column3: asyās tu svāminīṃ paśya yuvarāje virājati |
yasyāḥ śokopataptāyā yato rakṣas tato bhayam ||
atha vā paśya tām eva paśyatām eva pīḍyate |
yadi ca svayam ākhyātum aśaktā bhartṛdārikā |
tato mām anujānātu dhṛṣṭo hi gaṇikājanaḥ ||
evam uktābravīd evam evaṃ nāma nigadyatām |
akṛtvā sāhasaṃ kair vā mahāl labdho manorathaḥ ||
na cemaṃ gomukhād anyaḥ śrotum ālāpam arhati |
mahyam ākhyātum ārabdhā kṣaṇam adhīyatāṃ manaḥ ||
sa samāhṛtavān kāntāḥ kumārīr ā mahodadheḥ ||
yasyāś ca prathamaṃ tena gṛhītaḥ kampanaḥ karaḥ |
tā gaṇāntargatā yasmād anyāsāṃ ca mahattamāḥ |
mahāguṇās tataś cānyās tato .py anyās tataḥ parāḥ |
ya eṣa gaṇikābheda idānīm api dṛśyate |
tataḥ kālāt prabhṛty eva bharatena pravartitaḥ ||
gaṇamukhyās tu yās tāsām ekasyāṃ kila saṃtatau |
eṣā rājakulaṃ yāntīṃ dṛṣṭvā mātaram ekadā |
aham apy āci yāmīti punaḥ punar abhāṣata ||
jñātvā tu dṛḍhanirbandhāṃ sācī duhitaraṃ priyām |
atha rājakulād eṣā nivṛttā lakṣitā mayā |
prātaḥ sādaram ādatta citraṃ maṇḍanam ātmanaḥ ||
tayā pṛṣṭā kva yāsīti yatra tvam iti cābravīt ||
tayoktam ananujñātaiḥ putri gantuṃ na labhyate |
dhṛṣṭā hi dveṣyatāṃ yānti praṇayinyo .pi yoṣitaḥ ||
madhurāś copapannāś ca śrutvā mātur imā giraḥ |
svaptum icchāmy ahaṃ sakhyas tāvan nirgamyatām iti ||
yātāsu tāsu manasā yatsatyaṃ mama śaṅkitam |
etāḥ prasthāpitāḥ sakhyaḥ kim akāraṇam etayā ||
yā sakhībhir vinā nidrāṃ naiva labdhavatī purā |
tasyās tā eva nighnanti nidrām iti na badhyate ||
janmāntare .pi bhūyāsam ahaṃ tasmin vadhūr iti ||
ninīya mayi mattaś ca pratyāhṛtyedam abravīt ||
tan mitram atikaṣṭād yad vyasanāt kila rakṣati |
vyasane praharantyā tu śatrutvaṃ darśitaṃ tvayā ||
ahaṃ hi sarvaduḥkhānām idam utpannam ālayam |
tvayā jīvitam ujhantī vidhṛtā kim akāraṇam ||
yad etad ucyate loke sarvathā na tad anyathā |
bruvāṇām ity asaṃbaddham ity enām aham abruvam |
svāmini prabhur ity asmān upālambhena takṣasi ||
idaṃ kathaya nas tāvad vyasane .bhyudaye .pi vā |
tanum ekākinī tyaktvā sukham āsitum icchasi ||
duḥkhahetum ataḥ śaṃsa yadi sādhyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
atha sthitvā kṣaṇaṃ tūṣṇīṃ śanakair idam abravīt |
atha jānanty api tvaṃ māṃ nirlajjayitum icchasi |
idam ākhyāya te ko vā strībhyaḥ sāhasikaḥ paraḥ ||
upaviṣṭas tu nṛpater ūrau vāme nṛpātmajaḥ |
mayā dṛṣṭaḥ praviṣṭaś ca hṛdayaṃ me anivāritaḥ ||
dahane .pi vasann antar na dahaty araṇīṃ sa tu |
saumyo .pi puṇyavān asmān nirdhūmaṃ dagdhum icchati ||
sa hetur asya duḥkhasya sakṛddarśanam āgataḥ |
adhunā śrūyamāṇo .pi kiṃ vā vilapitair iti ||
śrutvedam aham asyās tu jātā yat satyam ākulā |
etām āśvāsayāmi sma niḥsārair vacanair iti ||
vaśayeyaṃ tava prītyai kiṃ punaḥ puruṣeśvaram ||
kiṃ tu tvāravatā śakyaṃ na labdhaṃ phalam īpsitam |
taṃ ceyaṃ siddham evārtham arthibhāvād abudhyata |
moktukāmā tadā prāṇān punar utprekṣitā mayā ||
tataḥ saṃbhrāntayā gatvā mayāsyā mātur antikam |
sa kenacid upāyena veśam āśu praveśyatām ||
padmāvatyai tayā cāsi cetasya iti bhāṣitaḥ ||
dhūrtair asmatprayuktais tvaṃ veśam etaṃ praveśitaḥ ||
tisṛṇāṃ ca prayuktānām abhavad bhavataḥ priyā |
tad idaṃ duḥsahaṃ duḥkhaṃ yasmād asmākam āgatam |
tvadāyattaḥ sa śeṣaś ca saṃvidhattāṃ bhavān iti ||
svayam eva tato gatvā devī vijñāpitā mayā |
mucyatām eṣa saṃtāpaḥ siddhaṃ viddhi prayojanam ||
nāsty eva ca mamāyāsaḥ śaratkāntyunmanā yataḥ |
sābravīn na nasaṃbhāvyam idaṃ nāgarake tvayi |
kiṃ tu prastāvam āsādya yatethāḥ kāryasiddhaye ||
tāṃ ca vijñāpayāmi sma rājaputreṇa modakaḥ |
svayam ārabhya hastābhyāṃ yuṣmabhyaṃ prahitā iti ||
sābravīj jālam apy etad āśvāsayati mādṛśam |
āśvāsanti kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛgā hi mṛgatṛṣṇikām ||
eṣa vijñāpayāmy adya śvo vijñāpayiteti ca |
atha mām abravīd devyāḥ purato mudrikālatā |
athavā tiṣṭha tāvat tvam aham evānayāmi tam |
viraktam api saṃdhātum alaṃ kauśalam asti naḥ ||
evam uttejitas tasyā gurubhir vacanair aham |
yātrāyāṃ tu pravṛttāyām abhyāse .tra yad eva me |
tan mayā kāritā yūyaṃ kṣiptvā hariśikhādikān ||
yat tat pravahaṇaṃ gacchat pathi yuṣmābhir īkṣitam |
yuṣmabhyaṃ darśitaṃ vandyaṃ tat tayā vandamānayā ||
yac ca vijñāpitā yūyam ānataṃ mukuṭaṃ manāk |
kṛtas toṣayatā kāntām asmākaṃ svāminīm iti ||
na hy āśīviṣadagdha antrāḥ kṣamante divasān iti ||
tad dohadam ivāsādya priyāṃ pravahaṇe sthitām |
na samākramya mṛdnāti tāvad darśaya tām iti ||
tvatpravīṇo .ham ity uktau tau ca bhūpatinā kila ||
alaṃ vāṃ kalahaṃ kṛtvā karmaśāstravidau yuvām |
yasya yā kuśalā śiṣyā sa nartayatu tām iti ||
śvaḥ suyāmunadantāṃ ca tasmād aryasutāṃ ca naḥ |
nṛtyantīṃ nṛpatir draṣṭā tatra draṣṭāstha tām iti ||
yā svābhāvikarūpakhaṇḍitajagadrūpābhimānā priyā śṛṅgārādirasaprayogasubhagā jāyeta sā kīdṛśī |
ity adhyāsitacetasā katham api prakrāntayā cintayā paryaṅkāṅkavivartinārtatanunā nītā triyāmā mayā ||
saṃprasthāpya manaḥ pūrvaṃ nṛpāsthānam agām aham ||
draṣṭum icchatha yāṃ pūrvam ājñāpayata tām iti ||
gomukhaḥ sa ca yām āha sā pūrvaṃ nṛtyatām iti ||
tābhyām āgatya pṛṣṭaś ca kā pūrvaṃ nṛtyatām iti |
pratyāhṛtya tataś ceto hriyamāṇaṃ balāt tayā |
nānugantum alaṃ rambhā nṛttam asyāḥ samenakā |
kuta eva parājetum abalā bālikā priyā ||
avocaṃ gomukhaṃ cedaṃ jīyamānāṃ priyām aham |
aśaktaḥ prekṣituṃ tena raṅgān nirgamyatām iti ||
tenoktam icchayā gantum āgantuṃ vā na labhyate |
jīvalokam iva jyotsnā priyā raṅgam arañjayat ||
kīrtikāntyor iyaṃ madhye yā lakṣmīr iva rājate |
eṣā naḥ svāminī devī vāmato mudrikālatā ||
na ceyaṃ śakyate jetum alaṃ vaḥ śaṅkayā yataḥ |
dṛṣṭā saṃbhāvayāmy asyās tena nṛttaguṇān iti ||
tāvaj jaya jayety uccair vimuktaḥ prekṣakair dhvaniḥ ||
raṅgād dṛṣṭā ca niryāntī bādhyamāneva sā mayā |
gomukhaṃ cābravaṃ kasmān mām idānīm upekṣase |
na hy ādeśam upekṣante tvādṛśā mādṛśām iti ||
śraddhāsyati na me vākyaṃ vipralabdhā hi sā mayā ||
ayaṃ hariśikhas tāvan nītyā vakragatiḥ kṛtaḥ |
vihanyād api naḥ kāryaṃ tasmād eṣa na yujyate ||
tasmād evaṃvidhe kārye niyogaṃ nāyam arhati ||
tatas tau sahitau yātau cirāt tu marubhūtikam |
prāptaṃ hariśikho .pṛcchat kiṃ vṛttaṃ bhavator iti ||
āyāty abhimukhī yaiva saiva yāti parāṅmukhī ||
na spraṣṭavyo na saṃbhāṣyo gomukhaḥ pāpavān iti ||
saṃbhrāntaś ca vilakṣaś ca tadā tām āha gomukhaḥ ||
manye niṣkāraṇaṃ kopaṃ devyāḥ ko nāma mādṛśaḥ |
kathaṃ niṣkāraṇo nāma kim idaṃ laghu kāraṇam ||
tvayā nartayatā kāntā kim iyaṃ sukham āsitā ||
athavā tad gataṃ nāma svāmī kiṃ karaṇaṃ tvayā |
paśyann abhimukhaṃ prītyā sa tathā vimukhīkṛtaḥ ||
bhavān paśyatu vā mā vā tvadvidheyo yuvā janaḥ |
tvam icchasi jayaṃ yasyāḥ kim asau na parājitā ||
uktavān paśyatānarthaṃ doṣo bhūto guṇo .pi naḥ ||
yadi prāk svāminī nṛtyet tayā rājā sutoṣitaḥ |
tadā ca guṇavidveṣī jano vaktā bhaved yathā |
itarā yadi nṛtyantī tena dṛṣṭā bhavet tadā |
norvaśīm api paśyet saḥ kuto madanamañjukām ||
prītyā yaś conmukhaḥ paśyan kṛtaḥ svāmī parāṅmukhaḥ |
aryaputre tu vimukhe yuṣmābhiḥ sā parājitā |
tena bravīmi sevāpi yāti yady aparādhatām |
ayi candramukhaṃ mā sma gomukhaṃ puruṣaṃ vada |
anālāpena yac cāsi kṣaṇam āyāsito mayā |
tat kṣamasva na hi svāsthā bādhante tvādṛśām iti ||
tataḥ sā gomukhenoktā draṣṭum icchati vaḥ priyaḥ |
saṃdehaś ced iyaṃ mudrā tadīyā dṛśyatām iti ||
tayoktaṃ kumbhakārāṇāṃ koṭir vasati vaḥ pure |
koṭiḥ kim iti nānītā na hi te kṣīṇamṛttikāḥ ||
tenoktaṃ kena vānītā mudrā vā mṛttikāmayī |
atha devī namaskṛtya prītā vijñāpitā mayā |
yat saṃdiśati naḥ svāmī yuṣmabhyaṃ tan niśāmyatām ||
preritaḥ tvām ahaṃ draṣṭuṃ yena lakṣmīm ivālasaḥ |
prasthitāyāṃ tato devyām āha māṃ padmadevikā |
iyaṃ prasādhyate yāvat tāvad āstāṃ bhavān iti ||
devyā saha praviśyāntar muhūrtād iva sā tataḥ |
tenoktaṃ kim ihākhyeyaṃ taruṇo nanu dārakaḥ |
iyam āyāti te paścād yātu tāvad bhavān iti ||
sayāno gomukhaḥ prāha laghu śrāvaya mām iti ||
mayoktaṃ gomukhas tāvad ekākī praviśatv iti |
sa praviśyoktavān dvāre devī kiṃ vidhṛteti mām ||
kuru nāgarakaṃ tāvat tvaṃ mām ity aham uktavān ||
yad etad ghuṣyate loke tad etat tathyatāṃ gatam ||
saṃkṣepatas tu vakṣyāmi yad yad devī kariṣyati |
tat tad evānukuryās tvaṃ dakṣo hi labhate śriyam ||
anuśiṣya sa mām evaṃ niryāyānīya ca priyām |
sukhaṃ supyāstam ity uktvā yathāsvaṃ sasuhṛdgataḥ ||
tataḥ praviśya dayitā mām ardhākṣṇā niraikṣata |
kṛtaṃ tathaiva ca mayā vanditena ca vanditā ||
sarvathā yad yad evāham anayā kāritas tadā |
pradoṣa eva kṣaṇadā kṣīṇā kṣaṇavad āvayoḥ ||
dineṣu mama samprāptaḥ senānīr idam abravīt ||
yuṣmābhir api kartavyaṃ yat tad ājñāpyatām iti ||
iti tasmin nate mahyaṃ gomukhena niveditam ||
tenaiva sahitā yūyaṃ gantāraḥ śanakair iti ||
tac ca krīḍāgṛhaṃ prāpya kalpitaṃ yamunātaṭe |
kim etad iti pṛṣṭā ca mayā saṃbhrāntacetasā |
kāśirājasya yā kanyā vṛtā tubhyaṃ purodhasā |
seyam utprekṣya tad duḥkhaṃ dāruṇaṃ maraṇād api |
ity asminn eva samaye prāptā hariśikhādayaḥ |
vayam eva viṣaṃ pūrvaṃ pibāmaḥ kalpyatām iti ||
yo hi mūlam anarthasya sa tāvat pāyyatām iti ||
abravīd gomukho vakti kiṃ mayātaḥ prayojanam ||
aham adhyetum ārabdho vaidyāt prāṇapradād iti ||
preryamāṇaṃ galāṣṭrābhiḥ śīghram ānaya taṃ śaṭham ||
yas tvayā ghaṭito .narthaḥ svāmino jīvitaḥ sukham |
svāminyā saha saṃyogaḥ so .yam evaṃ vijṛmbhate ||
so .bravīt so .yam āyāto vādaḥ saṃprati satyatām |
sa kālas tāvad āyātu svāminī yad viśaṅkitā |
tatraiva vidyāma nyañco pāsyāmas tyajyatāṃ tvarā ||
vijñāpayatu tenāsya dattaḥ pūrvam ayaṃ varaḥ ||
siddhiṃ yāsyati cāvaśyaṃ mā sma śaṅkāṃ karod iti ||
mātur evānayan mūlaṃ prāviśāma tataḥ purīm ||
gomukhena yad ākhyātaṃ tat kāryaṃ sādhyatām iti ||
tapantakas tu sāsphoṭam idaṃ siddhim iti bruvan |
rājapādair ahaṃ pṛṣṭas tāta kiṃ kriyatām iti |
śālīnena mayāpy uktaṃ modako dīyatām iti ||
yācate sma prahīṇatvād gatvā gatvā mahīpatim ||
iti saśarīrayā kṣaṇam iva kṣaṇadāḥ kṣapayan saha viśarīrayā dayitayā virasān divasān |
dinarajanīvihāraviparītam aham caritai rathacaraṇāhvayasya caritāni viḍambitavān ||
aham aryasutāṃ nītvā gṛhaṃ svagṛham āgataḥ |
vanditā ca vihasyāha devī padmāvatī yathā |
kiṃkāraṇaṃ vadhūr adya nāsmān āyāti vanditum ||
bhrātrā te kiṃ na muktaiva na vādyāpi vibudhyate |
kopitā vā bhaved bhartrā śiṣṭā duścaritair iti ||
nāsti naḥ svāminīty uktvā devyor nipatitā puraḥ ||
tato devyau tataḥ śeṣam aśeṣam avarodhanam |
rājā ca śrutavṛttāntaḥ sāsthāno dhairyam atyajat ||
akasmāc ca kṣaṇaṃ nidrāṃ gacchāmaḥ pratibudhya ca |
śūnyām īkṣāmahe śayyām aśrīkāṃ nalinīm iva ||
tato hā heti vikruśya samūrchāḥ kṣaṇam āsmahe |
na kvacic ca vicinvatyaḥ paśyāmaḥ svāminīm iti ||
ekām eva mayā labdhāṃ sutāṃ durlabhikām iti ||
dūrād eva ca māṃ bhītāṃ mā bhaiṣīr iti sāntvayan |
yadi mahyam iyaṃ dattā satyena tanayā tvayā |
tato muñca nayāmy enāṃ nyāsabhūtā hi kanyakā ||
anicchantī tatas tasya saṃnidhau ciram āsitum |
prayatnād dhairyam ādhāya pragalbheva tam abravam ||
arhaty avaśyam eveyam īdṛśī tvādṛśaṃ patim |
na punar dīyate tāvad bālikā śaiśavād iti ||
tena bravīmi tenādya tat smṛtvā kṣudrabuddhinā |
yad atrānantaraṃ nyāyyaṃ tad anuṣṭhīyatām iti ||
tataḥ samutpatann eva śokaḥ krodhena māmakaḥ |
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha kva yāsīti prālapaṃ gaganonmukhaḥ ||
kim etad iti pṛṣṭena vṛttānto .yaṃ mayoditaḥ ||
antare ca rumaṇvantam āha keyaṃ pramāditā |
yuktaṃ tadā yadālocya mahat sīdat prayojanam |
apanītā vadhūḥ kasmād bālān mama sutād iti ||
sa tam āha nivartadhvam alaṃ tatra gatena vaḥ |
yuṣmān dṛṣṭvā hi sa śiśuḥ prāṇān api parityajet ||
ājñāpayatha māṃ yac ca yac ca vijñāpayāmi vaḥ |
āsīnān āsane tena nivṛtya sthīyatām iti ||
upaviṣṭāya cācaṣṭa sphuṭaṃ divyena sā hṛtā |
anāthāpi na vaḥ kācit kenacit paribhūyate ||
nāsty asau yo na cāsmābhir īkṣitaś cāracakṣuṣā ||
ākāśe tu na me prajñā kramate divyagocare |
kadācit kupitā bhartre tatrāsīta vadhūr iti ||
sādhubhiḥ kathyamānāni pañca sthānāni tad yathā ||
prastāve yan mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ tad avadhīyatām ||
brahmann akṛtadāro .smi sutā me dīyatām iti ||
so .bravīd bhavataḥ ko .nyas trailokye .pi varo varaḥ |
kiṃ tu datteyam anyasmai kṣamatāṃ bhagavān iti ||
tasya bhrātā vṛṣo nāma sa cāṅgirasam abravīt |
amṛtā nāma duhitā mama sā gṛhyatām iti ||
pariṇīya tu tāṃ kanyām amṛtām amṛtopamām |
sā kadācit kathaṃcit taṃ kāraṇe .lpe .pi pīḍitā |
ahaṃ tv anicchate tubhyaṃ pitrā dattā balād iti ||
apṛcchad amṛtāgatya kiṃ dhyāyati bhavān iti ||
tena vanditasaṃdhyena cirād uktaṃ nanu priye |
devīṃ vihāya sāvitrīṃ kim anyac cintayāmy aham ||
atha sā śrutam ity uktvā svasminn āśramapādape |
putri mā sma tyaja prāṇān dustyajān dharmasādhanān |
straiṇam ajñānam āśritya saṃtuṣṭo hi patis tvayā ||
sarvathā matprasādāt te putri putro bhaviṣyati |
balena tapasā yasya na samāno bhaviṣyati ||
iti dattvā varaṃ tasyai sāvitrī divam āśrayat |
tena bravīmi kupitā kadācid amṛteva sā |
udyānaṃ praviśet tatra svayam anviṣyatām iti ||
āsīc ca mama devībhyāṃ prayogo .yam anuṣṭhitaḥ |
api nāmāsya kasyāṃcit striyāṃ bhāvo bhaved iti ||
prakāśān aprakāśāṃś ca pradeśān bahuśo bahūn |
anviṣyanto bhramāma sma na cāpaśyāma tatra tām ||
kebhyaścit kupitaḥ śāpān kebhyaścid vitaran karān |
api satyam idaṃ saumya syāt krīḍety aham abravam ||
so .bravīt satyam apy etat krīḍā yaiṣātiharṣajā |
asatye hy atra yā krīḍā tad unmattavijṛmbhitam ||
tvaritaṃ gamyatāṃ yasmān nārtaḥ kālam udīkṣate ||
paśyāmi sma tato gacchann aśokaśiśum agrataḥ |
āsīc ca mama kiṃ citraṃ yat pādasparśadohadaḥ |
athāliṅgitum ārabdhaḥ sānurāgam ahaṃ ca tām |
tayā cāṅgāni saṃhṛtya mā tāvad iti vāritaḥ ||
ārādhitavatī yakṣam ahaṃ kanyā satī yathā |
pānaṃ hastena dāsyāmi prasīdatu bhavān iti ||
sa ca tasya prasādān me yātaḥ siddhiṃ manorathaḥ |
āyācitaṃ tu yakṣāya na mayā pratiyācitam ||
vṛttāntaḥ kathitaś cāyam athokto dhanadena saḥ ||
nītvā samarpaya kṣipraṃ dārakāya vadhūm iti ||
tena cāham ihānītā gaganāgamanāc ca me |
śarīraṃ paruṣībhūtaṃ vāritā stha tato mayā ||
tasmai yakṣāya yuṣmābhiḥ sa me saṃpādyatām iti ||
taṃ cākarṇya mahāmanoratham idaṃ pūrṇaṃ cirāt kāṅkṣitaṃ naiva prītivikāsihārihasitaṃ dhatte sma kāntāmukham |
yācñāvṛttikadarthitair bahubhir apy āptair na hi prārthakāḥ prītiṃ yānti tathā yathā tanubhir apy arthaiḥ sukhābhyāgataiḥ ||
tato divasam āsitvā kāntāmātur ahaṃ gṛhe |
tām ādāya svam āvāsaṃ pravṛttotsavam āgamam ||
tatra sā sadhanādhyakṣaṃ taṃ yakṣaṃ kusumādibhiḥ |
ādāya madhunaḥ pūrṇāṃ tato mām abravīt priyā ||
eṣā dhanapateḥ śeṣā svādur āsvādyatām iti ||
nāhaṃ sevitum icchāmi kiṃ punar vyasanaṃ mahat ||
kimāsvādam idaṃ pānam iti pratyabravaṃ tataḥ ||
sābravīd vyaktam adyāpi na jānītha rasaṃ punaḥ |
pīyatām iti pītaṃ ca punas tadvacanānmayā ||
idaṃ kīdṛśam ity asyai pṛcchatyai kathitaṃ mayā |
column5: apṛcchat ko .yam asmāsu pravādaḥ kathyatām iti ||

column3: kim artham api me cittaṃ gatam asvasthatām iti ||
tayoktam aparāpy ekā śuktir āsvādyatāṃ tataḥ |
gamiṣyaty acirād eva cittaṃ te svasthatām iti ||
tasyām api ca pītāyām apaśyaṃ vegavadbhramān |
anicchan pāyitaḥ pānaṃ tathā tām apy apāyayam ||
yad eva rucitam tābhyāṃ tat taivāsmi pravartitaḥ ||
column5: yad eva rocate yasmai bhavet tat tasya sundaram ||
column9: dāpitā yena tenaiva tena tenaiva dāpitā ||

column3: yaḥ saṃtoṣayituṃ yakṣaṃ vivāhaḥ kṛtrimaḥ kṛtaḥ |
sa mayoktaḥ sakhe sakhyā tavāhaṃ pāyito balāt |
bhavatāpi rucau satyāṃ sthīyatāṃ pīyatām iti ||
pānaṃ sādhu na paśyāmi kiṃ punar mantriṇām iti ||
pālayatsu kim asmākam ātmabhir vañcitair iti ||
anuṣṭhāne punas tasya svātantryaṃ svāminām iti ||
niḥśaṅkaḥ pātum ārabdhas taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tapantakaḥ ||
unmatta kim asaṃbaddhaṃ bhāṣamāṇaḥ puraḥ prabhoḥ |
svāmino niḥsapatnau tu pādāv icchāmi sevitum ||
ālāpā nirgatāḥ saumyād gomukhasya mukhād iti ||
mayoktaṃ bhaṇa paśyāmas tvayā kasmāc ciraṃ sthitam |
ko vā tavedam ākāram ujjvalaṃ kṛtavān iti ||
ājñāpitās tava bhrātrā pānam āsevitaṃ niśi ||
tena pānagṛhāt pānaṃ svādyamānaṃ svadeta yat |
svayam āsvādya tad bhrātre tvayā prasthāpyatām iti ||
tatra cāsvādayann eva tat tat pānaṃ manāṅ manāk |
matto .haṃ preṣayāmi sma yuṣmabhyam api saṃtatam ||
mama tv āsīt kim ity eṣā nivārayati mām iti |
tataḥ parijanaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasuptam abhavan mama |
na yuktaṃ sukhasuptasya śatror api nibodhanam ||
pratibodhya jalaṃ yāce taddhi me na virūpyate ||
iti nirdhārya tasyāṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭir nipātitā |
yāvad anyaiva sā kāpi nārīrūpaiva candrikā ||
āsīc ca mama kiṃ yakṣī kiṃ gandharvī kim apsarāḥ |
mānuṣī syāt kulastrī syād gaṇikā syād iyaṃ na hi ||
tasmād vidyādharī prāptā kāpi kenāpi hetunā ||
sā tu saṃtyājitā nidrāṃ sadyaś caraṇapīḍayā |
mām ālokya tathābhūtaṃ bhītā bhūmāv upāviśat ||
abravīc ca na kartavyam aryaputreṇa sāhasam |
tataḥ śrutveti yat satyam ātmany evāsmi lajjitaḥ |
evaṃ kāriṇam apy eṣā saṃbhāvayati mām iti ||
śrūyatāṃ cāpriyaṃ sā te priyā madanamañjukā |
āsīn me manasi hṛtā na sā mṛtā sā yā dṛṣṭer vrajati na gocaraṃ priyā me |
jyotsnā hi sphuṭadhavalāpi kaumudīndor andhānāṃ bahalatamomalīmasaiva ||
tatas tām abravaṃ bhīru tvam eva hi mama priyā |
tathāpi tu vinodena tiṣṭhāmaḥ kathyatām iti ||
yasmāt tena viśuddhyarthaṃ svānam ācaritaṃ tayā ||
tṛṇāya manyate sthairyād yā devīṃ pṛthivīm api ||
tau ca putram avindantau ciraṃ duḥkham atiṣṭhatām |
prauḍhāyā iva kanyāyāḥ pitarau sadṛśaṃ varam ||
bhavitā bhavatoḥ putraḥ putrakau duḥkham ujhatam ||
ekā ca duhitā yasyāḥ kalāśālī bhaviṣyati |
kāle kvacid atīte ca prasūtā pṛthivī sutam |
pṛṣṭo mānasavegena kim etad iti vegavān ||
column9: kim etad iti saṃdihya kim etad iti pṛṣṭavān ||

column3: tat prajāḥ pālayeḥ putra prajās tvāṃ pālayantu ca |
pālitair hi mṛgendro .pi kānanair eva pālyate ||
na nivṛttā yadā devī tadopāyaṃ prayuktavān ||
na me sampādayaty ājñām aho dharmaḥ satām iti ||
tato hrītā ca bhītā ca sāśruśreṇiḥ savepathuḥ |
pādayoḥ patitā patyur vyajñāpayad asau śanaiḥ ||
yadā tarhi mayā yūyaṃ pāvayantas tapovanam |
upāsyāḥ pāvanatamaṃ sa kālaḥ kathyatām iti ||
bhartāraṃ vegavatyāś ca dṛṣṭvā draṣṭāsi mām iti ||
evaṃ caiva ca kalyāṇi pitā vijñāpyatām iti |
tāta tvayi vanaṃ yāte ko me dāsyati modakān |
tat tan mānasavegas te bhrātā dātāsyatām iti ||
iti rājyakalatramitraputrān gṛhadhāmaṃ ca tṛṇāya manyamānaḥ |
gurusattvarajastamaḥkalaṅkāṃ prakṛtiṃ hātum agād vanaṃ narendraḥ ||
atha yāte kvacit kāle mātaṅgādhipateḥ sutā |
sā sma vegavatīm āha rājaputri kim āsyate |
tayoktaṃ nāsti me śaktir gantum ākāśavartmanā |
upahasya tatas tās tām uccais tāḍitapāṇayaḥ |
tena coktāṅkam āropya mātaḥ kiṃ dīyatām iti ||
tayoktaṃ dehi me vidyāṃ mahārāja sasādhanām |
acireṇaiva dāsyāmi mātar ity abhidhāya sā |
gatā vegavatīṃ draṣṭum āṣāḍhaṃ sasakhī sakhīm ||
upahasya ca tāṃ sāpi vipakṣām iva sārasīm |
kim ayaṃ kṣipyate kālo vidyā me dīyatām iti ||
tenoktam api dāsyāmi tvarase kim akāraṇam |
gurukāryakriyāvyagraṃ kiṃ na paśyasi mām iti ||
apatan mātur utsaṅge saṃtapteva vaśā hrade ||
pṛthivī tu samāhūya sacivau bhartur abravīt |
acireṇa pitur mūlaṃ dārikāṃ nayataṃ yuvām ||
antaraṅgo hi saṃbandhaḥ putraiḥ pitror akṛtrimaḥ |
bhrātaras tu dviṣanty eva bhrātṝn ekodarān api ||
pṛcchanti sma ca tatraikam abhivādya tapasvinam |
brahman brūhi tam uddeśaṃ yatrāste vegavān iti ||
aṅgaṇe krīḍataḥ prītāv imau ca śikhipannagau ||
āsannāgamanaś cāsau dagdhaṃ hi kaṭhinaiḥ karaiḥ |
tapastāntaṃ tataḥ kāyaṃ sakāyam iva vegavān |
abravīn mantriṇau nāyaṃ mama tātaḥ sa vegavān ||
tābhyām uktaṃ sa evāyaṃ tathā cetthaṃ ca dṛśyate |
tādṛśā eva dṛśyante tathā cetthaṃ ca sādhavaḥ ||
rājño mānasavegasya rājyaṃ no varṇyatām iti ||
tābhyām uktam aśakyaṃ tad guṇāḍhyenāpi śaṃsitum |
tam apekṣya tu rājānaḥ śeṣāś chattraviḍambakāḥ ||
iyaṃ māṇavikā kasmād ānīteti ca pṛcchate |
vidyālābhārtham ity uktaṃ tasmai tābhyāṃ savistaram ||
yuvābhyāṃ nītipannābhyāṃ sa bālaḥ pālyatām iti ||
vegavatyapi sotsāhā karoti sma mahat tapaḥ |
mā rājadārike bhaiṣīr ity uktvā parivāritā ||
kvāsau kvāsau khalaḥ sarpa iti pṛṣṭā kumārakaiḥ |
te tv ālokya tam uddeśam avocann uccakaistarām |
rājaputri na sarpo .yam ayaṃ sarpāntakaḥ śikhī ||
tvayā sarpa iti jñātaṃ tasmād āśvasyatām iti ||
prekṣaṇīyaṃ ca tad draṣṭum adṛṣṭaṃ vanavāsibhiḥ |
vayam ārādhitāḥ prītās tadvidyāṃ labhatām iti ||
tenoktaṃ yadi ca prītā no bhavanto .nujānate |
anayā yat tapas taptam asmābhiś cedam īdṛśam |
tad asyāḥ kulavidyānām alaṃ bhavatu siddhaye ||
yaś cāsyāḥ ko .pi dīrghāyur grahīṣyati varaḥ karam |
rājyasya daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ sa madīyasya bhokṣyati ||
evam uktvā tatas tasyās tat sarvaṃ kṛtavān pitā |
apṛcchad api kalyāṇi kuśalī vegavān iti ||
yāsau vegavatī sāhaṃ tasya vegavataḥ sutā ||
atīte tu kvacit kāle saśarīreva cārutā |
sā ca tadguṇabhūyiṣṭhāṃ dṛḍhaṃ dveṣṭi kathām api |
sa kadācit kvacit kāṃcid dṛṣṭvā tāpasakanyakām |
balād bhoktum upakrāntas tayā coktaṃ sphurad ruṣā ||
kiṃtu vegavataḥ sādhoḥ putratvaṃ tena mucyase ||
bhavataḥ śatadhā mūrdhā dagdhabuddheḥ sphuṭed iti ||
tatas trastas tataḥ śāpād akāmāṃ kāminīm asau |
api notsahate draṣṭuṃ kuta eva niṣevitum ||
sa tu mām abravīn mātas tathā madanamañjukā |
protsāhyatāṃ yathā kṣipram upasarpati mām iti ||
kas te mānuṣakeṇārthaḥ kuru vidyādharaṃ patiṃ ||
rājā mānasavegas tu bhartā te varṇyatāṃ katham |
doṣān api manuṣyāṇāṃ gṛhṇāmi sma yathā yathā |
guṇān vidyādharāṇāṃ tu gṛhṇāmi sma yathā yathā |
alaṃ bhagini saṃtapya jīvitaṃ rakṣyatām iti ||
tayā tūktaṃ mayā nedam ātmaduḥkhena rudyate |
aśakyaṃ tu bhayaṃ bhīmam āhṛtaṃ mandayā mayā ||
kulavidyādhanair yaś ca tuṅgair api na mādyati ||
sa madvṛttāntam ajñātvā daśāṃ yāsyati kāmapi |
kiṃ tu pratyāśayā prāṇān ekayā dhārayāmy aham |
tataḥ śrutveti yat satyaṃ jātāhaṃ jātasaṃśayā |
vidyādharanarendraḥ syād uta na syād asāv iti ||
kiṃ kācid dūtikā yātu sāpy asaktā parīkṣitum |
dūtikā matsamā nāsti svayam eva vrajāmy ataḥ ||
tataḥ svārthāhitotsāhā pṛcchāmi sma tava priyām |
tava priyāya kiṃ vārtā tvadīyā dīyatām iti ||
atha kṣaṇam iva dhyātvā tayoktaṃ smayamānayā |
tulyam evāvayoḥ kāryaṃ śaktau satyāṃ kim āsyate ||
idaṃ hi guru kartavyaṃ kṣiptakālaṃ ca sīdati |
īdṛśaṃ tvādṛśī karma kāryate katham anyathā ||
iyaṃ maṇḍalitā veṇī mayā sakhi tavāgrataḥ |
dāhyā vā dahaneneyaṃ mocyā vā gṛdhrajambukaiḥ |
gatvā cāgaccha doleva na sthātavyaṃ kvacic ciram |
asaṅgā hi gatiḥ sakhyāḥ kāntaṃ yāntyāḥ smṛter iva ||
apaśyam aryaputraṃ ca hā kvāsīti pravādinam ||
sa ca saṃskartum ātmānaṃ kvātra yakṣaḥ kva cājjukā ||
yac ca pātum anicchantaḥ pāyitāḥ stha balān madhu |
tatra yat kāraṇaṃ tac ca prāyaḥ pratyakṣam eva ca ||
na draṣṭavyāsmi supteti pratiṣiddhāḥ stha yan mayā |
tad ājñāpaya māṃ kṣipram imāṃ madanamañjukām |
ānayāmi parair nītāṃ śuddhā nītir iva śriyam ||
āsīc ca mama na nyāyyaṃ praiṣaṇīyajanocitam |
athainām abruvaṃ caṇḍi śrutam ehi śayāvahai |
na hi tāmraśikhaṇḍānām adyāpi sphurati dhvaniḥ ||
prabhāte mām avandanta na tu vegavataḥ sutām ||
gomukhas tv acirāt prāptaḥ prathamaṃ mām avandata |
asau hariśikhenoktaḥ suṣṭhu khalv asi paṇḍitaḥ |
vandyalakṣaṇayuktāṃ yo vandyām api na vandate ||
bhaṇa kena na pūjyeyaṃ yā naḥ pūjyena pūjitā |
candrāsannair hi nakṣatrair lokaḥ kāryāṇi kāryate ||
ityādi vadatas tasya pakṣam utkarṣayann iva |
atha senāpatiḥ prāptaḥ prātar mām idam abravīt |
idānīm eva devībhyāṃ devo vijñāpito yathā ||
tena prasādo yady asti vegavatyā tataḥ saha |
devena tu vihasyoktam evam astu kim āsyate |
mamāpi hi manasy āsīd ayam eva manorathaḥ ||
column5: sadaiva me manasy āsīd ayam eva manorathaḥ ||

column3: kiṃ tu mātā varasyātra devī bhavatu māgadhī |
rumaṇvadādayaḥ pakṣe tasyā evaṃ bhavantv iti ||
tapantakas tu māgadhyā preṣitaḥ prekṣituṃ vadhūm |
śvaśrūs te māṃ khalīkṛtya sāntarhāsam avocata |
kva yāsi jālma labdho .si preṣitas tvaṃ caraḥ kila ||
asyāḥ saubhāgyam utpādyam avaśyaṃ kārmaṇair mayā ||
kiṃ mayā preṣitaḥ kaścid bhavān iva caras tayā ||
devyāḥ niṣkramitaḥ svasmād aham antaḥpurād iti ||
tapantakena yā prāptā tatra gatvā viḍambanā |
atha gatvā svam āvāsaṃ vāsāvāsaṃ praviśya ca |
śayanaṃ ca navoḍheva sevate sma parāṅmukhī ||
upasṛtya śanaiś caināṃ bravīmi sma vilakṣakaḥ |
tayā tu katham apy uktaṃ sphuṭitasmitacandrikam |
nṛpasyāniṣṭam āśaṅkya manye kim api dāruṇam |
anyad uccalitāḥ sthānaṃ vihāyemāṃ purīm iti ||
mayā vegavatī pṛṣṭā kās tā iti tayoditam |
mama prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ svayam ādāya tāḥ sakhīḥ |
utpatantī mayā dṛṣṭā vegād vegavatī nabhaḥ |
catasraḥ kila tiṣṭhanti bhaginyaḥ kanyakās tava ||
tatas tā dārikās tebhyaḥ putrebhyo me dadātv iti ||
abhūc ca dārikāpakṣe tadā devī kanīyasī |
ahaṃ ca varapakṣe tu tātaḥ sāntaḥpuro .bhavat ||
yā samṛddhis tadā dṛṣṭā vatsarājakule mayā |
tām adyāpi na paśyāmi prāpyāpi śriyam īdṛśam ||
prabhāte tān ahaṃ prāptān savrīḍān iva pṛṣṭavān |
yātā yasya yathā rātriḥ sa tathā varṇayatv iti ||
tathaiteṣāṃ gatā rātrir mā sma gacchad yathā punaḥ ||
śūro .ham iti bhāryāyāḥ pādasthānaṃ na muktavān ||
tapantakaḥ punaḥ śayyāṃ tyaktvā supto mahītale |
yo hi vāsagṛhe suptaḥ prītayā saha kāntayā |
sa kathaṃ paravṛttāntaiḥ kṣapāṃ kṣapitavān iti ||
ramamāṇaḥ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā sasuhṛt pānam ācaram ||
sabhāryāḥ suhṛdas te .pi tābhir eva sahāgatāḥ ||
mayoktaṃ yasya yasyāś ca pānaṃ saha na duṣyati |
sa tayā sā ca tenaiva pānam āsevatām iti ||
column5: baliṃ tasmāt tena ca tadyathā eva iti ||

column3: gṛhītas tarhi niḥśaṅkaṃ mayā hariśikhaḥ svayam ||
āsīnāyāṃ tatas tasyāṃ tena sārdham anantaram |
abravīt pariśeṣo .yaṃ kim anyat kriyatām iti ||
vayaṃ ca sahitā dāraiḥ krīḍantaḥ sukham āsmahi ||
kadācit kupitā mahyaṃ yena kenāpi hetunā |
ko nu mā nayatīty āsaṃ saṃdehādhīnamānasaḥ ||
devādīnām ayaṃ sparśo lakṣaṇair na hi vidyate |
tasmād ahaṃ yathāśakti vyāyamya dviṣatā saha |
svasyāḥ susadṛśaṃ jāteḥ karma vyavasitaṃ tvayā ||
vandhyas tu tava saṃkalpaḥ phūtkāro vāsuker iva |
tasmād dadāmi te .bhīṣṭaṃ dvayor anyataraṃ varam ||
brūhi kiṃ mriyase dṛṣṭvā priyāṃ madanamañjukām |
mama tv āsīn mṛṇālīva cikkhalāt kaluṣād iyam |
yadi nāma priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā nyaseyaṃ kāyaśṛṅkhalām |
tato me śatrumitreṇa bhaved upakṛtaṃ mahat ||
yaṃ yam eva smaran bhāvaṃ tyajaty ante kaḍevaram |
column5: yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaran bhāvaṃ tyajaty ante kalevaram |
column9: yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram |

column3: taṃ tam eva kilāpnoti tadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ||
yas tu paśyan puraḥ prītyā priyāṃ prāṇair viyujyate |
iti saṃkalpayann eva raṇantīṃ kiṅkiṇīm adhaḥ |
śṛṇomi sma prabhātendoḥ paśyāmi sma tanuprabhām ||
tāṃ diśaṃ prahitākṣeṇa dṛṣṭā vegavatī mayā |
yathāhaṃ tava mātuś ca tathāyaṃ mama vallabhaḥ |
tasyāḥ puro nihatyainaṃ yāsau mām avamanyate |
tāṃ ca tvāṃ ca tatas tasya gamayiṣyāmi pṛṣṭhataḥ ||
śanaiḥ śanair mahīṃ yāyāt tathāyaṃ nīyatām iti ||
hantuṃ vegavatīm eva pravṛttaḥ prārthitas tayā ||
nipatanti na nistriṃśāḥ śūrāṇāṃ tvādṛśām iti ||
ekā vegavatī kṛttā bhavanty aṣṭau tathāvidhāḥ |
tathā mānasavegau dvau prāgalbhetām itas tataḥ ||
ahaṃ tu tanmahāyuddhaṃ paśyann eva śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
kathaṃ duruttarād asmān mamottāro bhaved iti |
upāyaṃ cintayann eva smarāmi sma kathām imām ||
gurave dātum icchāmaḥ kāṅkṣitāṃ dakṣiṇām iti ||
utpādyatām apatyaṃ ca kratubhiś cejyatām iti ||
tair uktam aparā kācid dakṣiṇā mṛgyatām iti |
tenoktam alam etena graheṇa bhavatām iti ||
tasmān naivātinirbandhān nivartante sma te yadā |
tadā kruddhena guruṇā yācitā dakṣiṇām imām ||
kumbhodhnīnāṃ sahasraṃ me datta sthāta ca mā ciram ||
te tu bhrāntvā mahīṃ kṛtsnām ārūḍhās tuhinācalam |
jñātāḥ kila kubereṇa kauverīṃ prasthitā diśam ||
kuberasyāpi kiṃ nāsti tena te gurudakṣiṇām |
saṃcaranto bahūn deśāṃś cārayantaś ca gāḥ śanaiḥ |
lobhanīyam idaṃ dravyaṃ na parityāgam arhati ||
tenedam upapannaṃ ca guruṇā ca mayoditam |
ramaṇīyavipākaṃ ca vākyaṃ naḥ kriyatām iti ||
athovāca dvitaḥ prīto yuktam āryeṇa cintitam |
na hi svārtheṣu muhyanti buddhayas tvādṛśām iti ||
ekatas tu tritaṃ dṛṣṭvā tūṣṇīm āsīnam uktavān |
yad atra yuktaṃ tad brūtāṃ kim udāste bhavān iti ||
tenoktaṃ ninditaṃ kurvan na kaścin na nivāryate |
pitāpi hi viṣaṃ khādan naiva putrair upekṣyate ||
tena vijñāpayāmi tvāṃ kriyatāṃ ca vaco mama |
buddhivṛddhena hi grāhyaṃ bālād api subhāṣitam ||
anāryapriyam āryeṇa na kāryaṃ kāryam īdṛśam |
kāryaṃ cen mahyam ātmīyam aṃśam āryaḥ prayacchatu ||
tataḥ kruddhau ca lubdhau ca kaniṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhamadhyamau |
teṣām anyatamaḥ pānthaḥ kūpe loṣṭum apātayat ||
tataḥ ṣvād iti kṛtvā taj jarjaraṃ ghaṭakarparam |
babhañja sa ca saṃdehaḥ pathikānāṃ nyavartata ||
tena gāvaś ca pānthāś ca bhrātarau ca mahātmanā |
kūpa eva tritaṃ tyaktvā sagoyūthau palāyitau ||
tritas tu ghaṭam ālokya rajjvaiva saha pātitam |
āṃ smṛtaṃ labdham ity uktvā vedavṛttāntapeśalaḥ |
prataran prataran dhīraṃ golehyād utthitas tritaḥ ||
gatvā ca stokam adhvānaṃ gokhurālīṃ nirūpayan |
abhivādya tam aprākṣīn mārge bhagavatā kvacit |
na dṛṣṭāv evamākārau sagoyūthau dvijāv iti ||
tenoktaṃ na mayā dṛṣṭau tau mahāpāpakāriṇau |
yau tvāṃ pātālagambhīre kūpe bhrātaram aujhatām ||
praṣṭavyāv api na kṣudrau draṣṭavyāv api na tvayā |
yāv evaṃ ninditācārau praṣṭavyau kuta eva tau ||
tam uvāca tritaḥ krodhād dhūrtaṃ kaluṣamānasam |
tādṛśā eva jānanti sādhavaṃ na bhavādṛśāḥ ||
śarīraṃ ca sahasrākṣaṃ karaṃ ca kuliśākulam |
varaṃ brūhīti tenoktas tritas tuṣṭas tam abravīt |
bhrātarau me sapāpau ced apāpau bhavatām iti ||
punar brūhīti tenoktaḥ punar apy abravīt tritaḥ |
gurū me gurave gās tāḥ prītau vitaratām iti ||
paryāptam iti tenokte prītaḥ śakro divaṃ yayau ||
tathāham api tām iṣṭiṃ kiṃ na kuryāṃ manomayīm |
yājakais tu vinā yajñaṃ kṣatriyasya virudhyate ||
tasmād asmād upāyena kenottiṣṭheyam ity aham |
iti ceti ca nirdhārya smṛtyāmitagatiṃ gataḥ ||
kaṣṭām āpadam āpanno vidhaye māṃ smarer iti ||
evaṃ ca cintayann eva kūpe kūpataros tale |
apaśyam aham ātmānaṃ taṃ cāmitagatiṃ puraḥ ||
māṃ cāvocat sa vanditvā harṣaghargharayā girā |
kartum icchati yo mohān mahāgaurīṃ sa rakṣati ||
tāvat sarojajalajadhvajavajralakṣmyā tvatpādapaṅkajayugaṃ na namāmi yāvat |
na pṛcchāmi sma panthānaṃ deśaṃ nagaram eva vā ||
anumāya tatas tena vasantaṃ deśam antike |
pṛṣṭavān asmi kasyedam udyānam iti so .bravīt ||
athavā kiṃ na etena mahātmāno hi mādṛśaiḥ |
krīḍanti tena devena svayaṃ vijñāyatām iti ||
praviśāmi sma tatrāham eko dauvārikaś ca mām |
antare vetram ādhāya tiṣṭheti dvāry adhārayat ||
athāvocad dvitīyas taṃ dhik tvāṃ nirbuddhacakṣuṣam |
kiṃ kadācit tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā kaścid īdṛśaḥ |
evaṃ vā praviśan dhīraṃ dharaṇīdhīradhīr iti ||
tenoktam ananujñātaṃ bhartrā nāradam apy aham |
viśantaṃ nānujānāmi kiṃ punaḥ saumyam īdṛśam ||
upasṛtya tam ābhāṣya bhoḥ sādho sukham āsyate |
kaccid vā pratyavekṣyante bahukṛtvaḥ kalā iti ||
vīṇāvyāsaktacittatvāt paśyati sma na mām asau |
avakṣiptaṃ hi dṛśyāni manaḥ paśyati nekṣaṇe ||
mayā tu calitā vīṇā gṛhītvāgre yadā tadā |
vīṇātaś cakṣur ākṣipya mayi nikṣiptavān asau ||
mām upāveśayat prītas tasminn eva śilāsane ||
prakṣālya ca svayaṃ pādau dattārghaḥ samupāviśat ||
anuyuktaś ca sa mayā ko .yaṃ janapadas tvayā |
bhūṣitaḥ katamac cedaṃ puraṃ saccaritair iti ||
atha tena vihasyoktaṃ saṃbhāvyā nabhasā gatiḥ |
tvādṛśāṃ devaputrāṇām ajñānaṃ tu na yujyate ||
yo hi deśāntaraṃ yāti mugdho .pi dharaṇīcaraḥ |
na jñātā pathikeneti duḥśliṣṭam iva dṛśyate ||
śrutvā dārair asaṃtuṣṭo yakṣīṃ kāṃcid asādhayam ||
sā cāhaṃ ca tataḥ prītau śaile śaile vane vane |
yad vā yad rucitaṃ tasyai tatra tatrāramāvahi ||
cintitaṃ ca mayā rātrau na me yakṣyā prayojanam |
ānīya nabhasā nyastaḥ pure .smin bhavatām iti ||
tenoktaṃ na na saṃbhāvyā yakṣarakṣaḥsu caṇḍatā |
paścāt tāpagṛhītā tu na sā yuṣmān vimokṣyati ||
ko .yaṃ janapadaḥ syāt kā purīti ca yad ucyate |
aṅgā janapadaḥ sphītaś campā ceyaṃ mahāpurī ||
ahaṃ ca dattako nāma vaṇik paurapuraskṛtaḥ |
gāḍhaṃ parikaraṃ badhnan dhāvamānaḥ sa cāgamat ||
śṛṇomi sma ca paurāṇāṃ jalpatām itaretaram |
ciraṃjīvadbhir āścaryaṃ pṛthivyāṃ kiṃ na dṛśyate ||
kva ca kasyāpi pānthasya rajjubhāge vyavasthitaḥ ||
kuṅkumaṃ kretum āyātaḥ kaścid vāṇijam abravīt |
cirād ākarṇya tad vākyaṃ kupitaḥ sa tam abravīt |
vaṇijo .nye kim utsannā yena khādasi mām iti ||
tatra yānād avaplutya prāviśaṃ gṛham ṛddhimat |
utthāsnur iva medhāvī viśālaṃ hṛdayaṃ śriyaḥ ||
atha vyajñāpayan prahvāḥ sūpakārāḥ sametya mām |
ājñāpayata yuṣmākaṃ kaḥ pākaḥ sādhyatām iti ||
mama tv āsīn mayā tāvad brāhmaṇatvaṃ prakāśitam |
tad idaṃ yuktam ity etac cintayitvedam uktavān |
karmakaryo .pi tāny asmin gṛhe prāyeṇa jānate ||
aho nāgarakaḥ svāmī svayaṃ pravahaṇena yaḥ |
cintitaṃ ca mayā jāto mahānayam upadravaḥ |
kena nāma prakāreṇa tyajeyam idam ity aham |
teṣāṃ saṃpratyayārthaṃ ca haran dāharujaṃ kila |
ballavas tu puraḥ sthitvā vīṇādattakam uktavān |
nāyaṃ vipraḥ kathaṃ vipraḥ pradviṣyād ghṛtapāyasam ||
niśvāso .sya mayā ghrātaḥ śanakair niścarann iti ||
abravīc ca payaḥpānaṃ yūyaṃ pibata pānakam |
mayā tu jātatarṣeṇa pāne pariṇatiṃ gate |
kāntam adhyāsi paryaṅkaṃ nyastaṃ tatraiva maṇḍape ||
evaṃ ca sukham āsīno vīṇādattakam abravam |
vīṇonmattir iyaṃ kasmāc campāyāṃ kathyatām iti ||
sa ca tāṃ dhriyamāṇo .pi varair varaguṇākaraiḥ |
tena śulkam upanyastaṃ duḥsaṃpādaṃ surair api ||
apūrvaṃ kila gāyantyās tasyāḥ kim api gītakam |
yo .nuvādayitā vīṇāṃ pariṇetā sa tām iti ||
na kaścid yo na campāyāṃ vīṇayonmattakaḥ kila ||
ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe gate māse sā tad gāyati gītakam ||
anena ca prakāreṇa yātaḥ kālo mahān ayam |
na cāpi vīṇayā kaścid anugacchati tām iti ||
yadi sajjā suhṛdgoṣṭhī samasyā kriyatām iti ||
tenoktaṃ suhṛdaḥ sajjā yadi vaḥ susthitā gṛhāḥ |
kalyā gandharvadattā vā sva eva kriyatām iti ||
tatas taṃ pṛṣṭavān asmi mahotsāhena cetasā |
rūpaṃ gandharvadattāyāḥ kīdṛg ity atha so .bravīt ||
utkṛṣṭavismayavimohitamānasena rūpaṃ nirūpayitum eva mayā na śakyam ||
pṛcchāmi sma ca bhūyas tam api śakyā bhaven mayā |
draṣṭuṃ gandharvadatteti tena coktaṃ na śakyate ||
agāndharveṇa sā draṣṭuṃ devenāpi na śakyate |
yadi cecchatha tāṃ draṣṭuṃ gāndharvaṃ śikṣyatām iti ||
gāndharvaśabdas tat tasmād asmākaṃ kāryatām iti ||
āsīc ca mama taṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtaṃ naravānaram |
anyāyāgatam aiśvaryaṃ nindanty eva hi sādhavaḥ ||
apūjayan mayā cāsau na draṣṭum api pāritaḥ ||
atha ruṣṭakaṭākṣeṇa lohitākṣaḥ sa vīkṣya mām |
abravīd dattakas taṃ ca yakṣībhartur dvijanmanaḥ |

column5: akṛtvā kiṃ karoty asya nāradīyaṃ bhavān iti ||

column3: na ca pārayate dātuṃ dāridryāt kākaṇīm api ||
na cāsminn ekam apy asti yady asti pratipadyatām ||
ko yakṣīkāmukaṃ śakto daridram iti jalpitum ||
yasya dāsaḥ sadāso .haṃ tvaṃ jānāsy eva mādṛśaḥ |
sa yakṣīkāmukaḥ kasmād daridra iti bhaṇyate ||
patite droṇamegho .pi na tiṣṭhati jalaṃ sthale ||
mayā tu sā viparyaksthā sthāpitāṅke yadā tadā |
bhūtiko māṃ dhig ity uktvā vīṇādattakam uktavān ||
na yakṣīkāmuko mandaḥ śakyaḥ śikṣayituṃ mayā |
vīṇāgrahaṇam apy eṣa na jānāti sukhaiditaḥ ||
na nāma svayam etena yadi vīṇā na vāditā |
iti saṃtakṣya māṃ vāgbhir ātodyaṃ parivartya ca |
sa niṣādo niṣādaṃ me ṣaḍja ityupadiṣṭavān ||
catasraḥ pañca vā tantryaś chinnāś caḍ iti visvarāḥ ||
akṛtvā kiṃ karoty asya nāradīyaṃ bhavān iti ||
ahaṃ tu vismṛtacchadmā chinnatantrīm api kṣaṇam |
kim etad iti jalpanto mām aikṣanta savismayāḥ ||
kākatālīyam ity uktvā gata eva sadakṣiṇaḥ ||
vacobhiḥ kila te cittaṃ madīyaṃ hartum aicchatām ||
vegavatyā vimuktaṃ ca pratibhānti sma tāni mām |
atha prasupta evāsmi nirāśe te ca jagmatuḥ ||
mama tv āsīd avaśyaṃ māṃ netā śvas tatra dattakaḥ |
vīṇā ca vādanīyā syāc cirotsṛṣṭā ca sā mayā ||
bhaktyā mātuḥ sapatnīva nisargakuṭilā hi sā ||
vīṇā saṃnihitā ceyaṃ velā ceyaṃ nirākulā |
jijñāse tāvad ity enāṃ vicāryāhaṃ gṛhītavān ||
utkarṣann apakarṣaṃś ca kāścit kāścin manāṅ manāk |
samudrasena godatta dhāva dhāva sakhe drutam ||
tasmāt sarasvatīvīṇe dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca saṃhate |
yena vo rocate gantuṃ tena prasthīyatām iti ||
ahaṃ tu pādacāreṇa gacchāmi śanakair iti ||
amantrayanta yāntaś ca kruddhā nāgarakā mithaḥ |
apaśyaṃ veśmanāṃ mālās tasyaiva sirasām iva ||
dhruvaṃ sā rākṣasī yakṣī yadi vā mṛttikāmayī |
kruddhayā mugdhayā vāpi yayā svārtho na cetitaḥ ||
athavā sarvam evedam alīkaṃ pratibhāti mām |
kva yakṣīkāmikaḥ kvāyaṃ kāmaḥ kāmī rater iva ||
atha nāgarakāḥ prāpan sudhāṃ gṛhapater gṛham |
sphuraddivyaprabhāvāt tu na vidma kiṃmayair iti ||
teṣu nāgarakaḥ kaścit kāṃścid āha sma sasmitam |
yat satyaṃ lajjito .smīti tataś coktam ṛjur bhavān ||
pañcaṣaṣṭam adṛṣṭvā tu nikṣiptaṃ tatra dattakaḥ |
dattavān svayam ākṛṣya mahyam ātmīyam āsanam ||
te .pi nāgarakāḥ śeṣāḥ sthite tiṣṭhati dattake |
tiṣṭhanti sma sthitā eva bhṛtakā iva bhartari ||
sa tad adhyāsta śeṣāś ca yathāsanam upāviśan ||
tāsāṃ pratyekam ekaikā teṣāṃ pādān adhāvata ||
madīyas tu yayā pādaḥ pāṇibhyām avalambitaḥ |
praviśan dhautapādaś ca śṛṇomi sma prajalpitāḥ |
yadi rūpam upanyasyec chulkaṃ gṛhapatis tataḥ |
vīṇāyāṃ tu prayuktāyāṃ bhagno .yaṃ no manorathaḥ |
hyo yasmād bhūtikenāsya nāradīyaṃ kṛtaṃ kila ||
idaṃ tāvan mahad duḥkhaṃ yad yakṣīkāmuko .nayā |
idaṃ tu duḥsahataraṃ yad imāṃ bakulāvalīm |
anātmajño balāt ko .pi gale tāṃ lambayiṣyati ||
prajāpatiś ca durlagnaḥ sarvathā śivam astv iti ||

column436: Comm. on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti Comm. on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 3: 8 5 0

column3: tataḥ kañcukinā vaktraṃ kṣaṇād dīnatayā kṛtam |
pratyekaṃ ca mukhāny eṣām avalokya ciraṃ ciram |
sa yadā yātum ārabdhas tadāhūya mayoditaḥ ||
samāptapratikarmā vā kalyā vā yadi sā tataḥ |
āgacchatu kim adyāpi dṛṣṭair nāgarakair iti ||
avagrahe hi jīmūto visphūrjann api śobhate ||
tad evaṃ yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ yādṛśī cātidhīratā |
tādṛśaṃ yadi vijñānaṃ bhavet kiṃ na bhaved iti ||
ko hi vedajaḍaṃ muktvā chāndasaṃ chāttram atrapam |
kva ca priyaguṇā yakṣī guṇarddhiḥ kva cedṛśaḥ ||
yat kiṃcid api bālānāṃ cetastoṣāya kalpate |
utkaṭena hi nāmnāpi prāyas tuṣyanti ḍiṇḍikāḥ ||
śrutvedam itareṇoktaṃ mā sma nindad bhavān imam |
yathā paricitaśrīkas tathā māṃ prati śobhate ||
tato javanikāṃ prerya kanyā kañcukibhir vṛtā |
kathayāmi kathaṃ rūpaṃ tasyāḥ saṃkṣiptam ucyate |
āste gandharvadatteyam iyaṃ vīṇā ca sāritā |
yo vo vādayituṃ śaktaḥ sa kiṃ tiṣṭhati ḍhaukatām ||
aśeṣair na ca kartavyā paripāṭir apārthikā |
sā hi yuṣmākam asyāś ca lajjākhedaprayojanā ||
tataḥ svayaṃ bhavadbhiś ca yasmin vo bhāvanāhitā |
yuṣmān ātmānam etāṃ ca sa kleśān mocayatv iti ||
tvaṃ naḥ pūjyaḥ pravīṇaś ca tasmād utthīyatām iti ||
sa yadā kampitaśirā necchati sma tadāparaḥ |
sampādayati śabdo .bhūd uccakaiḥ sādhu sādhv iti ||
krāmantaṃ gaganaṃ vegāt triś cakāra pradakṣiṇam ||
tena ca svayam utpādya stuvatā garuḍadhvajam |
iti kramāgataṃ tātas tātād āgamitaṃ mayā ||
svargān nānyatra gāndhāra ity āhur nāradādayaḥ ||
tena yo .yaṃ na jānāti na ced abhyupagacchati |
tad asaṃpādayann eva jāyate doṣavān asau ||
ahaṃ punar idaṃ jānan sadyaḥ pariṇamatphalam |
tatas tam uktavān asmi kim idaṃ na tvayā śrutam |
pathā sakṛt pravṛttāyāḥ kiṃ karoty avaguṇṭhanam ||
tad asyā baṭuvidyāyāḥ prāntam aprāpya mādṛśaḥ |
hā kaṣṭaṃ vañcito .smīti paścāt tāpena khedyate ||
yatra cāmī na lajjante salajjāḥ suhṛdas tava |
aho sāhasam ity uktvā tūṣṇīṃbhāvam upeyivān ||
aham apy āsanaṃ tyaktvā tiryak paśyati dattake |
mām ālokya tathābhūtam uktaṃ nāgarakair iti ||
karaśākhāś ca no jātā na ca saṃbhāvanedṛśī ||
ayaṃ tu komalāgrābhis tantrīr aṅgulibhiḥ spṛśan |
īdṛśī tādṛśī dṛṣṭā rūpiṇī yuvatir mayā ||
kiṃ tat satyaṃ mṛṣety etad devair vijñāyatām iti ||
udveṣṭite ca tat tasmin dṛṣṭaṃ veṣṭanacarmaṇi |
atha gandharvadattāyā jātam aṅgaṃ nirīkṣya mām |
mayā tu dhautapādena vīṇāṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām |
tathā ca dhṛṣṭam ādiṣṭā bālāśālīnatāṃ gatā ||
tad eva gītakaṃ divyam ahaṃ mandam avādayam ||
vṛttibhir dakṣiṇādyābhis tad gītaṃ gītakaṃ tayā |
upary upari pāṇyantaiḥ pāṇibhir yojitaṃ mayā ||
bho bho nirmatsarāḥ santaḥ satyam ākhyāta sādhavaḥ |
gītaṃ yad anayānena kiṃ tat saṃvāditaṃ na hi ||
parīkṣya bahuśo rājñā sacivo guṇavān iva ||
vayaṃ gandharvadattā ca sānudāsaś ca sānugaḥ |

column4: kāśmaryaḥ khadirāḥ śākāś campakāś ca saveṇavaḥ |

column3: āsīc ca mama kiṃ mattaḥ kim unmattaḥ kim ārjavaḥ |
ayaṃ yasmād asaṃbaddham abuddhir iva bhāṣate ||
ahaṃ ceyaṃ ca yady asya brāhmaṇāv iti niścayaḥ |
tato mat katham utkṛṣṭā brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇād iyam ||
atha imāṃ brāhmaṇīm eṣa manyate kṣatriyaṃ tu mām |
tathā sati kathāpy eṣā kriyamāṇā virudhyate ||
kiṃ tu saṃbhāvyate nāyam asaṃbaddhaṃ prabhāṣitum |
te ca svā caiva nṛpater ity uktaṃ manunā yataḥ ||
pratyākhyānaṃ ca nitarām iyaṃ nārhati ninditam |
yad ahaṃ grāhitas tena vijñānam atimānuṣam |
dāpitā yena tenaiva tena tenaiva dāpitā ||

column3: yūyaṃ vijñāpitāḥ pūrvaṃ tad etad avadhīyatām ||
nāmitro nāpi madhyasthaḥ sādhor yasyābhavad bhuvi ||
tasya mitravatī nāma nāmnā susadṛśī priyā |
bhāryā maitrīva sādhor yā śatror api hitaiṣiṇī ||
aputrān ātmanaḥ paurāḥ saputrān api menire ||
daṃpatibhyām asau tābhyāṃ krītābhyāṃ prīṇitas tathā |
yaś ca putras tayor jātas tasya nāmākarot pitā |
ādiṣṭaḥ sānunā yat tat sānudāso bhavatv iti ||
ekaputro .py asau pitrā durlabhatvāc ca vallabhaḥ |
upādhyāyaiś ca sotsāhair vinītaḥ sa tathā yathā |
pitarau suhṛdo dārā na kaścin nākulīkṛtaḥ ||
ādiṣṭaḥ sānunā yo .sau tayoḥ putraḥ suvṛttayoḥ |
aham eva sa vo dāsaḥ sānudāsas tathāguṇaḥ ||
mama tu dhruvako nāma dhruvamaitrīsukhaḥ sakhā |
sa ca mām abravīn mitra kriyatāṃ tad bravīmi yat ||
bhavatāpi sadāreṇa tatra gatvā mayā saha |
dharmārthayoḥ phalaṃ yena sukham eva nirākṛtam |
tyaktadṛṣṭasukhaḥ so .pi vada ko nāma paṇḍitaḥ ||
na cāpi svārthasiddhyarthaṃ mayā tvaṃ vipralabhyase |
tathā hi bhīmasenasya vākyam ākarṇyatāṃ yathā ||
mayā tu sa vihasyoktas tuccha eva prayojane |
idaṃ saṃrambhagāmbhīryaṃ śaṅkām iva karoti saḥ ||
yadi pītaṃ na vā pītaṃ svadārasahitair madhu |
lābhaḥ kas tatra hānir vā rāgo .yam abhivāsitaḥ ||
tam indhayati yan mitra tatra kiṃ nāma pauruṣam ||
phalaṃ yadi ca dharmasya sukham īdṛśam iṣyate |

column57: tāni tānyabhivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ||

column3: yāṃ yathāsukham āsīnām aśnantīṃ ca striyaṃ prati |
nekṣyate pratiṣedhāt sā katham evaṃ viḍambyate ||
athavā gacchatu bhavān yathāsukham ahaṃ punaḥ |
na yāsyāmi na dhāsyāmi dāraiḥ saha sabhām iti ||
sa tataḥ sthirasaṃkalpaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā pratyavasthitam |
suhṛdām agrataḥ kṛtvā pratijñām aham āgataḥ |
tat prasīdāsatāṃ nāma dārā yadi virudhyate |
sadoṣaṃ yadi pānaṃ ca svayaṃ mā sma pibas tataḥ |
tāṃ tadā dṛṣṭavān asmi sakalatrāṃ suhṛtsabhām ||
kalpitaṃ dhruvako mahyam uccam āharad āsanam ||
utthitaḥ puruṣaḥ ko .pi sarasaḥ sarasas tataḥ ||
bhoḥ puṣkaramadhu prāptaṃ mayeti ca mudāvadat ||
pratiṣiddhaḥ sa caikena mūrkha mā caṇḍam āraṭīḥ |
yadi tāvad idaṃ sarve pibanti suhṛdas tataḥ |
dīyate yadi vā rājñe durlabhaṃ pārthivair api |
aparaṃ so .pi yāceta ratnagṛddhā hi pārthivāḥ ||
taṃ ca karṇejapāḥ kecid vakṣyanti priyavādinaḥ |
rājann aparam apy asti tatra prāptam idaṃ yataḥ ||
etāvad eva tatrāsīn nātiriktam iti bruvan |
iti protsāhitaḥ pāpair labdhāsvādaś ca pārthivaḥ |
haret sarvasvam asmākaṃ tasmāt tasmai na dīyate ||
kiṃtu rasyatarāsvādaṃ na ca madyaṃ yatas tataḥ |
idaṃ puṣkaramadhv eṣa sānudāsaḥ pibatv iti ||
na ca madyam iti śrutvā pītavān asmi tan madhu ||
āsīc ca mama ko nāma ṣaṇṇām eṣa raso bhavet |
lakṣyate na hi sādṛśyam etasya madhurādibhiḥ ||
na cāhaṃ ṣaḍbhir ārabdhaḥ saṃhatya madhurādibhiḥ |
sarvajñair api durjñānā yenāsminn ekaśo rasāḥ ||
tena manyata evāyaṃ saptamaḥ suraso rasaḥ |
rasite .mṛtam apy asmin gacched virasatām iti ||
bādhate māṃ pipāseti śanair dhruvakam abruvam ||
tena dattaṃ tu tat pītvā svabhāvāpoḍhamānasaḥ |
tat puropavanaṃ vegāc cakravad bhramad abhramam ||
atha gatvā tam uddeśam apaśyaṃ mādhavīgṛhe |
tatas tām abravaṃ sāmnā bhadre yadi na duṣyati |
duḥkhasyāsya tato hetur mahyam ākhyāyatām iti ||
duḥsahasyāsya duḥkhasya nanu hetur bhavān iti ||
yadīdaṃ matkṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhīru mā tvaṃ rudas tataḥ ||
yad anantam anantārghaṃ tan manye draviṇaṃ tṛṇam |
śarīrakam apīdaṃ me kvacid vyāpāryatām iti ||
tad ehi gṛham asmākaṃ satyaṃ mantrayase yadi |
śarīrasyāsya te tatra viniyogo bhavatv iti ||
kṛṣyamāṇas tayā cāhaṃ pāṇāv ādāya mantharam |
sā mām arghyeṇa saṃbhāvya mūrdhni cāghrāya sādaram |
tat puṣkaramadhu svādu śīghram ānīyatām iti ||
mama tv āsīd dhruvaṃ yakṣī gaṅgadattānyathā kutaḥ |
gṛhe puṣkaramadhv asyā duṣprāpaṃ mānuṣair iti ||
pītvā ca puṣkaramadhu prītayā sahitas tayā |
āsīn me yan mayā dattvā śarīraṃ puṇyam arjitam |
iti tatra ciraṃ sthitvā pṛcchāmi sma priyāṃ priye |
kim idānīṃ suhṛdgoṣṭhī karītīty atha sābravīt ||
yadi te draṣṭum icchāsti mayaiva sahitas tataḥ |
mayālambitahastaṃ tvāṃ na kaścid api paśyati |
na dṛśyate sānudāsaḥ kva nu yāto bhaved iti ||
apareṇoktam āścaryam adṛṣṭaṃ kiṃ na paśyasi |
gaṅgadattām athāvocam adṛśyo yady ahaṃ tataḥ |
bhadre katham anenoktam adṛśyo dṛśyatām iti ||
mām avocad adṛśyāya yakṣībhartre namo .stu te ||
drākṣāmadhu tvayā pītaṃ sādhitā ca vilāsinī ||
sa bhavān gaṅgadattāyā gṛhaṃ yātu nirāmayaḥ |
ahaṃ tu puṣkaramadhu chadmanā chalito .pi taiḥ |
āsīc ca mama te dhīrā ye svabhyastamadhupriyāḥ |
na prāṇimi vinā tasmād dhiṅ nikṛṣṭaṃ ca mām iti ||
atha gacchati sma ravir astabhūdharaṃ vasitadrumān adhi śakuntapaṅktayaḥ |
madamandam ātmabhavanāni nāgarāḥ priyayā sahāham api tanniveśanam ||
tatra prasannayā kālaṃ priyayā ca prasannayā |
kadācic cāham āhūya nīto dārikayā gṛham |
guruṇā guruśokena pīḍyamānaṃ ca māṃ nṛpaḥ |
sa hīha paraloke ca sukhāya prāṇinām iti ||
pitryaṃ śreṣṭhipadaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ yāhīty abhāṣata ||
mayā tūktam idānīṃ me bālakālaś calo gataḥ |
durācāraiva sā veśyā ciraṃ yasyāḥ satīvratam |
na hi vedam adhīyānaḥ śūdraḥ sadbhiḥ praśasyate ||
sadoṣam api na tyājyaṃ sahajaṃ karma sādhubhiḥ |
itīdaṃ vacanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sāpi saṃmānayatv iti ||
ayam āgata evāsi tyaja niṣṭhuratām iti ||
atha sā madviyogena madduḥkhena ca karśitā |
mama tv āsīt prapañco .yaṃ viṣamaḥ prastuto .nayā |
nūnam asmān iyaṃ vṛddhā mugdhān ākṛṣṭum icchati ||
īdṛśī ca vacodakṣā sadākṣiṇyaś ca mādṛśaḥ |
nirdākṣiṇyā ca devī śrīr iti jāto .smi śaṅkitaḥ ||
avaśyaṃ ca madīyā śrīr gaṅgadattāṃ gamiṣyati |
dānaṃ hi tatra dātavyaṃ yatra cittaṃ prasīdati ||
na vartate sakṛt pātum atas triḥ pīyatām iti |
yathā yathā ca māṃ mandam ārohan madirāmadaḥ |
tadīyāś ca madīyāś ca gataśokam avekṣya mām |
gāyanti sma hasanti sma kecit tatrārudann api ||
iti vismāritas tābhiḥ pitṛśokam ahaṃ tadā |
śvaśrūs tvām āha rūkṣo .si gātram abhyajyatāṃ tava ||
tasmād iyam api sneham aṅgeṣu nidadhātv iti ||
skandhaḥ kaṭukatailena mrakṣitaś ca tayā mama ||
uktaś cāsmi punar yāvad dārikāyā muhūrtakam |
abhyaṅgaḥ kriyate tāvad bhavān avataratv iti ||
sasaṃbhramaiś ca tair uktaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭair aham |
sarvajñānām api trāsāt prasaranti na pāṇayaḥ ||
tasmād avataratv asmād dīrghāyuḥ pañcamaṃ puram |

column3: śrūyate sma ca tasyaiva prāsādasyopari dhvaniḥ |
bandinaḥ paṭhataḥ ślokam uccakair uccarann iti ||
jaya rājasiṃha paradantimaṇḍalaṃ vijitaiva vādimṛgasaṃhatis tvayā |
cintitaṃ ca mayā manye praviṣṭaḥ ko .pyayaṃ viṭaḥ |
ya eva māṃ suhṛt kaścid apaśyat saṃmukhāgatam |
sa evāmīlayad dṛṣṭiṃ hā kiṃ dṛṣṭam iti bruvan ||
tena ca praviśann eva pūrvābhyāsād aśaṅkitaḥ |
bhadra sarvaṃ na jānāmi tat tvam ākhyāyatām iti ||
tenoktam īdṛśaṃ tattvaṃ na tvaṃ paragṛhaṃ punaḥ |
mayoktam atha sāsūyaṃ kiṃ ca mitravatī mṛtā |
tenoktaṃ kaccid āyuṣmān sānudāso bhavān iti ||
lajjamānaḥ sthitas tūṣṇīm atha tenoditaṃ punaḥ ||
jīvaty eva mṛtā tāta mātā mitravatī tava |
spṛhayaty anapatyābhyo yā strībhyaḥ putravaty api ||
gṛhaṃ vikrīya niḥsāram anāthā jananī tava |
saha pautreṇa vadhvā ca kutrāpy anyatra tiṣṭhati ||
āste mitravatī yatra tad ayaṃ pṛcchyatām iti ||
sa ca gatvā mayā dṛṣṭaḥ pratyabhijñāya māṃ cirāt |
hā kaṣṭam iti kṛtvoccair duḥkhaskhalitam abravīt ||
daridravāṭakaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ kutreti sa mayā punaḥ |
atha nimbataror mūle dattakaṃ nāma putrakam |
bālakānām ayaṃ rājā te .nye mantryādayaḥ kila |
dadāti sma tatas tebhyaḥ svāḥ sa kulmāṣapiṇḍikāḥ ||
yas tu teṣāṃ pratīhāraḥ sa rājāṃśaṃ prakalpitām |
sā tu niṣkramya saṃbhrāntā mām āliṅgya tathāvidham |
sadyaḥ putreṇa saṃyuktā svāminā ca vinākṛtā |
nilīnāṃ ca kuṭīkoṇe paśyāmi sma kuṭumbinīm |
alaṃ vā vistaraṃ kṛtvā mūrtām iva daridratām ||
snapayantyā ca māṃ bhagnā karmakaryā pramattayā |
śūnyam adya jagajjātam adya mātā mṛtā mama ||
mama mātur vivāhe tvaṃ labdhā jñātikulāt kila |
tena tvām anuśocāmi dvitīyāṃ jananīm iva ||
śrūyamāṇam api hy etad duḥkhāyaiva bhavādṛśām ||
so .haṃ katham api kṣiptvā varṣalakṣāyatāṃ kṣapām |
gṛham mayā praveṣṭavyaṃ na praveṣṭavyam anyathā ||
tayoktaṃ mā gamaḥ putra tvāṃ sadāraṃ sadārakam |
yaḥ śaktaḥ puruṣas tasya ślāghyam ekasya jīvitam ||
ambā dūram anuvrajya hitaṃ mahyam upādiśat |
tāmraliptīṃ vraje putra yatrāste mātulas tava ||
aho kaṣṭam idaṃ dṛṣṭam asmābhiś ceṣṭitaṃ vidheḥ |
kva sādhuḥ sānudāso .yaṃ kveyam etādṛśī daśā ||
māṃ cāvocan vayaṃ sarve bhavataḥ paricārakāḥ |
etasmād asahāyatvān mā sma śaṅkāṃ karor iti ||
atha māṃ ramayantas te ramaṇīyakathāḥ pathi |
te .pi plutair udāttaiś ca vyāhāraiḥ parito diśam |
sānudāsa kva yāsīti vyāharan māṃ sasaṃbhramāḥ ||
dhik pramādahatān asmān bhavatā chalitā vayam ||
bhavatā ca na saṃbhuktam etad asmād anarthakam ||
idānīm api yat kiṃcit tvayā tatropayujyatām |
anyathāsmābhir apy adya sthātavyaṃ kṣudhitair iti ||
tatas tadarthitaḥ kiṃcid bhakṣayitvā sahaiva taiḥ |
tatra māṃ rathyayāyāntaṃ kaścid dṛṣṭvā kuṭumbikaḥ |
śayanīye niṣaṇṇaṃ mām avocat sa kuṭumbikaḥ ||
tvadīyas tāta vṛttāntaḥ sarvaḥ saṃvidito mama |
ahaṃ siddhārthako nāma vaṇigbhṛtyaḥ pitus tava |
tena tvadīyam evedaṃ yat kiṃcid draviṇaṃ mama ||
mūlam etad upādāya vardhantāṃ te vibhūtayaḥ |
prātiṣṭhe saha sārthena tena siddhārthakena ca ||
khaṇḍacarmeti me nāma muṇḍāḥ pāśupatā vayam ||
na nayeyaṃ yadi svargaṃ gaccheyaṃ nirayaṃ tataḥ ||
taskarān yadi paśyāmas tatas tvāṃ devi caṇḍike |
tathā kathitavantas te tām ālokyaiva ḍiṇḍikāḥ |
taskaro .yam iti bhraṣṭaḥ sārthikād api dhāvataḥ |
tasya madhena gacchantaṃ māṃ pariṣvajya vṛddhikā |
vṛddhāṃ duḥkhitakām asvāṃ tyaktvā deśāntaraṃ gataḥ ||
mādṛśīṃ mātaraṃ dīnāṃ tyaktvā yad upacīyate |
mama tv āsīd aho kaṣṭam aparo .yam upadravaḥ |
manye mūrtimatī kāpi vipattir iyam āgatā ||
atha māṃ ciram īkṣitvā tayoktaṃ lajjamānayā |
athavā putra evāsi mamety uktvānayad gṛham |
campāyāṃ sānudāsasya gṛham amba vrajer iti ||
śrāntaśrāntaś ca viśrāntaḥ pṛṣṭvā panthānam antare |
bhoḥ sādho gaṅgadattasya gṛham ākhyāyatām iti |
yaṃ yam eva sma pṛcchāmi sa sa evaivam abravīt ||
tāmraliptyāṃ pure bhrāntas tvatto dhūrtataro janaḥ |
iti saṃpṛcchamānāya yadā mahyaṃ na kaścana |
ācaṣṭe sma tadā khinnaḥ sann upāviśam āpaṇe ||
tatra māṃ pṛṣṭavān eko vaṇik pāṇḍaramastakaḥ |
udvigna iva vicchāyaḥ kiṃnimittaṃ bhavān iti ||
gṛhaṃ hi gaṅgadattasya na pṛcchanti yathāsthitāḥ ||
na sa jānāti dhūrto vā gaṅgadattasya mandiram ||
pravṛddhāṃś ca viśuddhā:mśu gaṅgadattasya tad gṛham ||
athavā gaccha mugdheti mām uktvā svayam eva saḥ |
gaṅgāyāṃ gaṅgadattena pitre dattaṃ jalaṃ mama ||
bhāgineyārthaye yat tvāṃ tad anuṣṭhātum arhasi ||
yad anantam akupyaṃ ca draviṇaṃ mama paśyasi |
svasmāt svasmāt tad ādāya pratijñātāc caturguṇam |
tasmiṃś ca kṣīṇa evānyā gantrī te dravyasaṃhatiḥ |
akṣayaprabhavo hy asyā gaṅgāyā himavān iva ||
sve svasmin sati cānante lipsānyasmin vigarhitā |
sāre .rthe dṛḍhanirbandhaṃ mā māṃ vyāhata mātula ||
pravartyo gurubhiḥ kārye yatra bālo balād api |
svayam eva pravṛttas tair nivartyeta kathaṃ tataḥ ||
yac coktaṃ māmakair arthaiḥ kuṭumbaṃ jīvyatām iti |
mātulād dhanam ādāya yo jīvati samātṛkaḥ |
sthirasattvaṃ sa buddhvā mām ālāpair evamādibhiḥ |
palāyamānaṃ kaḥ śakto mriyamāṇaṃ ca rakṣitum |
tasmai ca kathayāmi sma prakṛṣṭān ātmano guṇān |
tṛṣṇādāsīvidheyā hi kiṃ na kurvanti pātakam ||
yuṣmābhiś ca sanāthatvam aham icchāmi sādhubhiḥ |
tvādṛṅnātho hy anātho .pi mukhyo nāthavatām iti ||
śraddadhāti sma duḥsādhyāṃ mayi sarvajñatām api ||
adhunā bhavatā tāta tataḥ prasthīyatām iti ||
mahārṇavanabhastalaṃ lavaṇasindhunauchadmanā viyatpatharathena tena vaṇijas tataḥ prasthitāḥ ||
kathaṃ vā na vimānaṃ tad yena mānasaraṃhasā |
viśīrṇabandhanaḥ potaḥ paṭṭaśaḥ sphuṭati sma saḥ ||
yasya keśeṣu jīmūtā iti gītām anusmaran |
daivāt phalakam ālambya prāpaṃ toyanidhes taṭam ||
kṣaṇaṃ viśramya tatrāhaṃ hā kiṃ vṛttam iti bruvan |
āsīc ca mama kāpy eṣā dānavī devatāpi vā |
na hi rūpaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ nāryāḥ kasyāścid īdṛśam ||
randhreṣu praharantīti yat tan mām idam āgatam ||
tasmād asmād ahaṃ deśāt palāye sabhayād iti |
prasthitaś cintayitvā ca sā ca mām ity abhāṣata ||
bhoḥ sādho mā bhavat te bhīr nāhaṃ naktaṃcarāṅganā |
āsīc ca mama divyeyam iti saṃprati niścitam |
yady eṣā rākṣasī tasmāt kva gataḥ syāṃ palāyitaḥ |
yadi tvaṃ mānuṣī satyaṃ darīdvārād itas tataḥ |
nirgatyātmānam ācakṣva divyā cet pāhi mām iti ||
atha hrīteva sā kiṃcin netre saṃmīlya sāśruṇī |
tataḥ saṃmīlite dṛṣṭvā tayā netre mamābhavat |
idaṃ vassveti tām uktvā tasyai tasyārdham akṣipam ||
bhadre kasyāsi kā veti tām apṛccham avāṅmukhaḥ ||
yā prakṛṣṭe .pi saubhāgye patiṃ devam ivārcati ||
tayoḥ sāgaradinnākhyaḥ putraḥ pitror guṇaiḥ samaḥ |
jyeṣṭhaḥ samudradinnaś ca tatsanāmā ca kanyakā ||
sutāya sānudāsāya sā ca pitrā pratiśrutā ||
sānudāsaś ca rūpeṇa smareṇa sadṛśaḥ kila |
sakalaṃ ca kalājālaṃ vedeti jagati śrutiḥ ||
athavā na kalājālaṃ jālaṃ veda sa kevalam |
ko hi nāma kalāśālī karma tādṛśam ācaret ||
tac ca vaiśasam ākarṇya sānudāsasya duḥśravam |
sāgarasya kuṭumbaṃ tat prasthitaṃ yavanīṃ prati ||
na tasyai nirdayenāpi sindhunā dattam antaram ||
sāgareṇa ca yā kanyā sānudāsāya kalpitā |
sāgareṇa nirastā ca mandabhāgyāham eva sā ||
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ kiṃ vṛttaṃ kiṃ nu vartate |
column5: kiṃ nu kāryaṃ kathaṃ kuryāṃ kva nu gacchāmi saṃjaya |

column3: prajñātaiḥ phalamūlaiś ca puṣṇāmi viphalāṃ tanum ||
mauktikasya guhākoṇe rāśiḥ prāṃśur mayā kṛtaḥ ||
mama tāvad iyaṃ vārttā tvadīyākhyāyatām iti |
iti pṛṣṭasya me cittam iti cittam abhūt tayā ||
sānudāso .ham eveti yady asyai kathayāmy aham |
anyad eva kim apy eṣā mayi saṃbhāvayiṣyati ||
saṃbhāvayatu nāmeyam ahaṃ punar imāṃ katham |
vipanmagnām upekṣeyaṃ puruṣaḥ san striyam satīm ||
api cedaṃ smarāmy eva tātapādair yathā vṛtā |
pitrā ceyaṃ pratijñātā tena vyarthā vicāraṇā ||
athetthaṃ kathayāmi sma campāyām abhavad vaṇik |
yasya mitravatī jāyā sānudāsaḥ sutas tayoḥ |
sa tābhyām ekaputratvāj jñāpitaḥ sakalāḥ kalāḥ ||
sānudāsaḥ sa evāhaṃ sarvasvaṃ me tayā hṛtam |
athāsminn antare sā māṃ bhāṣamāṇam abhāṣata |
kiṃcit pṛcchāmi yat tan me yūyam ākhyātum arhatha ||
prāsādāgre yad uktāḥ stha dāsyā tat kathyatām iti ||
abhyaṅgaḥ kriyate tasmād bhavān avataratv iti ||
kim uktāḥ śilpibhir yūyam iti pratyabruvaṃ tataḥ ||
tair ukto .haṃ pravīṇo .si tvatto lajjāmahe vayam |
tasmād asmāt purāt ṣaṣṭhāt pañcamaṃ gamyatām iti ||
ityādi yat tayā pṛṣṭaṃ vṛttaṃ vṛttaṃ mayākhilam |
tatas tāṃ pṛṣṭavān asmi bhīru kiṃ kriyatām iti |
sātha prasārayat svinnaṃ sphurantaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ karam ||
gambhīraṃ dhvanati tataḥ samudratūrye gāyatsu śrutimadhuraṃ śilīmukheṣu |
nṛtyatsu sphuṭaraṭiteṣu nīlakaṇṭheṣv ālambe karam ibhatālutāmram asyāḥ ||
sarvam ekapade naṣṭaṃ sādhāv apakṛtaṃ yathā ||
devam ātmabhuvaṃ dhyāntau jātau svaḥ kāmayoginau ||
tataḥ samudradinnā mām ity avocat kadācana |
divā prāṃśos taror agre prāṃśur ucchrīyatāṃ dhvajaḥ |
svadeśam ānayed āvāṃ dharmo .yaṃ vaṇijām iti ||
yuktam āheti nirdhārya tathaiva kṛtavān aham |
āptānām upadeśo hi pramāṇaṃ yoṣitām api ||
paśyāmi sma tataḥ sindhau bohitthaṃ sthiram asthire |
abhivādayamānaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā tena saspṛham |
kiṃ jātiḥ kasya putro .si kiṃ vā māteti sarvathā |
kiṃ tvayā tāta pṛṣṭena mitravarmasuto bhavān ||
kathaṃ punar amuṃ deśam āgato .sīti pṛcchate |
tenoktam asi dīrghāyur jāmātā tanayaś ca me |
ātmā sāgaradattaś ca mitravarmā ca me yataḥ ||
gaccha sāgaradattasya tanayāṃ tac ca mauktikam |
anyac cāsiddharātro .haṃ kiṃ ca potaṃ na paśyasi |
mamedaṃ vahanaṃ riktaṃ voḍhavyaṃ sāravat tava |
mūlyaṃ tasya ca yat tan nau samabhāgaṃ bhaviṣyati |
pūrvaṃ saṃmantritārghas tvaṃ dharmo .yaṃ vaṇijām iti ||
tac ca mauktikam ānīya potas tena prapūritaḥ |
tena dattāni vadatā vadhūs tvaṃ me suteti ca ||
preritaṃ yānapātraṃ ca tad vipannaṃ ca pūrvavat ||
tāś ca vijñāpayāmi sma parasmin mama janmani |
bhagavatyaḥ sadā bhaktam upatiṣṭhata mām iti ||
tasmai kruddhas taraṃgāya mahāmoham ahaṃ gataḥ |
cetaye yāvad ātmānaṃ loṭantam udadhes taṭe ||
mauktikaṃ gṛhyatāṃ nāma tat te svaṃ svaṃ mahodadhe |
sādho sādhvī vipadbandhuḥ priyā me mucyatām iti ||
yāś ca tāḥ śirasi nyastā muktāḥ pote nimajjati |
siraḥ kaṇḍūyamānena tāḥ spṛṣṭāḥ pāṇinā mayā ||
tat kiṃ parīkṣitaṃ tāsāṃ yā na dṛṣṭāḥ parīkṣakaiḥ ||
sa śokas tāsu dṛṣṭāsu yat satyam abhavat tanuḥ |
yad etad draviṇaṃ nāma prāṇā hy ete bahiścarāḥ ||
column9: yadetad draviṇaṃ nāma prāṇā hyete bahiścarāḥ |

column3: śāṭakānte ca tā buddhvā dṛḍhayā granthimālayā |
tatas tatra vasaty arthaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yāce sma kaṃcana |
dhanninuṃ colliditi ca bravīti sma hasan sa saḥ ||
jāmāteva cirāt prāptaḥ priyaḥ prītyāsmi satkṛtaḥ ||
deśo .yaṃ katamaḥ sādho katamad vātra pattanam ||
itaś ca pāṇḍyamathurā grāmān mṛduni yojane |
viśramya rajanīm atra prātar gantāsi tām iti ||
saṃkṣiptā ca nirastā ca yāpitā yāminī mayā ||
kvacit kaścit tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ prājño vāṇijadārakaḥ |
tatas taṃ pṛṣṭavān asmi sānudāsena kiṃ tava |
kasya vā sānudāso .sāv iti tenoditaṃ tataḥ ||
pānthaḥ kaścit kvacit satre pravṛttiṃ kathayed iti ||
tat te yadi sa dīrghāyur āyuṣmandarśanaṃ gataḥ |
ācakṣva nas tato dīnā janatā jīvyatām iti ||
mama tv āsīt pratijñāyāḥ kiyatsampāditaṃ mayā |
sānudāsaḥ punaḥ potam āruhya gatavān iti ||
tau taṃ vāṇijam abrūtāṃ ratnatattvavidā tvayā |
tenāpi tac ciraṃ dṛṣṭvā na jānāmīti bhāṣite |
tau māṃ niścalayā dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭavantam apṛcchatām ||
niścalasnigdhayā dṛṣṭyā suṣṭhu dṛṣṭam idaṃ tvayā |
manyāvahe vijānāti mūlyam asya bhavān iti ||
koṭir asya samaṃ mūlyaṃ ratnatattvavido viduḥ |
atha vikrāyakas toṣān muktāśrur mām avocata |
yadīyaṃ mūlyam etasya dhanaṃ dhanyās tato vayam ||
api bhūṣaṇam etan me koṭimūlyaṃ bhaved iti |
sadaiva me manasy āsīd ayam eva manorathaḥ ||
column5: mamāpi hi manasy āsīd ayam eva manorathaḥ ||

column3: api nāma labheyāham idaṃ koṭyeti cetasi ||
tatas tāv astuvātāṃ māṃ namas te viśvakarmaṇe |
ko hi mānuṣadurbodham idaṃ budhyate mānuṣaḥ ||
pṛthivī mūlyam asyeti kaścid āha parīkṣakaḥ |
ajānan kākinīty anyo na kiṃcid iti cāparaḥ ||
tvatkṛtena tu mūlyena janitaṃ nau mahatsukham |
etad ekārthayor āsīd abhīṣṭam ubhayor api ||
atha vārttām imāṃ śrutvā nṛpeṇāhūya sādaram |
viśālaṃ bahuśālaṃ ca prītaḥ prādāt sa me gṛham ||
ataḥ param ahaṃ tasyām āsaṃ puri parīkṣakaḥ |
dharmeṇaiva ca māṃ kaścin na parīkṣām akārayat ||
evaṃ ca vasatas tatra mameyam abhavan matiḥ |
upalabhyas tato lokāt karpāso guṇavān iti |
dhik karpāsakathāṃ tucchāṃ sarvathā mūṣakeṇa te |
mathurāyāṃ ca maryādā gṛhaṃ yasya pradīpyate |
prakṣipyate sa tatraiva sakuṭumbo raṭann iti ||
atha hastadvitīyo .ham iyaṃ dig iti saṃbhraman |
dhāvitvā ca triyāmārdham aharardhaṃ ca raṃhasā |
āsīc ca mama hā kaṣṭaṃ hanta naṣṭo .smi saṃprati |
jvalati jvalane kṣipto nirghṛṇair draviḍair iti ||
hā mātar jīvito .smīti tān ālokyāśvasaṃ tataḥ |
rakṣomukto hi nāśvasyāt ko vā dṛṣṭvā narān naraḥ ||
āgacchati kuto deśān nagarād vā bhavān iti |
column5: āgacchati kuto deśāt kaṃ vā yāti bhavān iti ||

column3: atha taiḥ saspṛhaiḥ pṛṣṭaṃ mathurāyāṃ tvayā yadi |
sānudāso vaṇigdṛṣṭas tato naḥ kathyatām iti ||
mayoktaṃ sānudāsākhyo vaṇik tatra na vidyate |
bhavantaḥ katamat tatra pṛcchantīty ucyatām iti ||
tatas te kathayanti sma tāmraliptyāṃ vaṇikpatiḥ |
gaṅgadatto guṇān yasya na na veda bhavān api ||
ye guṇān na vidus tasya sadvīpāt prāṅmahodadheḥ |
vyāpinyā kīrtitān kīrtyā na jātās te .thavā mṛtāḥ ||
gaṅgadattas tu pānthebhyaḥ pravṛttim upalabhya tām |
āhūyāha sma suhṛdaḥ prītāṃś ca paricārakān ||
ye me śoṇitam āyānti gṛhītvā dakṣiṇāpathāt |
tān ahaṃ suhṛdaḥ sphītais toṣayāmi dhanair iti ||
tad vayaṃ gaṅgadattena tam ānetuṃ visarjitāḥ |
yadi cāsau tvayā dṛṣṭas tad ācaṣṭāṃ bhavān iti ||
mama tv āsīd varaṃ kṣiptas tatraivāhaṃ vibhāvasau |
na tv apūrṇapratijñena mātur ānanam īkṣitum ||
karpāse jvalati kṣiptaḥ pāṇḍyair niṣkaruṇair iti ||
tatas tāḍitavakṣaskās tāram āraṭya te ciram |
campāyāṃ tāmraliptyāṃ ca jīvitavyaṃ na kenacit ||
stuvanto devatāḥ svāḥ svāḥ paryakrāman pradakṣiṇam ||
mama tv āsīd aho kaṣṭaṃ baddho .haṃ naraśambaraḥ |
sotsāhair api durlaṅghyaṃ jālaṃ jālmaiḥ prasāritam ||
athoccair āraṭāmi sma bho bho tyajata sāhasam |
sānudāsaḥ sa evāhaṃ vidheyo bhavatām iti ||
te stuvantas tato hṛṣṭāḥ sugataṃ saugatā iva |
tiṣṭhantu tāvad akalaṅkakuṭumbidārāḥ śītāṃśubhāsvadanilair api ye na dṛṣṭāḥ |
sindūrapāṭalitakhaṇḍanaṭair naṭadbhir nagnāṭakair api narendrapatheṣu gītam ||
vidyāvṛttais tato viprair gaṅgadattaḥ svayaṃ ca mām |
madhurair upapannaiś ca vacanair ity abodhayat ||
pitā me dhriyate bhartā bhṛtyān āttena kiṃ mama |
avaśyabharaṇīyaiś ca rakṣyaiś ca paravān bhavān ||
asārathāv iva rathe dhruvaṃ yan na bravīmi tat ||
svakuṭumbam anukaṇṭhaṃ kuru yāhi gṛhān iti ||
ekadā kaṃcid adrākṣam āceraṃ nāma vāṇijam |
tair gatvā saha potena kaṃcid adhvānam ambudheḥ |
ity asmān anuśāsti sma sārthavāhaḥ kṣapākṣaye ||
latām anīdṛśīṃ mohād yaḥ kaścid avalambate |
pramīto himavaty asmin sa prayāti parāṃ gatim ||
vayam evācalāgraṃ tad āruhya paridevya ca |
nirupya ca jalaṃ tasmai tatraivāneṣmahi kṣapām ||
mā mā spṛkṣata vāry etad bho bho tiṣṭhata tiṣṭhata ||
mūḍhaiḥ spṛṣṭam idaṃ yair yais te te pāṣāṇatāṃ gatāḥ |
atha vā svayam evaināṃ suhṛdaḥ kiṃ na paśyatha ||
vaṃśān paśyatha yān asyāḥ parasmin saritas taṭe |
eṣām anyatamaṃ gāḍhaṃ gṛhṇīdhvaṃ maskaraṃ karaiḥ ||
vāte mantharatāṃ yāte maskarāt tuṅgatāṃ gatāt |
teṣām ekaṃ kṛśād vaṃśād viśīrṇād apatat tataḥ |
śilābhūtāṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā gatiṃ māheśvarīm agāt ||
avatīrya tu vaṃśebhyas tyaktvā dūreṇa tāṃ nadīm |
tasmai salilam anyasya amadāma nyavasāma ca ||
chāgān vikretum āyānti kirātāḥ parito diśaḥ ||

column3: kaccic ca skhalitas tasyāḥ khastaḥ śaṃkaram asmaram ||
kuṭṭitaṃ tat tayoś carma jātaṃ tita:ujarjaram ||
snātas tarpitadevaś ca paścād amṛtam āharam ||
tattaṭe kṣaṇam āsitvā niṣadya ca gataśramaḥ |
apuṣpaḥ phalahīno vā yatraiko .pi na pādapaḥ ||
kasyāpi caraṇaiḥ kṣuṇṇām adrākṣaṃ padavīm iva ||
tayā saṃcaramāṇaś ca mantharaṃ dūram antaram |
mama tv āsīt tato nāma divyaṃ cakṣus tapasvinām |
yan me yādṛcchikaṃ nāma yac ca vyāpārahetukam |
tat kīrtitam anenādya na kadācid api śrutam ||
tvayā yac cintitaṃ tāta tataḥ prati tathaiva tat |
nāmamātrakathā nāti citraṃ hi tapasaḥ phalam ||
dhruvakādyair yathā madyam upāyaiḥ pāyito bhavān |
vimuktas tvam iha prāptaḥ sarvaṃ tad viditaṃ mama ||
yadarthaṃ cāyam āyāsaḥ prāptaḥ kṛcchratamas tvayā |
mitravaty eva tat sarvaṃ mātā te kathayiṣyati ||
tac ca samprāptadeśīyam ato mā viṣadad bhavān ||
vāneyam āharann annaṃ kṛṣṭapacyam ahaṃ dviṣan ||
suvarṇaprāptaye prāptā yā vipat saṃpad eva sā ||
ekadā taṃ mahātmānam abhitaḥ prāptam ambarāt |
tatas tāḥ samparikramya praṇamya ca yatiprabhum |
ekā tu na gatā tāsām aṅkam āropya tāṃ muniḥ |
sā kadācin mayā pṛṣṭā ko .yaṃ kā vā tvam ity atha |
śrūyatām iti bhāṣitvā tayor vṛttam avartayat ||
atiśeṣe tvam ity eṣā pratītiḥ piṣṭapatraye ||
bharadvājam ato gatvā tvam ārādhaya sundari |
yadā nāśakad ākraṣṭum abdair bahutithair api |
toṣito .yam avocat tāṃ varaḥ kas te bhavatv iti ||
tan me bhagavatā dhairyāt saubhāgyaṃ durbhagīkṛtam ||
tena vijñāpayāmy etat prītaś ced dayase varam |
jagato .pi varas tasmād bhavān evāstu no varaḥ ||
vaśitvād rāgam ālambya saubhāgyaṃ me dadātv iti ||
anurodhāc ca tenāsyām ekaiva janitā sutā |
ciram ārādhito bhaktyā virakto .pi hi rajyate ||
sā tu suprabhayā nītvā pitryaṃ viśvāvasoḥ puram |
vardhitā ca vinītā ca vidyāsu ca kalāsu ca ||
atha gandharvarājas tām ānīya duhituḥ sutām |
astu gandharvadatteyaṃ mahyaṃ dattā yatas tvayā |
iti tasyāḥ kṛtaṃ nāma bharadvājena sārthakam ||
suprabhāyāṃ tu yā kanyā bharadvājād ajāyata |
nāmnā gandharvadatteti vitta mām eva tām iti ||
mama tv āsīd ayaṃ śailo hiraṇmayaśilaḥ sphuṭam |
tās tu prātaḥ śilā dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭo gandharvadattayā |
kim etad iti tasyai ca yathāvṛttaṃ nyavedayam ||
tayā tu kathitaṃ pitre mām āhūya sa cāvadat |
āyuṣman na hiraṇmayyaḥ śilā eva hi tāḥ śilāḥ ||
dṛṣṭavān asi sauvarṇās tatsaṃparkād imāḥ śilāḥ |
aham eva suvarṇaṃ ca campāṃ pratigamaṃ ca te |
yāś ca tās tuṣṭatuṣṭena muhūrtenāhṛtāḥ śilāḥ |
ekadā kacchapīṃ vīṇāṃ mahyaṃ dattvāvadat muniḥ |
yad bravīmi tad ākarṇya tvam anuṣṭhātum arhasi ||
sa tathaiva yatas tasmād asmākam iyam ātmajā ||
na hi sāgarajanmā śrīḥ śrīpater anyam arhati ||
tena campām iyaṃ nītvā deyā te cakravartine |
cihnair yaiś ca sa vijñeyaḥ kriyantāṃ tāni cetasi ||
ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe bhavān māse gandharvān saṃnipātayet |
puras teṣām iyaṃ gāyād geyaṃ nārāyaṇastutim ||
yas tu saṃvādayet kaścid gandharvas teṣu vīṇayā |
vādayet tac ca yas tasmai dadyāḥ svatanayām iti ||
sarvathā bhavatāṃ yad yad vṛttaṃ gandharvasaṃsadi |
athāvāṃ munir āha sma khinnau sthaḥ putrakau ciram |
khedocchedāya tac campāṃ pratiṣṭhethāṃ yuvām iti ||
tatas taṃ praṇipatyāhaṃ calitaḥ pracalo mudā |

column3: svapne .pi na narair dṛṣṭā samṛddhiḥ kaiścid apy asau ||
bhāradvājīm athāpṛcchaṃ mātaḥ kim idam adbhutam |
gandharvanagaraṃ māyā svapno vāyaṃ bhaved iti ||
kadā paśyāmi jananīm iti cākulatāṃ tyaja |
sārthasthānād itaś campā nanu krośeṣu pañcasu ||
sa ca me svapnam āyādiviṣayaḥ saṃśayas tayā |
tam utthāyātha paryaṅkāt parirabhya ca sādaram |
amṛtaiva janaḥ kaścic cirāt kaścid udaśvasat ||
yaiś ca gomayapānīyaṃ kṣiptaṃ mama puraḥsarāḥ |
draṣṭuṃ śaknoti yas tasya kṣudrakān dhig asūn iti ||
tatas tena vihasyoktaṃ kva devī kva daridratā |
tad eva bhavanaṃ devyāḥ samṛddhiḥ saiva cācalā |
iti tat kṣaṇasaṃkṣiptaṃ kṣiptvā sakṣaṇadaṃ dinam |
gatvā narendram adrākṣaṃ surendram iva bhāsvaram ||
vandanāya tato dūrād dharaṇīm aham āśliṣam |
asāv api mudāhūya mām āśliṣad akaitavam ||
sāravadbhir anantaiś ca mām asau bhūṣaṇāmbaraiḥ |
paṭhadbhiś ca tato viprair ātmīyam agamaṃ gṛham ||
paurair harṣakṛtotsāhair na kṣuṇṇaḥ katham apy aham ||
ambām athārghajalapātrabhṛtaṃ nirīkṣya dūrād apāsarad asau janatā vihastā |
pūrṇād ivāndhatamasāni tuṣārakānter āryāt pṛthag janaśatāni hi saṃbhramanti ||
labdhāntaras tataḥ pādau śirasā mātur aspṛśam |
cirāc ca labdhaniśvāsā mām udasthāpayat tataḥ |
sphītaiḥ parijanaṃ ca svaṃ vibhavaiḥ samayojayam ||
vāṅmātreṇāpi yat satyaṃ na sā saṃmānitā mayā |
samudradinnayā sārdham anubhūtaṃ ca tatra yat |
mama tv āsīd varaṃ duḥkham anubhūtaṃ mahan mayā |

column3: mātaḥ kasyāsi kā veti sā ca nīcair avocata ||
tatas tasyāś cirābhyastaṃ pratyabhijñāya tad vacaḥ |

asty ahaṃ vahanād bhraṣṭā bhrāmyantī jaladhes taṭe |
yasmai dattāsmi yuṣmābhis tam adrākṣaṃ vipadgatam ||
jāyante hi supuṇyānām utsavā vyasaneṣv api ||
tathā yathā priyatamau nāsmaraṃ pitarāv api ||
prasthitau svaḥ svadeśāya vipannaḥ sa ca pūrvavat ||
sa ca vāṃ bhāginībhartā sākrandāyāḥ puro mama |
saṃpraty eva taraṃgeṇa gamitaḥ kvāpi vairiṇā ||
nabhasvajjavanair bhaṅgair bhaṅgurair āvṛtaḥ sa ca |
śīte śītalayiṣyāmi muñcataṃ māṃ yuvām iti ||
bhaviṣyati tathā bhūyaś citraṃ hi caritaṃ vidheḥ ||
tac ca muktāpravālādi gurumūlyaṃ yad āhṛtam |
vadhūḥ samudradinnā te gurusāraṃ ca taddhanam |
sarvam arpitam āvābhyāṃ tubhyaṃ tat parigṛhyatām ||
āgamiṣyati tad devi muñca kātaratām iti ||
ity uktvā sadhanaskandhāṃ nikṣipya bhāginīṃ mayi |
pitrā tulyo bhavatv eṣa śāpo nāśaṃsitas tava ||
tasmād dhanam idaṃ bhuñjan bhuñjānaś ca yathāgamam |
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca yātvānṛṇyaṃ bhavān iti ||
tac ca me gurugāmbhīryaṃ kvāpi nītam asūyayā |
eṣa strīpuruṣaḥ śocyo yo na strī na pumān iti ||
sa me keśakalāpāgram īṣad āmṛśya yātavān |
svayam eva ca tat tasya kapālam apatat karāt |
dhūmrachāyaḥ śanair jalpan dhig dhiṅ mām iti nirgataḥ ||
mama tv āsīd aho strīṇām atrāsamatrapaṃ manaḥ |

sā mām avocad bhīteva śītalībhavata kṣaṇam |
kiṃcid vijñāpayāmy eṣa yātu vaḥ krodhapāvakaḥ ||
bhūtavrataṃ ca nāmedaṃ bahuvidhnaṃ caraty ayam |

tuṣṭayā toṣitā gaurī mayā yūyaṃ ca roṣitāḥ ||

tathā nalinikāṃ nūnaṃ kartum icchasi mām iti ||

vasantam iva taṃ premṇā na kadācid amuñcatām ||
manoharaṃ muhuḥ paśyan svayaṃ dhūpam ayojayat ||
tatra tatra tatas tena paśyatā tat tad adbhutam |
citre nyastāpi sā tena citte nyastātirāgiṇā ||
nitambād ambaraṃ tasyāḥ sa kilākraṣṭum aihata ||
citrabhittim atha tyaktvā sāpi padmeva padminīm |
viṣṇor vakṣa iva śyāmam asevata nabhastalam ||

column3: asmān upacaranti sma surān iva surāṅganāḥ ||
sevamānā vayaṃ devaṃ devatām amṛtā gatāḥ ||
athaikā brāhmaṇī vṛddhā kimartham api nirgatā |
mā vocad dārakaṃ kaścit kva gato .bhūd bhavān iti ||
so .pi tasyāṅkam āropya harati sma vilakṣatām ||
svaṃ ca mandiram āgatya sa sumaṅgalam uktavān |
tasmād ādaram āsthāya śāstram adya prakāśyatām |
iti protsāhitas tena svārthena ca sumaṅgalaḥ |
tataḥ sa tādṛśo gandhas tathāyatnena sādhitaḥ |
tataḥ sasmitam ālokya bakulādīn uvāca sā |
rātrau rātrau sametānāṃ viyuktānāṃ divā divā |
iti saṃvatsaro yātas tābhis teṣām acetitaḥ ||
ekadā syandamānāśruḥ sākrandā sā tam abravīt |
svagṛhāya gamiṣyāmi tatra gacched bhavān iti ||
tvatsaṅgasubhagā yā dik tām api prekṣya jīvyate |
khaṃ paśyantam apaśyaṃs tam iyaṃ yātīti vādinam ||
kim astāne viṣādena potam āruhya māmakam |
dhyāyantas tatra tāḥ kāntāḥ paśyantaś cāntarāntarā |
tataḥ sa tena potena prasthitaś ca mahārṇavam |
sa ca potaḥ samīreṇa dūraṃ hṛtvā vipāditaḥ ||
rājaputras tu dayitāṃ siddhāṃ vidyām iva smaran |
tāṃ na cetitavān eva vipattiṃ māradāruṇām ||
veṣṭitaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ baddham udbaddhaṃ pādapeṣu ca ||
avatīrya ca hastinyāḥ sa rājānam avandata |
gāḍham āliṅgya tenāpi ciraṃ prītyā nirūpitaḥ ||
kutaḥ sumaṅgalād anyaś cakṣuṣmān iti bhūpatiḥ ||
āsīc ca rājaputrasya sa evāyaṃ sumaṅgalaḥ |
bhaved aham iva bhraṣṭaḥ potabhaṅgabhayād iti ||
gaccha viśramya tāteti rājñoktaḥ prāviśat puram |
apaśyan natamūrdhānaṃ sa tam eva sumaṅgalam ||
pṛcchati sma ca taṃ bhadra mitre prāṇasame tava |
bhujau me bakulāśokau kaccit kuśalināv iti ||
dṛṣṭam eva hi yuṣmābhir nṛpaś caiṣa puraṃdaraḥ ||
jayanta iti putro .sya śūraḥ cāruḥ kaviḥ paṭuḥ |
sutā nalinikā nāma nṛpates tasya tādṛśī |
yasyā na pramadāloke na cāsti sadṛśo varaḥ ||
varaṃ varayatā tasyāḥ pitrā dvīpāntarāṇy api |
anena ca prapañcena yadā kālo bahurgataḥ |
tadā mām ayam āhūya sadainyasmitam uktavān ||
nātho .pi bhava nas tāta saṃkaṭād uddharann itaḥ ||
kulaśīlavayorūpair yaḥ syād asyāḥ samo varaḥ |
yadā tu paṭuyatno .pi nālabhe varam īpsitam |
gataś ca kānanadvīpaṃ dṛṣṭavān asmi saṃcaran |
ātmāpi gandhaśāstrajñas tadā vaḥ śrāvito mayā ||
rañjayanti manaḥ kṣipraṃ guṇair api nirākṛtāḥ ||
suhṛdbhiḥ saha yuṣmābhir ahaṃ jijñāsitas tadā ||
dhūpaṃ tat phalake nyastām apaśyaṃ bhartṛdārikām ||
tām ālokya tato yuṣmān manye .haṃ dhanyajanmanām |
ātmano rājaputryāś ca vidhātuś ca kṛtārthatām ||
so .haṃ svārthaparo yuṣmān apahartum ito gataḥ |
tathāpi satkṛto yuṣmān hartum evāham udyataḥ |
idaṃ cāntaram āsādya mayā yūyaṃ tvarāvatā |
pradeśe yatra cāmbhodhir vipannaṃ vahanaṃ vahet |
vipannavahanas tatra na ca kaścana vidyate ||
tena tau bakulāśokāv avipannau gṛhān gatau |
idaṃ ca puram āyātā yathā yūyaṃ tathā vayam ||
na hi śrīḥ svayam āyāntī kālātikramam arhati ||
sumaṅgalena sā coktā mā sma śethāḥ pṛthaṅniśi |
patyus te dayitā yakṣī maivaṃ naiṣīd asāv iti ||
unnidraiva sanidreva suptā kila pṛthak kṣaṇam ||
yuṣmān api hared eṣā tathā mātaṅgakanyakā ||
manyadhve yādṛśīm enāṃ kanyakā neyam īdṛśī |
na me nalinikāvārttā virasāntā bhaved iti ||
ananyagatasaṃkalpam evaṃ māṃ mā sma kalpayaḥ |
iti jihmaṃ puras tasyāḥ kāmukācāram ācaram ||
gandharvadattāvacanāt priyatvaṃ mātaṅgakanyā sutarām agān me |
madaṃ vidhatte madirā prakṛtyā kim aṅga kāntānanasaṅgaramyā ||
rājamārge mayā dṛṣṭā vṛddhā strī bhāsvaraprabhā |
tava bhartre mayā dattā kanyājinavatīti mām ||
uktā sā ca mayā devi bhṛtyatvāt paravān aham |
dṛṣṭvā svāminam āyāmi tat kṣaṇaṃ kṣamyatām iti ||
sa mayoktas tayā sākaṃ hasantaḥ sukham āsmahe |
praṣṭavyāḥ santi cāsmākaṃ tāvat pṛcchāmi tān aham ||
anyac cāgamyatām etad gṛhaṃ yadi na duṣyati |
tataḥ prasthāpito gatvā pratyāgatya ca dattakaḥ |
kim atrodayano rājā praṣṭavyaḥ suhṛdā tava |
āha yat santi me kecit tāvat pṛcchāmi tān iti ||
ājñāpayati yac caiṣa mām ihāgamyatām iti |
athavā kim ahaṃ tasya samīpaṃ kim asau mama |
mama tv āsīd vidagdheyaṃ vṛddhā vipraśnikā dhruvam |
prāsādāt prāsravat toyaṃ sumeror iva nirjharaiḥ ||
anumāya ca taṃ pretaṃ mantragarbham upāgatam |
kvāpi māṃ netum icchantaṃ netum aicchaṃ yamālayam ||
bharadvājātmajā trastā mā sma nidrāṃ jahād iti |
na taṃ tatra nihanmi sma bhīṣaṇāraṭiśaṅkitaḥ ||
tatprabhāvāc ca nidrāndhāḥ suptā jāgarikāḥ kṣitau |
kakṣārakṣās tam adrākṣur na niryāntam acetanāḥ ||
niṣkrāntaś ca parāvṛtya kakṣādvāraṃ yad aikṣata |
gṛhād dūram atītaś ca jānubhyāṃ tam atāḍayam |
prahāraḥ sa tu me jāto jānupīḍāprayojanaḥ ||
yac ca kiṃcid ahaṃ draṣṭum aicchaṃ paṭukutūhalaḥ |
kulaputraḥ sa tatra sma kiṃcit kālaṃ na gacchati ||
apaśyaṃ dvīpināṃ kṛttīs tathedam abhavan mama ||
āstīrṇāni kimarthaṃ vā kenāpi viśikhāsv iti ||
apanītavitarkaś ca tair gataḥ stokam antaram |
prāsāde kvacid aśrauṣaṃ vacaḥ kasyāpi kāminaḥ ||
ayi candraka kiṃ śeṣe nanu bhrātar vibudhyatām |
ayaṃ naḥ sukhahetūnām agraṇīḥ suhṛdām iti ||

mayā tarkayatā cedaṃ viruddham iti niścitam |
