column3: sāham evaṃvidhā jātā vipralabdhā khalu tvayā |
kṛtaghna tvam apīdānīm avajānāsi mām iti ||
athāvocat patis tasyāḥ kiṃ māṃ indasi nandini |
mayāpi nanu yat prāptaṃ tvadarthaṃ tan na dṛśyate ||
kṛttaḥ śastreṇa saṃdhānād bandhanād iva pallavaḥ ||
pādo me yādṛśo jātas tādṛśaḥ kasya kathyatām ||
athavā yaḥ samudrasya tulayā tulayej jalam |
sa guṇān pāṇipādasya gaṇayen mandadhīr girā ||
sarvathā dhig adhīraṃ māṃ yas tvādṛśyāḥ striyaḥ puraḥ |
athānyatra śṛṇomi sma pādaḥ ślokasya śobhanaḥ |
āgatas taṃ likhāmy āśu datta me vartikām iti ||
mama tv āsīn na mām eṣa gataprāṇo jighāṃsati |
uttareṇa hi nīyante na dvāreṇa jighāṃsitum ||
cintayann iti niryātaḥ prākāraṃ samayā vrajan |
yadi jīvantam adrakṣyaṃ likhitvā maṇḍalaṃ tataḥ |
atrāsye maraṇād enam iṣṭvā krūragrahān iti ||
nāyam anyatamenāpi kena nāma mṛto bhavet ||
sukhasupteti cānena na sā strī pratibodhitā |
tena tadviṣam udgīrṇaṃ tena tad dūṣitaṃ jalam |
tena pītena mūḍho .yaṃ sadyaḥ prāṇair viyojitaḥ ||
amṛto yadi dṛṣṭaḥ syāj jīvitaḥ syād ayaṃ mayā |
kimartham anayā straiṇaṃ kṛtaṃ sāhasam ity aham |
parāmṛśya bahūn pakṣān idaṃ niścitavān dhiyā ||
iyaṃ pativratā yoṣin nūnaṃ bhartuś ca vallabhā |
na vimānitavān etāṃ patiḥ parihasann api ||
gāḍhaṃ tāḍitayā krūraṃ kṛtaṃ karmedam etayā ||
nāsti yas tānitasnehāl lālayaty eva kevalam ||
vasanābharaṇaṃ yac ca bhūtale svayam ujjhitam |
niścaurā cedṛśī campā yan merugurur apy ayam |
etāni cānyāni ca nāgarāṇāṃ paśyan vicitrāṇi viceṣṭitāni |
yātrāṃ yā gacchatā dṛṣṭā sā dṛṣṭā sthavirā mayā ||
taṃ ca pretam asau dṛṣṭvā sādhitādeśam āgatam |
mama tv āsīd aho kaṣṭā candramasyāpad āgatā |
sa tu māṃ śanakair muktvā bāhujaṅghaṃ prasārya ca |
śmaśānam āgato .smīti khedaṃ mā manaso gamaḥ ||
yatra rudraḥ surās tatra sarve haripuraḥsarāḥ |
na hy anyatra tuṣārāṃśur anyatrāsya marīcayaḥ ||
prāptāḥ pretavane siddhiṃ tasmān nedam amaṅgalam ||
yadarthaṃ tvaṃ mamānītas tad etat saṃniśāmyatām |
na hi niṣkāraṇaḥ khedas tvādṛśām upapadyate ||
ahaṃ dhanamatī nāma mantraśaktiś ca yā mama |
sā dineṣu gamiṣyatsu vijñātā bhavatā svayam ||
durlabhe bhavati strīṇāṃ dṛṣṭe tvādṛśi yādṛśī ||
yadā nākathayaj jñātā mantraśaktyā mayā tadā ||
dīrghāyuṣā yadā cāhaṃ paribhūtā tathā tvayā |
sādhayitvā tathā pretaṃ tvam ihānāyito mayā ||
sātha paścānmukhī sthitvā pautrīm ehīty abhāṣata |
varaṃ pāṇau gṛhāṇeti tām avocat pitāmahī ||
madīyaṃ ca tadīyena svinnaṃ svinnena pāṇinā |
atha mām avadad vṛddhā śvaśuro dṛśyatām iti |
tatas tām avadaṃ devi jano .yaṃ paravān iti ||
yāv etau pārśvayor asya bhujāv iva mahābalau ||
ārabhya ca tataḥ kālād gaurimuṇḍaḥ sahānujaḥ |
dviṣantam antaraṃ prāpya bhavantaṃ hantum icchati ||
tena mānasavegaś ca gaurimuṇḍādayaś ca te |
anantāś ca mahāntaś ca bhaviṣyantaś ca śatravaḥ ||
mama tv abhūd abhūn mitram eko .mitagatir mama |
sa tu nāsti pradeśo .sya yo vimānair anāvṛtaḥ ||
so .ham evam anantāni kāntimanti mahānti ca |
gacchāmi sma vimānāni paśyann āyānti yānti ca ||
kasminn api tato deśe kasyāpi śikhare gireḥ |
kasyām api diśi sphītam adṛśyata puraḥ puram ||
tasmāc codapatad bhāsvad vimānaṃ vyāpnuvan nabhaḥ |
āgamat puruṣas tasmāt prabhāva iva dehavān ||
aṅgair aṅgaṃ samāliṅgya snehārdraiḥ karkaśair api ||
jyogbhartar jaya deveti sa mām uktvedam abravīt ||
asmābhiḥ sevakaiḥ kāryam idaṃ yuṣmāsu bhartṛṣu |
āliṅganaṃ tu bhartṝṇāṃ bhṛtyaiḥ paribhavo mahān ||
mahatī devatā hy eṣā tvādṛgrūpeṇa tiṣṭhati ||
ityādi bahu tat tan māṃ yāvad eva vadaty asau |
tasya kiṃ varṇyate yatra viśālaṃ viśikhātalam |
tasya kiṃ varṇyate yasya māṇavāḥ smitimānasāḥ |
na stanyam api yāvante jananīr api bālakāḥ ||
tasya kiṃ varṇyate yatra paśupālasutair api |
tasya kiṃ varṇyate yatra yoginām eva kevalam |
prakṣayo na ca jāyante rathyāḥ prāsādasaṃkaṭāḥ ||
na cedaṃ caṇḍasiṃhasya puram ekaṃ praśasyate |
anyeṣām api siddhānām īdṛśāny adhikāny api ||
tasmin parijano divyaiḥ prakārair mām upācarat |
sā yadā tan niśāśeṣam uttaraṃ ca divāniśam |
nāgataiva tad āsīn me tvarāturamater matiḥ ||
samastair asamastaiś ca ramayanti priyāḥ priyān ||
kiraṇair indulekheva gataiva saha tair asau |
tat kim etat kathaṃ nv etad ityādi bahu cintayan |
āsīc ca mama campāyāḥ preto mām anayan niśi |
tad brāhmeṇa vivāhena sūnoḥ saṃskāram icchati ||
upāsya caturaḥ kaṣṭān pāvakān iva vāsarān |
tāṃ prāpaṃ kanyakām ante tapaḥsiddhim ivepsitām ||
tayā saha prāvṛṣamāsi ramyām aśuklapakṣāntaniśām ivaikām ||
anuyuktā mayā kaccin nṛpaḥ kuśalavān iti ||
svais tyaktaḥ sāparādhatvāt kiṃcit kālam ihāsthitaḥ ||
āsīnāṃ pitur utsaṅge dṛṣṭvā rājānam uktavān ||
duhitā tava yady eṣā tato mahyaṃ pradīyatām |
tenoktaṃ kena na jñātāḥ prasiddhā hi guṇās tava |
kiṃ tu komalajanmeyaṃ prauḍhā tāvad bhavatv iti ||
diṣṭyā vṛddhir bhavaty adya mameva bhavatām iti ||
yad dattvā tanayāṃ mahyam anyasmai dattavān iti ||
sutā vā vyavahāro vā yuddhaṃ vā dīyatām iti ||
athāha vihasan rājā na yuddhaṃ na mamātmajām |
labdhum arhati dīrghāyur vyavahāras tu dīyate ||
mayoktaṃ bhīru mā bhaiṣīḥ kiṃnarīkaṇṭhi mā rudaḥ |
megharājyā yathākhyātaṃ jitaḥ sa capalas tathā ||
mām ādāya tataḥ pāṇau sā gatvāmbaravartmanā |
abravīc ca nirutkaṇṭhaiḥ kṣaṇam ekam ihāsyatām |
yāvad emi sakhīṃ dṛṣṭvā vanditvā ca gurūn iti ||
tasyām utpatya yātāyām udyāne saṃcarann aham |
avatīrya tato vyomnaḥ sā priyā priyavādinī |
nirjitaḥ sa durātmeti hṛṣṭā mām apy aharṣayat ||
katham ity anuyuktā ca mayā sādaram abravīt |
kim etad iti pṛṣṭā sā saṃbhramotkarṇayā mayā |
column5: kim etad iti cāpṛcchat sā mām ujjvalasaṃbhramā |

column3: sakhī svāṃ dārikām āha yāhi vijñāyatām iti ||
vardhase devi diṣṭyeti mām uktvoktavatī punaḥ ||
bherīṃ tāḍitavān eṣa gatvā vikacikaḥ sabhām |
te tam āhur bhavān kasmād bherīṃ tāḍitavān iti |
āryaveṣaḥ sa tān āha puraḥ sthitvā nirāsanaḥ ||
anyasmin dattavān yatra nāgaraṃ pṛcchyatām iti ||
ucyatām iti coktena tātena kila saṃsadā |
megharājyā yad ākhyātaṃ tad evākhyātam āha ca ||
pṛcchyantāṃ te .pi teṣāṃ ced aviruddhā pramāṇatā ||
arthī vikacikaḥ kanyām anyāṃ mṛgayatām iti ||
tato vikacikaḥ kruddhaḥ jhaṭity utthāya saṃsadaḥ |
utpatya nabhasā gacchann uccair āha sabhāsadaḥ ||
dhik khalān khalu caṇḍālān pakṣapātahatāñ jaḍān |
aham eva hi kartavye kartavye buddhivān iti ||
āsīc ca mama yat satyam āśaṅkākaluṣaṃ manaḥ |
kasmin punar asau kārye kartavye buddhimān iti ||
sā tatas tān alaṃkārān dviṣatī kaṇṭakān iva |
aparāsv api bhāryāsu yuṣmābhir idam āhitam |
na hi dṛṣṭaṃ vinābhyāsāt kriyākauśalam īdṛśam ||
tasmān nirmālyatulyena na kāryam amunā mama |
kā hi durlabham ātmānaṃ kitavaiḥ paribhāvayet ||
mama tv āsīd apūrveyam asyā viṣamaśīlatā |
yadi vipratyayaḥ kaścid bhartāraṃ kiṃ na paśyasi ||
bhartrā te cāṭukāreṇa bhāryāṃ toṣayatā kila |
tat kṛtaṃ durvidagdhena yena bhāryaiva roṣitā ||
subhagaṃ karaṇaṃ yad yat samācarati durbhagaḥ |
mā ciraṃ putrakāḥ sthāta bhāryājñātigṛheṣv iti ||
asnigdhasmitayā hā hā kim etad iti bhāṣitam ||
ataḥ param ayukto .yaṃ prapañca iti tām aham |
paśyāmi sma tataḥ khasthaṃ taṃ vidyādharapāṃsanam |
te paśyata iyaṃ kāntā hriyate dhriyatām iti ||
kāko .pi hi nabhaścārī na ca muñcati nīcatām ||
yaḥ siṃhaśirasi nyasya kākaś caraṇam utpatet |
na tena paribhūtaḥ syāt kesarī dharaṇīcaraḥ ||
tvādṛśe mādṛśaḥ krudhyan kena pāpān na śocyatām ||
ity uktvā karuṇākrandāṃ tām asau khecarādhamaḥ |
bhuvaḥ śyena iva śyāmām ādāyodapatad divam ||
cirād ākarṇito dhīrād uccakair uccaran dhvaniḥ ||
he he kālākṣi kālākṣi gaṅge gaṅge mahīti ca |
vatsalānāṃ vivatsānāṃ rambhaś ca subhago gavām ||
gatvā ca tvarayāpaśyaṃ yāṣṭīkaṃ pālam agrataḥ |
tatas tam abravaṃ sāmnā satataṃ mahitaṃ gavām |
bhraṣṭaḥ panthā mamāṭavyāṃ tam ākhyātu bhavān iti ||
prage draṣṭā svapanthānaṃ tadeta svagṛhān iti ||
sa tādṛṅmalinaḥ strīṇāṃ yatra veṣo vibhūṣitaḥ ||
gopyas tu caturācārā naṭīr apy atiśerate ||
māṃ gopaḥ svagṛhaṃ nītvā gṛhiṇīm āhvayan mudā ||
devas te gṛham āyātaḥ sa bhaktyārādhyatām iti ||
na tāṃ vedhāḥ kṣamaḥ sraṣṭuṃ madhūcchiṣṭamayīm api ||
bhāvabhir vartamānaiś ca kavibhiḥ kim udāhṛtaiḥ |
na tāṃ varṇayituṃ śaktau vyāsavālmīkināv api ||
yaṃ yam evopasāraṃ sā tuccham apy ācaren mayi |
kalpayitvā tu me gopaḥ śayyāṃ valkalapallavaiḥ |
etat te gṛham ity uktvā aṃsabhāro vrajam avrajat ||
mama tv āsīd ayaṃ manye vītarāgādibandhanaḥ |
sakleśaḥ ko nu viśvasyād dāreṣu ca pareṣu ca ||
mayi nikṣipya yātīti vyakta eṣa sa puṃgavaḥ ||
dṛśyante yāḥ sadācārāḥ sā tāsāṃ bālaśīlatā ||
eṣā tu gopayoṣāpi rūpiṇy api taruṇy api |
cintām etāṃ kurvataḥ kāryavandhyām āsīt sā me sopakāraiva rātrīḥ |
sadyaḥ kāntākaṇṭhaviśleṣaduḥkham ārāt sahyaṃ cetasā yan na soḍham ||
tataḥ prātaḥ sa māṃ gopaḥ kṛpālur iva tattvavit |
iti mām idam uktvāsau nivṛttaḥ kṛtabandhanaḥ ||
gacchan puruṣam adrākṣaṃ grāmād āyāntam antike ||
sa tu māṃ ciram īkṣitvā bravīti sma savismayaḥ |
mama tv āsīd asaṃdigdhaṃ dṛṣṭavān eṣa gomukham |
na hi tasmād ṛte kaścid asti matsadṛśaḥ kṣitau ||
pṛcchāmi sma ca taṃ bhadra sa kaniṣṭhaḥ kva tiṣṭhati |
kīdṛśā vā vinodena gamayed divasān iti ||
tatas tenoktam atraiva grāme gṛhapatir dvijaḥ |
ekadā brāhmaṇaḥ pṛṣṭas tena brahmasabhāṃ gataḥ |
āgataḥ katamād deśāt kimarthaṃ vā bhavān iti ||
bhrātarau sa ca me jyeṣṭho yātrāyām anyato gataḥ ||
ity ukte tena tenoktam idaṃ vaḥ sadhanaṃ gṛham |
yena yenātra vaḥ kāryaṃ tat tad ādīyatām iti ||
gṛhe gṛhapates tasya kṣamāvān api śīlataḥ |
hālikatvān na jānāmi jñātā kiṃ kim asāv iti |
yanmātraṃ tu vijānāmi tanmātraṃ kathayāmi vaḥ ||
ācāryā api vidyāsu tasyaiva chāttratāṃ gatāḥ ||
viśvakarmātha vā brahmā kasmān nāyam upāsitaḥ ||
utkaṇṭhaḥ sarvataḥ paśyañ jīmūtam iva cātakaḥ ||
āryajyeṣṭho bhavān eva yadi tal laghu kathyatām |
āma saumya sa evāham iti saṃvādito mayā |
ūrdhvacūḍaḥ sa vegena prati grāmam adhāvata ||
dūrād eva yathādīrgham apatan mama pādayoḥ ||
bālair āliṅgitaiḥ putrair dāraiś ca na tathā priyaiḥ |
janyate janitā prītis tena me suhṛdā yathā ||

column3: nītavantaḥ kathaṃ yūyam iyato divasān iti ||
asty ahaṃ svagṛhāt prātar yuṣmān sevitum āgataḥ |
pratibuddhān na cāpaśyaṃ pāṇḍāv api divākare ||
hā śūnyam iti sākrandā nirgatā vāsamandirāt ||
atha tāḍitahastena mā mā bhaiṣṭeti vādinā |
sa cāvocan mahīpālam alaṃ gatvā viṣaṇṇatām |
na hy adarśanamātreṇa bhānoḥ saṃbhāvyate cyutiḥ ||
brahmajātir ivāvadhyā sa kasmād duḥsthatām iyāt ||
idaṃ śrutvāpi naivāsīt kasmaicid aśane ruciḥ |
kim etad iti paurāṇāṃ yāvad vākyaṃ samāpyate |
sa tu mām abravīt karṇe kathaṃ katham ayaṃ mayā |
tatas tam uktavān asmi yayā hariśikhādayaḥ |
āgacchāgaccha tāteti sa tam āhūtam āgatam |
so .pi nyubjikayā dūram apasṛtya praṇamya ca |
taṃ rājā kṣaṇam āsīnam akhedam idam uktavān |
bhrātuḥ kathaya vṛttāntam iti tenoditaṃ tataḥ ||
vegavaty api sakrodhā jitvā bhrātaram ambare |
sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati mā bhūt tadviśaṅkā bhavatām iti ||
sa mayā sahito gatvā devyau dūrād avandata ||
kṣaṇaṃ cāntaḥpure sthitvā niryātaḥ sa mayoditaḥ |
vistareṇa sakhe mahyaṃ bhartur vṛttaṃ nivedyatām ||
bhidyante na rahasyāni gurūṇāṃ saṃnidhau tathā |
athoktaṃ tena yady evaṃ vivikte kvacid āsyatām |
na hīdaṃ śakyam ākhyātuṃ na śrotuṃ prasthitair iti ||
āsīnāya sa me vṛttaṃ yuṣmadvṛttam avartayat ||
tenaiva ca kṛtānujñaḥ prāyām aṅgārakaṃ prati ||
so .ham ādāya viśrabdhaṃ tvatsakhīm āśrame pituḥ |
sa ca gatvā mayā dṛṣṭas tiṣṭhann avaṭasaṃkaṭe ||
yudhyamānāṃ saha bhrātrā rakṣa vegavatīm iti ||
utpatya ca mayā dṛṣṭā nirjitā bhrātṛśātravā |
sā tu māṃ praṇataṃ dūrād ājñāpitavatī laghu |
bhrātaḥ prajñaptim āvartya svāmī vijñāyatām iti ||
atha dūreṇa māṃ jitvā vegād vegavatī gatā |
rūpaṃ gandharvadattāyāḥ kīdṛg ity ucyatām iti ||
varṇitaṃ dattakenāpi rūpaṃ tasyās tathā yathā |
sadyo vikasitaṃ bhartur devyās tu mlānam ānanam ||
yadi paśyed ayaṃ mugdhaḥ priyāṃ madanamañjukām |
dūre gandharvadattāstāṃ rambhām api na varṇayet ||
bahu śrotavyam atrāsti nipuṇaṃ śrūyatām iti ||
punar apy uktavān svāmī sā tathāpi priyā priyā |
priyāṃ vegavatīṃ prāpya yat satyaṃ vismṛtaiva me ||
uktaś cāsmi tayā smitvā bhrātar gacchāva saṃprati |
yāvatyā velayā devyā vākyam ityādi kalpitam |
devaḥ saṃcintya tāvatyā paścād ūhitavān idam ||
yathā prāpya dvitīyāṃ me vismṛtā prathamā priyā |
iti dāruṇayā patyur iyaṃ vācā vimohitā |
utthāya ca sasaṃjñeyaṃ divam utpatya bhāṣate |
athavā kuru bandhutvaṃ bhrātaḥ kāṣṭhāni saṃhara |
rājadvāre śmaśāne vā yas tiṣṭhati sa bāndhavaḥ ||
duḥkhādhikaraṇaṃ tan me śarīraṃ dahyatām iti ||
mayokteyaṃ kva devasya devī vegavataḥ sutā |
kva cāsadṛśam etat te vadanān nirgataṃ vacaḥ ||
yadi tyaktaśarīrāṇāṃ śarīraṃ na punar bhavet |
tayā tu sarvam evedam aśrutvā śūnyacetasā |
nanu saṃhara dārūṇi kiṃ cireṇeti bhāṣitam ||
mayoktaṃ yadi yuṣmākam ayaṃ cetasi niścayaḥ |
aham eva tataḥ pūrvaṃ praviśāmi citām iti ||
mām anumriyamāṇas tvam ucyase kiṃ janair iti ||
athainām uktavān asmi satyam etad virudhyate |
jīvitaṃ tu mahādoṣaṃ tathā ca śrūyatāṃ kathā ||
durgarājaṃ yam āśritya rājabhyo .pi na bibhyati ||
bilaṃ kṛtvā śatadvāram uvāsa kila mūṣika ||
vāneyaiḥ pāvanair annair jāhnavīyaiś ca vāribhiḥ |
tām apṛcchat kva yāto naḥ sakhā sakhi bhaved iti ||
tayāhārārtham ity ukte prasthitaṃ tam uvāca sā |
ayam āyāti te bhrātā sumuhūrtam udīkṣyatām ||
asatkāre gṛhād yāte kṛtaghne .pi sa te sakhā |
tvaṃ punas tasya mitraṃ ca cirāc ca gṛham āgataḥ |
nirātithyaś ca yāmīti vṛṣas tvam aviṣāṇakaḥ ||

column3: etasminn īdṛśe kāle śaṅkāgrastaḥ sa mūṣikaḥ |
anumāya cirāc cihnair ājagāma svam ālayam ||
atha mūḍhaś ciraṃ sthitvā prabuddho vilalāpa saḥ |
mahābhūtena bhūtāṅge bhavatā kim idaṃ kṛtam ||
na punar yat tvayā pāpa duṣkaraṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
tam eva capalaṃ yena sarvabhakṣaḥ kṛto bhavān ||
ityādi vilapantaṃ taṃ sametya sa suhṛd dhruvaḥ |
mūṣikair aparaiḥ sārdham alīkam avadad vacaḥ ||
svayam eva sakhe sakhyā strītvād vāmasvabhāvayā |
gaṅgākūlaṃ tribhir vāraiḥ śāvakān nayatām iti ||
asaṃbhrāntā ca mām āha kātarāṇāṃ bhavādṛśām |
na cāgner asti sāmarthyam adāhyaṃ dagdhum īdṛśam |
so .tidūreṇa vicchinnaḥ katham asmān dahed iti ||
sa tu mitrīyamāṇas taṃ ciram ālokya pṛṣṭavān |
evam uktaḥ prajāvatyā bhavān kiṃ kṛtavān iti ||
niṣpratyāśas tadā prāṇān ahaṃ rakṣitavān iti ||
ākhur anyatamas teṣāṃ tam asādhum abhāṣata ||
tuṣān gopayatā tyaktāḥ prājñena kalamās tvayā |
rakṣatā sutyajān prāṇāṃs tyaktā yad dustyajā guṇāḥ ||
prāṇānāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca viśeṣaḥ syāt kiyān iti |
mīmāṃsitvā ciraṃ devāḥ sāmyam eṣām akalpayan ||
tān prajāpatir āhaitya mā kṛdhvaṃ viṣamaṃ samam |
athavā mṛta eva tvam utkrāntaṃ paśya te yaśaḥ |
ahaṃ jīvita ity etat ko brūyān mūṣikād ṛte ||
iti te tam upālabhya parisaṃsthāpya cetaram |
sa cākhur mūṣikaśreṇyā tasmād ārabhya vāsarāt |
akṣatāṅgaḥ svayaṃ mandaḥ kiṃ vakṣyāmi puraḥ prabhoḥ ||
tad gariṣṭhād ato doṣāl laghiṣṭhaṃ maraṇaṃ mayā |
yāvac ca samayaṃ baddhvā kathā parisamāpyate |
tāvad āvām anuprāptāv āsthānaṃ bhavatām iti ||
rājaputrasya nāgantuṃ na sthātuṃ tatra yujyate |
tāvanty eva sahasrāṇi tādṛśām eva vājinām ||
pattirakṣyā hi mātaṅgāḥ karmaṇyāḥ samareṣv iti ||
prāptakālam idaṃ stutvā rājā senāpater vacaḥ |
saṃniviṣṭaṃ ca tat tantram anyasmin vindhyasānuṣu |

column3: cintitaṃ ca mayā hanta vinaṣṭaḥ khalu gomukhaḥ |
yūyaṃ māṃ vahatety eṣa no brūyāt katham anyathā ||
ariṣṭāviṣṭatāṃ muktvā katham itthaṃ sa vakṣyati ||
tan madīyam aśaṅkena pṛṣṭham āruhyatām iti ||
tena coktaṃ vilakṣeṇa mā grahīta yathāśrutam |
kiṃtu yaḥ kiṃcid ācaṣṭe pānthasya pathikaḥ pathi |
ākhyātuṃ ca vijānāti yat tataḥ kathayatv iti ||
sarvārthānām asau hetur guṇānām iva sajjanaḥ ||
nātisaktiś ca dāreṣu sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ viparyayaḥ ||
tena yat kiṃcid ucchāstraṃ bālabhāvād udāhṛtam |
gomukhas tu kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā mām avocad gataśramam |
yatra sthātavyam asmābhir upalabhya tam āśrayam |
āgacchāmīti mām uktvā calair uccalitaḥ padaiḥ ||
tataḥ kimapi niścitya nivṛtto mām abhāṣata ||
yad idaṃ yuṣmadaṅgeṣu divyaṃ bhūṣaṇam āhitam |
idam ādāya gacchāmi sthātuṃ nāsyeha yujyate ||
teṣāṃ sāhasikaḥ kaścid anarthaṃ cintayed iti ||
āsīc ca mama tāv etau nūnaṃ pāṣaṇḍitaskarau |
prayuṅkte nirghṛṇaḥ śastraṃ ko .nyaḥ klībatamas tataḥ ||
vipralabdhāḥ sukhaṃ tyaktvā mokṣamārge kila sthitāḥ ||
yathā tṛṇam upādātum ambarāmbhojam eva vā |
kaścin mahat tapaḥ kuryān mokṣārtho nas tathā śramaḥ ||
athavāstām idaṃ tāvad idaṃ tāvan nigadyatām |
smṛtīnāṃ viṭakāvyatvaṃ kathaṃ veda bhavān iti ||

yac cedaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nāma śarīreṣu śarīriṇām |
yathā dhanur adhānuṣkaṃ yathā bījam avāpakam |

tasmād eva ca sa chāttrair āhūyata dṛḍhodyamaḥ ||
vāsam āvasathe tasya karoti sma dṛḍhodyamaḥ ||

column3: tantrasthānam upāntaṃ ca cāṭādibhyaś ca rakṣitam ||
āha vedāntavādaś ca tārakaṃ brahma tantrayet |
śvaḥ prasthātāsmahe tasmāt prātar vārāṇasīṃ prati |
buddhadharme praśastā hi dharmasya tvaritā gatiḥ ||
na ca pratigrahād anyad viprasya dhanasādhanam ||
tat sukhopanataṃ caitad anindyam atibhūri ca |
na vikalpayituṃ śaktaḥ kiṃ punar nyāyyam īdṛśam ||
yātāyāṃ tu triyāmāyāṃ tam āmantrayituṃ gatam |
yadā tu divasārdhe .pi gate chāttraḥ sa nāgataḥ |
taṃ gaveṣayituṃ bhikṣuḥ svayam eva tadā gataḥ ||
uktaṃ ca bhavatā kasmād iyacciram iha sthitam |
athārthenaiva tenārthas tathā naḥ kathyatām iti ||
tatas tenoktam etasmin gṛhe kenāpi hetunā |
yāṃ yām eva ca pṛcchāmi kim etad iti dārikām |
sā sā mām āha saṃrabdhā śivaṃ dhyātu bhavān iti ||
taṃ cādyāpi na pṛcchāmi tamobhedakam ākulam |
tenāhaṃ nāgataḥ kṣipraṃ sakāśaṃ bhavatām iti ||
yenāyam ākulo lokas tad ahaṃ kathayāmi te ||
dārikā jāyate cāsya tāṃ ca tvaṃ pariṇeṣyasi |
iti tasmin kṛtādeśe gate svavivadhaṃ prati |
iti cintayatas tasya dīno gṛhapatir gṛhāt |
hā daivaṃ khalam ityādi lapan nīcair vinirgataḥ ||
amantrayata vāmasya vidheḥ kiṃ kriyatām iti ||
ayaṃ pariharāmy enāṃ dūrataḥ kardamām iti ||
sadvīpāṃ ca parikramya varṣair dvādaśabhir mahīm |
yayāce brāhmaṇīm amba pānīyaṃ dāpyatām iti ||
sā tv abhāṣata saṃbhrāntā hale putri tamālike |
āsyatām atra mitreti vadantyā śūnyayā tayā |
atha tām abravīd vṛddhā muktvaitām avinītatām |
tato gataśramaṃ vṛddhā pṛcchati sma dṛḍhodyamam |
āgacchati kuto deśāt kaṃ vā yāti bhavān iti ||
column5: āgacchati kuto deśān nagarād vā bhavān iti |

column3: tenoktaṃ na sa deśo .sti nāgacchāmi yataḥ kṣitau |
yac ca brūtha kva yāsīti tatra vijñāpayāmi vaḥ ||
tatas tam abravīd vṛddhā nītijñaiḥ satyam ucyate |
na hy ataptena lohena taptaṃ saṃdhīyate kvacit ||
tau ca saṃyojitau puṇyair arthināv arthinā tvayā ||
tatas tasyai pratijñāya tau baṭū pāṭhayann asau |
ekadā tām abhāṣanta vṛddhām āgatya bāndhavāḥ |
ye jāmātṛguṇās teṣāṃ kaścid asti kvacid vare |
dṛḍhodyame punaḥ paśya yadi kaṃcin na paśyasi ||
kena vanyaḥ karī vārīm āgataḥ svayam ujjhitaḥ ||
iti tair bodhitā vṛddhā pratītā tān ayācata |
yady evaṃ svayam evāyaṃ pūjyair abhyarthyatām iti ||
te tatas tam abhāṣanta bhautika brahmacāriṇā |
āmnātāś cāvabuddhāś ca vedāḥ sasmṛtayas tvayā ||
evamādi sa tair uktaḥ kṣaṇam etad acintayat |
yuktaṃ yad brāhmaṇair uktam atra tāvat kim ucyate ||
yaś cāsau sindhuviṣaye dūṣitaḥ kṛtyayā tayā |
sūcīsūtragate daivāt tataḥ kaḥ kutra mokṣyate ||
evamādi sa niścitya pratiśrutya tatheti ca |
pariṇīya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ saṃvatsaram ayāpayat ||
brūhi sundari paśyāma kuṭumbasyāsya kaḥ prabhuḥ |
keyaṃ bhavati te vṛddhā kāv etau baṭukāv iti ||
asyā brāhmaṇavṛddhāyāḥ priyaḥ sādhur abhūt patiḥ |
tāḍitaś caraṇenāpi yaḥ kṣamāvān abhūt purā |
yady evaṃ durdurūḍhena kiṃ mayārādhitena vaḥ |
ity uktvā mantharālāpaḥ sadāro gata eva saḥ ||
tasya tasyāṃ ca bhāryāyāṃ kālarātrisamā sutā |
yamau ca tanayau jātau yamakālau kulasya yau ||
aham eva ca sā kanyā tau caitau kākatālukau |
yair mātāpitarāv eva bālair eva samāhitau ||
mātāmahagṛhaṃ yāntu bālā me niviśantv iti ||
śeṣaṃ sujñānam evāsyāḥ kathāyāḥ sthīyatām iti ||
asmābhiś ca na vedoktaṃ na vedāntoktamohitam |
puṇyaṃ svargaphalaṃ kurvann ayāmi divasān iti ||
tato vārāṇasīṃ prāpad amuñcann eva jāhnavīm ||
sā tu kāpālikenoktā drutam ehi kapālini |
evaṃprāye ca vṛttānte ciraṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛḍhodyamam |
parihāsaś ciraṃ caṇḍi viruddhas tyajyatām iti ||
sābravīd eṣa me bhartā daivataiḥ pratipāditaḥ |
tvaṃ tu dhṛṣṭaviṭo bhūtvā kiṃ vyāharasi mām iti ||
taṃ ca prapañcam ālokya sa pradeśaḥ sakautukaiḥ |
savedaḥ ko hi nirvedaṃ vedoktaiḥ karmabhir vrajet ||
tvayā dṛḍhodyama tyaktā sāhaṃ mandā tamālikā |
yair aduṣṭāḥ striyo dṛṣṭās te dṛṣṭāḥ kenacit kvacit ||
tena tyaktavatā dārān yat tvayā pāpam arjitam |
tān eva bharamāṇena tat samucchidyatām iti ||
bhagavatyā yad uktaṃ tat tattvataḥ kathyatām iti ||
yac ca kiṃcid akartavyam anāthyād anayā kṛtam |
tasya kṛcchratamaiḥ kṛcchrair viśuddhiḥ kriyatām iti ||
pūjyānām eva tad buddham idaṃ budhyata yādṛśam ||
iyaṃ tv aśubhasāvarṇaṃ yam upāste sa dṛśyatām ||
tad upāstām iyaṃ bhadrā yam upāsac chivaṃ dhruvam |
ā mṛtyos tvatsamīpasthā nayāmi divasān iti ||
dhanaṃ me dhanadasyeva saiva caikā sutā yataḥ |
tatas tasya ca tasyāś ca bhaved bhartā bhavān iti ||
āsīc cāsya kim adyāpi syān na syād iti cintayā |
pratijñāya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ dadānād brāhmaṇāt svayam |
tat tena yena kṛtaduṣkarapauruṣeṇa vākyaṃ na bhinnatamasaḥ kṛtam apramāṇam |
śūreṇa daivahariṇā prabhuṇā prasahya tasmāj jitaḥ puruṣakāragajādhirājaḥ ||
aṅgāpotam amuṃ yena potaṃ prerayateti saḥ |
yāvan niryāmakān āha tāvat potau samīyatuḥ ||
yūyaṃ ye vā yatas tyā vā tan naḥ pratyucyatām iti ||
bhavantaḥ ke kuto veti tataḥ so .pi nyavedayat ||
prītir naḥ sthiratāṃ yāyād yathā saṃpādyatāṃ tathā ||
tasyāś ca divasir ebhir jātam anyatarad dvayoḥ ||
duhitā cet tato dattā bhavatputrāya sā mayā |
putraś cet tvaṃ tatas tasmai dadyāḥ svatanayām iti ||
tenoktaṃ mahad āścaryam iyam eva hi no matiḥ |
athavā kim ihāścaryam ekam evāvayor vapuḥ ||
tatra satkriyamāṇau ca satkurvāṇau ca saṃtatam |
tena coktam idaṃ yādṛg bālikā kundamālikā |
yayoḥ syād īdṛśaḥ putraḥ pitarau tau saputrakau ||
tasmād duhitṛmāteti mā gās tvaṃ bhīru bhīrutām |
na kīrtijananī vidyā nindyā bhavitum arhati ||
kasyeyaṃ kundamāleti tām apṛcchad yataḥ pitā |
prasiddhā tasya nāmnāpi sā tataḥ kundamālikā ||
tasmin garbhe tavotpannaṃ yat tan naḥ kathyatām iti ||
lambauṣṭhaṃ bhugnapṛṣṭhaṃ ca sā taṃ putraṃ samarpayat ||
so .bravīt kiṃ vṛthaivāyaṃ dhṛtaḥ kurubhakas tvayā |
kasmād īkṣaṇikāṃ pṛṣṭvā garbha eva na pātitaḥ ||
yaḥ sa sāgaradattena saha saṃbandhakaḥ kṛtaḥ |
saṃdiśed yadi nāmāsāv ahaṃ duhitṛvān iti |
tadā kiṃ pratisaṃdeśyaṃ mayāhaṃ putravān iti ||
bhāryāṃ cāvocad āgacched dūto mālavakād yadi |
enaṃ kurubhakaṃ tasmai na kaścit kathayed iti ||
ayaṃ kurubhakaḥ kasmād iti yat taṃ pitābravīt |
vyāharanti sma taṃ paurās tataḥ kurubhakākhyayā ||
athātīte kvacit kāle buddhivarmā rahaḥ sthitaḥ |
sv asti rājagṛhe pūjyaṃ buddhavarmāṇam ūrjitam |
rūpeṇa sadṛśī yasyāḥ pramadā na bhaviṣyati ||
tavāpi yadi bhāryāyāḥ putro jātaḥ śivaṃ tataḥ |
kanyā ced vāmaśīlena devena muṣitā vayam ||
nirnimittāpi hi prītir yā na saṃbandhabṛṃhitā |
tataḥ satkṛtya taṃ dūtam apṛcchad gṛhiṇīṃ vaṇik |
tasminn evaṃ gate kārye brūhi kiṃ kriyatām iti ||
tayoktaṃ dvyaṅgulaprajñā jānīyur vā striyaḥ kiyat |
kiṃ tu pṛṣṭeti vakṣyāmi pṛṣṭadhṛṣṭā hi mādṛśī ||
sahajaṃ hi tyajan vṛttaṃ durvṛtta iti nindyate ||
ye punas tasya doṣās tān mithyā bhaṇa guṇā iti ||
ākhyāyante hi sarvārthāḥ kṛtrimair eva nāmabhiḥ |
āhur madhurakaṃ kecit taṃ tādṛṅmārakaṃ viṣam ||
kārye hi guruṇi prāpte mithyā satyam apīṣyate |
aśvatthāmā hato drauṇir ity ūce kiṃ na pāṇḍavaḥ ||
tasmān mā smāvamanyadhvam adhanyair durlabhāṃ śriyam |
ityādivacanaṃ tasyāḥ sūktam ity abhinandya saḥ |
vaktavyaḥ suhṛd asmākam asmākam api dārakaḥ |
utpannas tādṛśo yasya kathitā katham ākṛtiḥ ||
athavā ye guṇāḥ ke.pi tasya śārīramānasāḥ |
svayam evāsi tān dṛṣṭā kiṃ nas taiḥ kathitair iti ||
ityādi bahu saṃkīrṇam asau saṃdiśya sādaram |
jāmātaram anālokya mā smāgacchad bhavān iti ||
tan mām ujjayanīṃ yūyaṃ yadi gacchantam icchatha |
taṃ me dārakam ākhyāta tadīyāṃś ca guṇān iti ||
āha saṃbandhinī yat tvāṃ sadāraṃ tan niśāmyatām ||
adyāpi ca na paśyāmo vayaṃ jāmātur ākṛtim ||
iti lokapravādo .yaṃ bhavatāpi na kiṃ śrutaḥ ||
tvaṃ yac cāttha paṭhann āste tāmraliptyām asāv iti |
idam apy atidurbaddhaṃ savyājam iva vācakam ||
yeṣāṃ karma ca vṛttiś ca vihite pāṭhapāṭhane |
teṣām api paricchinnaḥ pāṭhakālaḥ kiyān api ||
paṭhatā sakalaṃ janma neyam ity asamañjasam ||
atra vā tāmraliptyāṃ vā dārako darśyatām iti ||
iti yāvad asau tāvat pūjyair viśramyatām iti |
tān uktvā gṛhiṇīm ūce buddhavarmā sasaṃbhramaḥ ||
vardhamāṇe śarīre hi nijā doṣāḥ śarīriṇām |
tayā coktaṃ mayopāyaḥ kīdṛśo .py atra cintitaḥ |
yady asau rocate tubhyaṃ tataḥ prastūyatām iti ||
ucyatām iti tenoktā karṇe kimapi sābravīt |
so .pi śobhanam ity uktvā tam upāyaṃ prayuktavān ||
ākāraś ca prakāraś ca yādṛk kiṃ tasya kathyate ||
yac ca sāgaradattena mayā ca paribhāṣitam |
tena nas tena sauhārdaṃ suhṛdā sthiratāṃ naya |
athavā svārtha evāyaṃ tava dhiṅ māṃ mudhākulam ||
ya eṣa bhavataḥ putro yajñaguptaḥ surūpavān |
yac ca ratnasuvarṇādi lapsyate draviṇaṃ tataḥ |
abravīt tvadvidheyaiḥ kiṃ madvidhaiḥ prārthitair iti ||
śiśubhir na vicāryāṇi tasmād evaṃ bhavatv iti ||
abravīc cāyam āyātas tāmraliptyāḥ sa dārakaḥ |
ākāraś ca guṇāś cāsya dṛśyantāṃ yādṛśā iti ||
tatas tair vismitair uktam anindyā kundamālikā |
kiṃ tu nāmāsya duḥśliṣṭam ayaṃ kurubhakaḥ kila |
athavā duḥśravaṃ nāma śrūyate mahatām api |
kledur ity ucyate candro mātariśveti mārutaḥ ||
na cāpi guṇavad vācya vācakaṃ paribhūyate |
na hīdānīṃ vivāhasya kaścid asti vighātakaḥ ||
ity uktvā teṣu yāteṣu sāravatprābhṛteṣu saḥ |
yo .sau kurubhakas taṃ ca yajñaguptaṃ cakāra saḥ |
saṃjñayā yajñaguptaṃ tu varaṃ kurubhakaṃ vaṇik ||
sajjaṃ vaḥ pānam annaṃ ca kim ādhve bhujyatām iti ||
kena kenātra bhoktavyam iti syālakam uktavān ||
ye caite dattavetrāṅge yuṣmān ubhayataḥ same |
varas tu kṣaṇam avyūha syālam etad abhāṣata |
asmābhiḥ saha yuṣmābhir na kāryaṃ pānabhojanam ||
gotrācāro .yam asmākaṃ tāvat pānaṃ na sevyate |
bhujyate vāparaiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvan na pariṇīyate ||
kāryam etan na vā kāryaṃ vinādeśād guror iti ||
evaṃ nāmety anujñātaḥ śvaśureṇa varaḥ pṛthak |
pāṇibhyām udaraṃ dhṛtvā mumoha ca papāta ca ||

column3: hā hatāsi vinaṣṭāsi dhik tvāṃ pracchannarākṣasīm |
tvam eva na mṛtā kasmād ahaṃ vā duḥkhabhāginī |
yayā tvaṃ sakalaṃ janma draṣṭavyāmṛtayā mṛtā ||
kathaṃ jīvati sā yā strī bālaiva mṛtabhartṛkā |
yā ca mātā sutām iṣṭāṃ cārutāśīlaśālinīm |
śaktā vidhavikāṃ draṣṭuṃ jyeṣṭhā kālasya sā svasā ||
ityādi vilapanty eva sā ca niśceṣṭanābhavat |
kim etad iti pṛṣṭaś ca sa vaidyaiḥ pratyuvāca tān |
āmāśayagataṃ śūlaṃ bādhate guru mām iti ||
tataḥ patim upāsīnāṃ sa kubjaḥ kundamālikām |
abravīc ca vimuñcainaṃ kirāṭam apaṭuṃ viṭam |
devatāgurubhir dattaṃ kāntaṃ toṣaya mām iti ||
keyaṃ kelir anāryeti vadhūr bhartāram abravīt ||
sa tāṃ sasmitam āha sma mā sma grāmeyikā bhava |
kā hi nāgarikaṃmanyā hāsyāt naṭabaṭos traset ||
na hi mūkaṃ śukaṃ kaścic ciraṃ dharati pañjare ||
hasataḥ spṛśataś cāṅgaṃ bhīru mā vitrasīr iti ||
āsīc ca yajñaguptasya yāvad evaiṣa mūḍhakaḥ |
rahasyaṃ na bhinatty etat tāvan nyāyyam ito gatam ||
tataḥ kṣāmatarālāpas tān avocac cirād asau |
pitarau draṣṭum icchāmi priyaputrau priyāv iti ||
evaṃ vadati jāmātā tac ca pratividhīyatām ||
kṛtam apy akṛtaṃ tat tad etasmiñ jātam āture ||
svadeśāya tu yāto .yaṃ bhaved api nirāmayaḥ |
śyāmāṃ niśām iva kṛśena tuṣārabhāsā prāsthāpayat saha vareṇa vaṇiktanūjām ||
prayāṇakaiś ca yāvadbhir agād rājagṛhaṃ varaḥ |
śreṣṭhī ca dviguṇān prītān prāhiṇot paricārakān ||
nivartitavyaṃ yuṣmābhir iti cāsāv uvāca tān ||
prathamād vāsakād yau ca nivṛttau paricārakau |
śreṣṭhine kathitaṃ tābhyāṃ varaḥ svastho manāg iti ||
yathā yathā ca yāti sma vāsakān uttarottarān |
śanakaiḥ śanakair māndyam atyajat sa tathā tathā ||
vaiṣeṇāgantunā muktaḥ sa reje nijayā śriyā |
kiṃ punar yaḥ sadācāraḥ sargahetur bhavādṛśaḥ ||
iyam evāstu te putras tanayā ca vadhūr iti ||
naṭādiṣu ca nṛtyatsu sārkaṃ tad agamad dinam ||
api nāmaiṣa māṃ muktvā brāhmaṇo na vrajed iti ||
api nāmaiṣa niryāyād bahir vāsagṛhād iti ||
yajñaguptas tayor buddhvā tat kālocitam iṅgitam |
gamanaṃ cātmanaḥ śreyas tato nirgantum aihata ||
sā tam ucchalitaṃ dṛṣṭvā saviṣādam abhāṣata |
dārān āpadgatān muktvā prasthitaḥ kva bhavān iti ||
tenoktaṃ yasya dārās tvaṃ vidhātrā parikalpitā |
āpannāsmīti mā vocas tiṣṭhantī tasya saṃnidhau ||
ittham uktvā sa cānyābhiḥ preṣyābhiḥ saha niryayau |
anicchām aicchad ākraṣṭuṃ grāmyaḥ kurubhakaś ca tām ||
vyāharantīva taṃ vipraṃ nirjagāma javena sā ||
yajñaguptas tayā naiva dṛṣṭas tatra gṛhāṅgaṇe ||
yaṃ kaṃcid api sā yāntam anvayāsīt tadāśayā ||
suśliṣṭā hanta rakṣeyam ity adhyavasitaṃ tayā ||
ghūrṇamānā madād grāmaṃ bāhyaṃ niragamat purāt ||
tatra ca brāhmaṇī kācit tayā śvetaśiroruhā |
ekākiny eva sā daivaṃ ninditvā karuṇasvanā |
dhik kṣudraṃ buddhavarmāṇam iti sakrodham abravīt ||
sādhoḥ kiṃ duṣkṛtaṃ tasya nindyate yad asāv iti ||
tayoktam atimugdho vā dhūrto vā bhagavann asi |
tadīyaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ yena prakāśam api na śrutam ||
athavā śroṣyati bhavān anyatas tat suduḥśravam |
mādṛśī tu na śaktaiva vaktuṃ prakṛtikātarā ||
yāvac cedam asāv āha tāvad uccaistarāṃ pure |
nāgaraḥ kaścid ācaṣṭe sa dāridryeṇa mucyate ||
yaḥ punaḥ svagṛhe mohāt pracchādayati taṃ nṛpaḥ |
pāṭayaty adhanaṃ kṛtvā dāruṇaiḥ krakacair iti ||
abravīc ca kim āścaryaṃ yad ujjayaniko janaḥ |
yathā rājagṛhaṃ putri tvayedaṃ sukham āsitam |
ityādi bruvatīṃ śrutvā cintayāmāsa tām asau |
śanaiś cākathayat tasyai vṛttaṃ vṛttāntam ātmanaḥ |
gāḍham āliṅgya sā caināṃ prītā prāveśayad gṛham ||
abhyajya snapayitvā ca sukhoṣṇaiḥ salilair asau |
paridhāya ca tām eva bībhatsām asthiśṛṅkhalām |
bhrāmyatsaṃbhrāntapauraṃ tat sā prātaḥ prāviśat puram ||
tenoktam iha ca sthāne śreṣṭhino buddhavarmaṇaḥ |
sā taṃ kurubhakaṃ tyaktvā mārgayantī ca taṃ dvijam |
pradoṣe kvāpy apakrāntā lokas tenāyam ākulaḥ ||
bhadra ṣaṇḍhasya tasyāśu gṛhaṃ nayata mām iti ||
ko .yaṃ vyākhyāyate grantha ity apṛcchat samatsarā ||
tayoktaṃ kim alīkena na hīyaṃ dharmasaṃhitā |
na hi vaidyaḥ svaśāstrajñaḥ kuṣṭhī māṃsaṃ niṣevate ||
tan māheśvara pṛcchāmi kim artham idam īdṛśam |
tvayā kṛtam akartavyaṃ yuktaṃ cet kathyatām iti ||
so .bravīd bhagavan yuktam ayuktaṃ vā bhavatv idam |
tathā hi jāmadagnyena durlaṅghyād vacanāt pituḥ |
mātuḥ kṛttaṃ śiras tatra kim āha bhagavān iti ||
na hi rudreṇa pīteti pibanti brāhmaṇāḥ surām ||
na ca prājñena kartavyaṃ sarvam eva guror vacaḥ |
guruḥ kiṃ nāma na brūyād duḥkhakrodhādibādhitaḥ ||
śiro me chinddhi putreti kiṃ kāryaṃ tena tat tathā ||
yac ca mātuḥ śiraḥ kṛttaṃ rāmeṇa vacanāt pituḥ |
tat tasyaiva prabhāvena sadyaḥ saṃghaṭitaṃ punaḥ ||
idānīm api tām eva bhavān vineṣyati priyām |
guruvākyaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yad gataṃ gatam eva tat ||
vādivācye hi nirdoṣe kiṃ vācyaṃ prativādinaḥ ||
evaṃ ca ciram āsitvā nabhomadhyagate ravau |
tena coktā svam evedam ṛddhimac ca gṛhaṃ tava |
kṛtvāpi tu mahat pāpaṃ paścāt tāpaṃ karoti yaḥ |
evamādi tam uktvāsau gatvā ca brāhmaṇīgṛham |
apanīya ca taṃ veṣam ācaran majjanādikam ||
taṃ ca kāpālikaṃ kalpaṃ sāyam ādāya sā punaḥ |
annakālaṃ ca rātriṃ ca nayantī brāhmaṇīgṛhe |
śeṣaṃ ca yajñaguptasya sānayad divasān bahūn ||
akāryam idam etena kṛtaṃ karma dvijanmanā ||
kārye hi sulabhopāye na muhyanti sumedhasaḥ ||
ekarātraṃ vased grāme pañcarātraṃ muniḥ pure |
iti pravrajitācāram etaṃ veda bhavān iti ||
etāvantam ahaṃ kālaṃ vatsa rājagṛhe sthitaḥ |
tena vārāṇasīṃ gantum aham icchāmi saṃprati |
ujjvalair lakṣitaś cihnaiḥ kenāpi nihito nidhiḥ ||
yadi cāsti mayi prītis tataḥ svīkriyatām asau |
saphalāḥ khalu saṃparkāḥ sādhubhis tvādṛśair iti ||
yajñaguptas tam utkhāya nidhiṃ tatsahitas tataḥ |

column3: tam uvāca pitā putraṃ tyaktvā vedān anarthakān |
divyaṃ cakṣur idaṃ tāta mahākālamataṃ matam |
nidhigarbhāṃ naro yena chidrāṃ paśyati medinīm ||
aham apy anugacchāmi bhavantaṃ tīrtham asthiram |
atha vārāṇasīṃ gatvā yajñaguptāya sā dadau |
na tu tāruṇyamūḍhena saṃbhāṣyā gaṇikā tvayā ||
yaj jīvati tad āścaryaṃ kva dharmaḥ kva yaśaḥsukhe ||
ityādim ādeśam asau tadīyaṃ tathety anujñāya tathā cakāra |
ārādhyavākyāni hi bhūtikāmāḥ sevāvidhijñā na vikalpayanti ||
caturaḥ pañca vā māsān vārāṇasyāṃ vihṛtya tau |
naimiṣaṃ jagmatus tasmād gaṅgādvāraṃ tataḥ kurūn ||
aham apy adhunā gacchāmy avantinagarīṃ prati |
tatra kāpālikaḥ kaścin nihanyād api māṃ balī |
ujjayanyāṃ ca yat pāpaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtavān asi |
svargavad brahmaghātena tena sā durgamā tvayā ||
prāvṛtya ca tataḥ paśya sanidhiḥ pitarāv iti ||
āsīc cāsya prasannau me pādāv asya mahātmanaḥ |
sarvam apy ujhati sphītaṃ kimu grantham anarthakam ||
mahākālamataṃ tan me kathaṃ nāma na dāsyati ||
yaṃ ca doṣam ahaṃ tatra kṛtavān guruśāsanāt |
tasya pracchādanopāyo yat kiṃcid iva tucchakaḥ ||
kiṃ cāntevāsināṃ yuktaṃ moktum ācāryam āpadi ||
yā gatir bhavataḥ saiva mamāpi sahacāriṇaḥ |
na hi gacchati pūrṇendau kalaṅko .sya na gacchati ||
āgacchāmi nidhiṃ dṛṣṭvā nihitaṃ kenacit kvacit |
yāvat tāvat tvayotkaṇṭhā na kāryā mām apaśyatā ||
āśaṅke ciram ātmānaṃ paribhrāntam itas tataḥ ||
na hy aujjayanakāḥ paurāḥ sthirān nidadhate nidhīn ||
ehy ehi taralāpāṅgi yas te kāpālikaḥ priyaḥ |
tena sārdhaṃ yathāśraddhaṃ pānam āsevyatām iti ||
tatas tatrāpi sā tebhyaḥ prakṛtyā pratibhāvatī |
tān atidrutayā gatyā jagāma ca jagāda ca ||
paśyantīṃ ca ramaṇīyāṃ spṛśyamānāṃ ca bhīṣaṇām |
īrṣyāvān apramattaś ca sadā rakṣati mām asau ||
yameneva kṣayaṃ nītā koṭir yuṣmādṛśām iti ||
tataḥ kāpālikair uktam uktaṃ yad anayā śriyā |
tan na kevalam etasyām adhikaṃ copapadyate ||
tasmād gandharvam anyaṃ vā kaṃcit trailokyasundaram |
cirāc ca pratyabhijñāya ghnatī sahṛdayaṃ śiraḥ |

āptāś ca śreṣṭhinaḥ paurāḥ paritaḥ samupāviśan ||
guravaḥ satkṛtā mūrdhnā vācā savayasas tayā |
adhyāsya ca puraḥ pitror asau vāmanam āsanam |
āsīc ca yajñaguptasya dhig dhiṅ me viphalāḥ kalāḥ |
iti ye vicikitseyus teṣām eṣā nidarśanam ||
sarvathā guruvākyena yan mayā caritaṃ mahat |
tasmād asmy anayaivādya mocitaḥ pātakād iti ||
sa dattvā yajñaguptāya sasmitas tām abhāṣata ||
yathā dvijātikarmabhyo na hīyate patis tava |
tvayā dhīratayā putri tathā saṃpādyatām iti ||
na hi kṣitīśān avilaṅghyaśāsanān vilaṅghayanti priyajīvitaśriyaḥ ||

column3: tebhyas tenāpi sāmānyam ekam evottaraṃ kṛtam |
bhavataḥ sumukho rājā mā tvariṣṭa bhavān iti ||
na hi dṛṣṭasuvarṇādriḥ tāmraṃ dhamati vātikaḥ ||
māṃ muhuḥ paśyatā prītyā tenaiva sahito .gamam ||
gṛhe ca kṛtasatkāram asau mām anuyuktavān |
āgacchati kutaḥ kiṃ vā mad icchati bhavān iti ||
mayoktaṃ bhrātarāv āvāṃ dvijau dvāv āgamārthinau |
muhūrtaṃ tatra cāsīnaḥ śrutavān aham utthitam |
kiṃ tvam etan na vettheti na vedeti mayoditam ||
yadā vijayate dyūte sa sarvaṃ draviṇaṃ tadā |
yadi kautūhalaṃ tatra tato .sau dṛśyatām iti |
vyasanī ca svatantraś ca so .smākam adhunā suhṛt ||
tasmād dyūtasabhām eva yāmi draṣṭuṃ punarvasum |
pañcako .yaṃ padaṃ nedaṃ padam etan na pañcakaḥ |
athaikaḥ puruṣaḥ prāṃśuḥ pṛṣṭas tābhyām anāgaraḥ |
dīrghatvād eṣa nirbuddhir ato .nyaḥ pṛcchyatām iti ||
tataḥ pṛṣṭo .paro hrasvaḥ so .pi tena nivāritaḥ |
nedṛśāḥ praśnam arhanti bahudoṣā hi khaṭvakāḥ ||
atha māṃ dṛṣṭavantau tau pṛṣṭavantau ca sādaram |
sādho yadi na doṣo .sti tato nau chinddhi saṃśayam ||
tvaṃ na dīrgho na ca hrasvas tasmāt prājño na duṣṭadhīḥ |
na hi prayuñjate prājñāḥ veśād anyatra vaiśikam ||
dyūte jeṣyati yaś cātra sa me mitraṃ bhaviṣyati |
ityādi bahu niścitya puras teṣāṃ savistaram |
tatas tān uktavān asmi yo bhāgaḥ pañcakāṅkitaḥ |
tasyottānatvam utkṛṣṭaṃ kṣodas tatra yataḥ sthitaḥ ||
etāvan mama vijñānam ity uktvāvasthite mayi |
aho sādhv iti nirghoṣaḥ samantāt sahasotthitaḥ ||
iti praśasyamānaṃ māṃ tiryag dṛṣṭvā samatsaraḥ |
padavādī jito yo .sāv asau mantharam uktavān ||
dyūtasthāne hi kiṃ kṛtyaṃ pravīṇaiḥ prāśnikair iti ||
āsīc ca mama kasmān māṃ kaulaṭeyaḥ kṣipaty ayam |
atha nikṣipya sakrodhaṃ yauṣmākaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ bhuvi |
ehi dīvyāva mitreti tam ahaṃ dhūrtam uktavān ||
mayā saha sasaṃrambham akṣān ārabdho devitum ||
tena cāhaṃ tribhiḥ pātair anakṣakuśalaḥ kila |
tatas tat sakṛd unmocya sahasratritayaṃ mayā |
lakṣam ekena pātena jitaḥ sa kitavādhamaḥ ||
na virantuṃ na vā rantum asāv aśakad ākulaḥ ||
dīvya vā dehi vā lakṣaṃ saumyeti ca mayoditaḥ |
vailakṣyād ghaṭṭayann akṣān na kiṃcit pratipannavān ||
etasminn antare bhṛtyaṃ svam avocat punarvasuḥ |
kitavo .yam idaṃ lakṣam acalaṃ dāpyatām iti ||
māṃ cāyaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ nītvā harṣād ṛjutanūruhaḥ |
tathā pūjitavān devaṃ haraṃ dattavaraṃ yathā ||
māṃ cāvocad dhanaṃ yat tad bhavadbhiḥ kitavārjitam |
tad udgrāhyedam ānītaṃ lakṣaṃ te gṛhyatām iti ||
mayāpy uktam upānte yad draviṇaṃ tvatparigrahāt |
sādhitaṃ bhavatā yac ca tasya svāmī bhavān iti ||
uktaṃ cānena yan nāma yuṣmābhiḥ svayam arjitam |
svāmino yūyam evāsya dhanasyety atra kā kathā ||
yad apīdaṃ mayāvāptaṃ yuṣmatsvāmikam eva tat |
adhigacchati yad dāso bhartur eva hi tad dhanam ||
yac ca pṛcchāmi tan mahyaṃ prasāde sati kathyatām |
manye saty api devatve bhavadbhiḥ krīḍayāhṛtaiḥ |
dṛṣṭāḥ kena manuṣyeṣu yādṛśo bhavatām iti ||
tena yat satyam ity ukte duḥkham āśitavān aham |
yan mayā kāryam ākhyātaṃ tad evāsmai niveditam ||
tvādṛśasyāpi yo jyeṣṭhaḥ kīdṛśaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ||
kiṃ vānena vimardena jyeṣṭhas tiṣṭhati yatra saḥ |
sarvatīrthādhike deśe taṃ prāpayata mām iti ||
yac cottaram atas tatra pratyakṣaṃ bhavatām api ||
iti kṣipram ayaṃ labdho mayā vaḥ paricārakaḥ |
na hiṃsanti na sarvatra śriyaḥ puṇyavatām iti ||
tatas tam uktavān asmi vipadas tena durlabhāḥ |
parānnaṃ hi vṛthābhuktaṃ duḥkhāyaiva satām iti ||
evamādibhir ālāpair ardham ardhaṃ ca nidrayā |
nītavān asmi yāminyāḥ prātaś cāgāt punarvasuḥ ||
taṃ ca vanditamatpādam avocad iti gomukhaḥ |
pratyākhyānavicittas tu tam āha sma punarvasuḥ |
yady evaṃ jagadīśānāṃ kiṃ nāsti bhavatām iti ||
tau ca māṃ ciram ālokya vadanaṃ ca parasparam |
prasārya sabhujān pādāñ jayety uktvā bhuvaṃ gatau ||
vanditvā punar abrūtāṃ brūta kiṃ kriyatām iti ||
tatas tau gomukhenoktau bhavantau kila ballavau |
satyaṃ ced idam āryasya pākaḥ saṃsādhyatām iti ||
tau ca prītau pratijñāya nikartya nakhamūrdhajān |
athavā tiṣṭhati vyāsaḥ samāsaḥ śrūyatām ayam |
tāvatyā velayā tābhyāṃ pāka eva samāpitaḥ ||
pañca tittirayaḥ pakvāś catvāraḥ kukkuṭā iti |
āhāro yaiḥ praśastas tair aśitaṃ prākṛtāśanam ||
āhāraṃ yadi severan sakṛt tam amṛtāśanam |
sa gatvā sahitas tābhyāṃ cirāc cāgatya kevalaḥ |
mayā yāv uditāv etau na yuvām etad arhatha |
avasthāsādṛśaṃ kiṃtu yat kiṃcid gṛhyatām iti ||
na yuktaṃ dhanam ādātum āvābhyām iti bhāṣitam ||
prayacchaty ayutaṃ yaś ca pākasyaikasya niṣkrayam |
duḥsthitas tādṛśo yasya susthitas tasya kīdṛśaḥ ||
evamādi bruvann eva sa mālyam iva tad dhanam |
dhārayitvā kṣaṇaṃ mūrdhnā prasthāya prāptavān gṛham ||
divyam aiśvaryam āgāmi kathaṃ veda bhavān iti ||
dvitīya iva tasyātmā devavān iti ballavaḥ ||
īdṛśākāravijñānāv āvām eva ca viddhi tau ||
ekadā nau pitāvocat putrakau śṛṇutaṃ hitam |
ramyāsvādaṃ ca pathyaṃ ca ko .vamanyeta bheṣajam ||
jyeṣṭhasya dṛṣṭam aiśvaryam ataḥ śraddhīyatām iti ||
prajñaptikauśikasutapramukhair uktaṃ nandasya niścitataraṃ vacanāt tad āsīt |
bhāvaṃ hi saṃśayatamaḥpaṭalāpinaddham udbhāvayanty avitathā vacanapradīpāḥ ||
kavibhis tair anātmajñair buddhir āyāsyate vṛthā |
sarvathā taṃ vidhātāraṃ dhig yat kiṃcanakāriṇam |
sarvo hi viniyogārtham arthaḥ sarveṇa sṛjyate |
dhātrā punar iyaṃ sṛṣṭā komaleva mṛṇālinī |
śoṣitā tuhineneti dhik tasya khalatām iti ||
tatas tāṃ ciram ālokya nirnimiṣeṇa cakṣuṣā |
eṣā pravrajitā bhadra kva gacchati gatair iti ||
ambike sahaśiṣyāyās te namo .stu namo .stv iti ||
taṃ ca pravrajitāvocad asaṃbhāṣyo bhavān iti |
suhṛtsādhāraṇaṃ yasya sukhaṃ sa paramaṃ sukhī |
suhṛdbhiḥ kupitais tasmād asaṃbhāṣyaḥ kṛto bhavān |
ṛṣidattāṃ ca tad datte viṣṭare samupāviśam ||
namo .stu sarvasiddhebhyaḥ sādhubhyaś ca namo .stu vaḥ |
sādhu śrāvaka dhanyo .si yaḥ sarvajñaṃ namasyasi |
abravīt suprasannau me bhavantau bhavatām iti ||
tayā tv asya prayuktāśīr asmākaṃ laghuśāsane |
eṣa saṃnihitaḥ saṃghaḥ sakalaḥ suhṛdām iti ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāgarair uktam āryajyeṣṭhasya vāsya vā |
ākhyāta nipuṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kataro rūpavān iti ||
āsīc ca mama yat satyaṃ satyam evāsmi rūpavān |
vanditvā jinam agranthān ṛṣidattāṃ ca māṃ ca saḥ |
ataḥ pratīkṣyatāṃ śreṣṭhī kṣaṇam ity uditekṣayā |
ayam āyāta ity ākhyan nāgarāḥ priyadarśanam ||
āsīc ca mama taṃ dṛṣṭvā naivāyaṃ priyadarśanaḥ |
sā tu vanditadevādiḥ sādaraṃ mām avandata |
citraṃ nāgarakaiḥ kaiścil lajjitaiḥ kaiścid ambaram ||
sagomukham apaśyan mām ā śiraścaraṇaṃ ciram ||
atha prapañcam ākṣeptum etaṃ sapadi gomukhaḥ |
upanandas tataḥ pūrvaṃ tathā vīṇām avādayat |
yathā vigatarāgād yair nirgranthair api mūrchitam ||
upanandāt tato nandaṃ nandād api punarvasum |
punarvasor agād vīṇā kramāt taṃ gaṅgarakṣitam ||
parājayata dūreṇa pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ paraḥ paraḥ ||
gomukhas tu tato vīṇām avādayata līlayā |
gomukhāṅkāt tato vīṇā yāti sma priyadarśanam |
kiṃtu nāradaśiṣyo .yaṃ suto vā tumbaror iti |
yat satyam aham apy āsam adbhutaśrutivismitaḥ ||
muktavīṇe tatas tatra śanair māṃ gomukho .bravīt |
hasitvā tam athāvocam adyāpi hi śiśur bhavān |
yo māṃ yatra kvacit tucche pravartayati vastuni ||
campāyāṃ kīdṛśaṃ kāryam abhavad bhavatām iti ||
tatas tam uktavān asmi śrūyatām yadi na śrutam |
prāptir gandharvadattāyās tatra kāryam abhūd iti ||
athāyam avadat tatra devīprāptiḥ phalaṃ yadi |
yuṣmadanyo na māṃ kaścid vīṇayā jitavān iti |
idaṃ me śreṣṭham āgamya śreṣṭhināpahṛtaṃ yaśaḥ ||
tyajāmy eṣa tataḥ prāṇān duḥkhabhārāturān iti ||
mama tv āsīd asaṃdigdhaṃ sarvam atropapadyate |
tasmād etad iha nyāyyam iti niścitya sādaram |
hā hā kim idam ity uktvā pustanyastā ivābhavan ||
athaitasyām avasthāyāṃ mayā vīṇā ca saṃhṛtā |
iti me prasthitā kīrtir ā payodhivasuṃdharām ||
pūrṇā hi vasudhā śūdrair na ca tān veda kaścana |
asyām eva tu velāyām avocad gaṅgarakṣitaḥ |
ayam eva mamāpy arthaḥ saphalīkriyatām iti ||
anāyāsopadeśau ca yat tad evaṃ bhavatv iti ||
sa mayā śanakair uktaḥ kṣipram eva tvayānayoḥ |
yac cānyad api tat sarvaṃ gaṅgarakṣitarakṣitam ||
yasya ca svayam evāyaṃ dāsyām abhyanugacchati |
sa yasya kiṃkaras tasya kiṃkarā sakalā purī ||
na hy anālocyakartāraḥ kiṃkarā bhavatām iti ||
atha nītam anāhārair asmābhir api tad dinam ||
kārye hi guruṇi vyagraṃ jighatsāpi na bādhate ||
tasmān mā mām apaśyantaḥ kṛdhvaṃ duḥkhāsikām iti ||
īdṛśas tādṛśaḥ prājñaḥ prekṣākārī ca gomukhaḥ |
pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇam ākhyāya samastāyāḥ puraḥ puraḥ |
adhunā madhunā mattaḥ kathaṃ paśyasi mām iti ||
atha mām ayam āha sma na madaḥ pāramārthikaḥ |
sadoṣaṃ tu vaco vaktuṃ mayāyaṃ kṛtrimaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
dūṣayanti na vaktāram ato .yaṃ kṛtrimo madaḥ ||
tatas tam uktavān asmi saṃbhāvitaguṇasya te |
athānenoktam astīti katham ity udite mayā |
śrūyatām ṛṣidattā me yatra netrapathaṃ gatā |
kasmād aviṣaye cakṣuś cetasā me prasāritam ||
rāgādhīnaṃ na me cakṣuḥ pravṛttaṃ gaṇikāsv api ||
nūnam eṣā parigrāhyā mama pravrajitā yataḥ |
jijñāsye tāvad ity enām agacchaṃ draṣṭum anv aham ||
dvitrair eva dinais tasyā viśvāsam udapādayam ||
ke ke deśās tvayā dṛṣṭāḥ krāmatā pṛthivīm iti ||
vatsadeśaḥ sa dṛṣṭaḥ prāṅ mameti kathite mayā ||
tayoktam alam ālāpair aparais tava durbhagaiḥ |
gomukhaṃ nāma niṣṇātaṃ savidyāsu kalāsv iti ||
athavā dhig adhīraṃ mām evaṃ tāvad bhavatv iti ||
tato .ham uktavān ārye jānāsīti kim ucyate |
ātmānaṃ ko na jānāti sa hi me paramaḥ suhṛt ||
athavā na viśeṣo .sti sūkṣmo .pi mama gomukhāt |
tena māṃ paśyatā vyaktaṃ dṛṣṭo bhavati gomukhaḥ ||
sānurāgeva dṛṣṭvā māṃ ciraṃ mantharam abravīt ||
ity uktvā cīvarāntena mukham āvṛtya nīcakaiḥ |
ṛṣidattām athāvocam ārye kiṃ kāraṇaṃ tvayā |
tayoktaṃ śrūyatām asti vidvān rājagṛhe vaṇik |
padmo nāma dhanaṃ yasya padmasyeva mahānidheḥ ||
sumanā mahadinnā ca tasya bhārye babhūvatuḥ ||
putrābhyāṃ dayite pitros tathā duhitarāv api ||
tatra yā sumanā nāma tasyāḥ sumanasaḥ sutā |
duhitā mahadinnāyā yā ca mātuḥ sanāmikā |
na kutaścin na kasyāṃcit kaścij jagati yādṛśaḥ ||
kaṃ hi nāma na gacchanti kanyāpitror manorathāḥ ||
kāle kvacid atīte tu taṃ guṇair janavallabham |
vārāṇasyāṃ tataḥ pitrā svasuḥ sumanaso gṛhe |
saṃtatādyaiḥ krameṇātha jvaraiḥ pañcabhir apy aham |
mām asāv acireṇaiva tasmād vyādher amocayat ||
svasthāvasthāṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā sumanā gṛham ānayat |
tataḥ śrutadhārāyai mām arpayat sumanāḥ punaḥ |
sa ca yātaḥ punar vyādhir mantrāgadabhayād iva ||
śravaṇām avadad dainyād durmanāḥ sumanās tataḥ |
tathā cāgrāhayat sā mām arhatpravacanaṃ yathā |
gaṇanīm akarod asmin vihāre mām anicchatīm ||
dhyānaṃ yad yat samāpadya devatālambanaṃ niśi |
yadā yadā ca gośabdam adhīyānā vadāmy aham |
mukhottarapadas tatra jāyate sa tadā tadā ||
jalpantī mukhaśabdaṃ ca prayuñje yadi kevalam |
tāvac ca na mayā tyaktā pratyāśā gomukhāśrayā |
campāsthasya prabhor mūlaṃ prasthitaḥ sabalaḥ kila |
yac cāsmi na mṛtā sadyaḥ śrutvā gomukhavaiśasam |
āsīc ca mama jīvantī jīvitasya mahat phalam |
api cāparam apy asti jīvitālambanaṃ mama |
mama tv āsīd yathāheyaṃ sarvaṃ tad upapadyate |
svair iyaṃ gurubhir dattā madīyair api yārthitā |
kumārī sānurāgā ca tasmān na tyāgam arhati ||
vyagreṇa cātra vṛttānte dattaṃ vaḥ kṛtakottaram |
ṛṣibhyaḥ śramaṇābhyaś ca dātum icchāmi bhojanam ||
tad ekam arhataṃ bhaktyā sadyaḥ pāpaṃ pramārjyate ||
saśrāvakagaṇān āryāṃs tāṃs tad āmantryatām iti ||
sarvathā sādhitaḥ sūdair āhāraḥ sa tathā yathā |
tādṛśī ca mayā vyaktā jvaritānukṛtiḥ kṛtā |
kim etad iti cāpṛcchat sā mām ujjvalasaṃbhramā |
column5: kim etad iti pṛṣṭā sā saṃbhramotkarṇayā mayā |

column3: atha saṃghaṭṭayan dantān uktavān asmi tāṃ śanaiḥ |
vratasthānāṃ viśeṣeṇa sthātuṃ saha rahaś ciram ||
pṛthagjanā janāś caite tena nirgamyatām iti ||
tayoktaṃ kṣaṇam apy ekam aśaktā svastham apy aham |
muktvā tvāṃ sthātum anyatra kiṃ punaḥ saṃtatajvaram ||
mama tv āsīd iyaṃ cintā satyam āhuś cikitsakāḥ |
sarve saṃkrāmiṇo rogāḥ spṛśatāṃ prāṇinām iti ||
madīyaḥ kṛtrimo .py enaṃ yatra saṃkrāmati jvaraḥ |
kathaṃ nāma na saṃkramet tatra yaḥ paramārthikaḥ ||
lāvaṇyam iva gātreṣu tad asyāḥ prāsphurat sphuṭam ||
tatas tām uktavān asmi dhik tvāṃ niṣkaruṇāśayām |
śītajvarārtam aṅgair yā na pīḍayasi mām iti ||
athāśliṣyaṃ tathā sā māṃ nādṛśyata yathā pṛthak |
yātāyām atha yāminyāṃ buddhvā vṛttāntam īdṛśam |
saṃghaḥ saṃhatya tāṃ svasmān nivāsān niravāsayat ||
tad evam ṛṣidattā vaḥ saṃvṛttā paricārikā |
athavā kiṃ vikalpena svayam ālokyatām iti ||
tathāpi kathitaṃ tena naiva saṃśayam atyajam |
prasthāpya prāk tadārhāṇi tāṃ didṛkṣus tato .gamam ||
pravrajyāyāṃ punar yasyāḥ kāntir yāsīd akṛtrimā |
durlabhāṇi kvacit tasyā vācakāny akṣarāṇy api ||
na śakyā sarvathā draṣṭuṃ janair lolekṣaṇair api ||
virūpasya tu vairūpyaṃ yat pracchādanam arhati |
tatas tām uktavān asmi sakhyāḥ kiṃ kāryam āśiṣā |
sarāgaiva satī yā tvaṃ vītarāgagatiṃ gatā ||
mokṣaḥ kāruṇikair uktaḥ siddhair duḥkhakṣayaḥ kila |
sarvathā subhagatāmahoddhataḥ kiṃkaro bhavatu gomukhas tava |
tām āmantrya svam āvāsam agacchaṃ sahagomukhaḥ ||
kañcukaṃ muñcatas tasya mayā dṛṣṭaḥ payodharaḥ |
āsīc ca mama yoṣaiṣā yatas tuṅgapayodharā |
lokas tu yad imāṃ sarvaḥ pratipannaḥ pumān iti |
na hi dṛṣṭena dṛṣṭārthe draṣṭur bhavati saṃśayaḥ ||
asāv api tam uddeśaṃ prakāśya jhagiti tviṣā |
sa tu mām abravīt trastaḥ kā nāma priyadarśanā |
tyājitāḥ stha yayā sadyaś cetasaḥ sthiratām iti ||
mayoktaṃ tava yaḥ syālaḥ puruṣaḥ priyadarśanaḥ |
yac ca vakṣyasi sarvasyāṃ vārāṇasyām ayaṃ pumān |
bhavataḥ katham ekasya pramadeti tad ucyate ||
adhunā bhavataḥ kāntā jātety atra kim ucyate ||
gatānugatiko lokaḥ pravṛtto hi yathā tathā |
paramārthaṃ punar veda sahasraikaḥ pumān iti ||
tenoktaṃ janatāsiddhaṃ viruddham api na tyajet |
kriyate chagalaḥ śvāpi saṃhatya bahubhir balāt ||
tena yuṣmadvidhaiḥ prājñair na vācyaṃ sad apīdṛśam |
aśraddheyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ pratyakṣam api yad bhavet ||
śrūyatāṃ ca kathā tāvad arthasyāsya prakāśikā |

column5: saśiṣyaiḥ kila yuṣmābhis tarantī prekṣitā śilā |

column3: nāyam artho mahānarthaḥ prakāśyaḥ putrakair iti ||
śreṣṭhi kiṃ na śṛṇoṣy ekam āścaryaṃ kathayāmi te |
tarantīṃ dṛṣṭavān asmi sopādhyāyaḥ śilām iti ||
tayāpi kathitaṃ rājñe sa tāṃ pṛṣṭvā paraṃparām |
satyaṃ brūhīti no vācyaḥ satyavādivrato bhavān |
mithyā brūhīti no vācyaḥ kāmī mithyāvrato hi saḥ ||
kiṃtu yat piṅgalenoktam etad yuktaṃ parīkṣitum |
pramadāt satyam apy ete vadanti baṭavo yataḥ ||
saśiṣyaiḥ kila yuṣmābhis tarantī prekṣitā śilā |
kim etat satyam āhosvin mṛṣety ākhyāyatām iti ||
āsīc cāsya dhig etāṃ me ninditāṃ satyavāditām |
duḥśraddhānam aniṣṭaṃ ca yan mayā vācyam īdṛśam ||
na satyam api tad vācyaṃ yad uktam asukhāvaham |
athāvocat sa rājānaṃ rājan mithyā baṭor vacaḥ |
agniṃ paśyati yaḥ śītaṃ plavamānāṃ śilām asau ||
viruddham idam īdṛk kaḥ śraddadhyād vadatām iti ||
sa mayokto bhavān eva duḥśraddhānasya bhāṣitā |
evaṃ ca mama vṛttāntaṃ vijānann api gomukhaḥ |
sa mamālāpam ākarṇya kāyacchāyāṃ vilokya ca |
pradhārya cāparair vaidyaiḥ śanakair idam abravīt ||
tenāsmai rucitaṃ yat tad āśu saṃpādyatām iti ||
saviṣādau karomi sma viṣādāv iva vairiṇau ||
grāsān agrāsayat ṣaḍ vā sapta vā gomukhājñayā ||
ye tatpāṇisarojasaṅgasubhagā grāsā mayā svāditās taiḥ sadyas tanutām anīyata sa me saṃkalpajanmā jvaraḥ |
śailendrāḥ śuciśukrabhānudahanapluṣṭopalādhityakā mandair apy udabindubhir navatarair ujhanti saṃtaptatām ||
pāṇḍityāndhaka mitrāre mā sma tiṣṭhaḥ puro mama ||
yasya yas tasya kas tasmād arātir aparaḥ paraḥ ||
ity uktaḥ sa viṣādena tyājitaś campakābhatām |
taṃ ca dīrgham ahaḥśeṣam āyatāṃ ca vibhāvarīm |
vismitau ciram ālokya sthavirau mām avocatām ||
bhavantam icchati draṣṭum iṣṭaṃ ced gamyatām iti ||
idam ākarṇya yat satyam īṣad ākulamānasaḥ |
kiṃ gacchāni na gacchāni gacchataḥ kiṃ bhaved iti |
vitarkya kṣaṇam āsīn me saṃdehacchedanī matiḥ ||
yo bandhavyo .thavā vadhyo na sa kañcukidūtakaḥ |
ye ca kecij janā yeṣāṃ viṣaye sukham āsate |
rājñām ājñām avajñāya teṣāṃ jīvanti te katham ||
amandaspandam etac ca kāṅkṣitām akṣi dakṣiṇam |
ākhyatīva priyāprāptiṃ mahyaṃ tad gamanaṃ hitam ||
samṛddhiḥ srūyatāṃ tasyāḥ kṛtaṃ vā tatpraśaṃsayā |
ko hi varṇayituṃ śakto naro meror adhityakām ||
sukhasevyaṃ durīkṣaṃ ca taptāṃśum iva haimanam ||
nṛpas tu māṃ ciraṃ dṛṣṭvā snehasnigdhāyatekṣaṇaḥ |
sa tu mām abhitaḥ sthitvā kāryamātrasya vācakaḥ |
āryajyeṣṭha manas tāvad avikṣiptaṃ kuru kṣaṇam |
rājā manmukhasaṃkrāntair vākyais tvām eṣa bhāṣate ||
sā kim ākhyāyate tubhyaṃ prathitā pṛthivīva yā ||
ye guṇās te .pi te buddhāḥ śiśirāṃśor ivāṃśavaḥ ||
asyāsīt kāliyo nāma śreṣṭhī prāṇapriyaḥ suhṛt |
antarvatyām asau patnyāṃ nītaḥ puṇyais tripiṣṭapam |
atha sā gṛhiṇī tasya kāle putraṃ vyajāyata ||
column5: atha kāle gate tasmiñ jyeṣṭhā putraṃ vyajāyata |

column3: tasmiñ jāte mahārājaḥ svātmajād api harṣade |
evaṃprāye ca vṛttānte dvāḥsthair vijñāpito nṛpaḥ |
dvāre vaḥ kāliyaḥ śreṣṭhī tiṣṭhatīti sasaṃbhramaiḥ ||
kas tvaṃ kasya kuto veti pṛṣṭaś cedam abhāṣata ||
lālitaḥ pālitaś cāsaṃ śikṣitaś cākhilāḥ kalāḥ ||
cyāvayitvā divaṃ nīto na hi nāśo .sti karmaṇām ||
athāsau bhavatāṃ dāsī durmanāḥ sumanāḥ sutām |
jātāṃ putra iti khyātim anayal lobhadūṣitā ||
bhāryayā hi kṛtaṃ karma patyāv api vipacyate ||
kule ca kulaputrasya jāto jātismaraḥ punaḥ |
asau ca yuvatir jātā kāntākārā ca dārikā |
evamādy uktavān ukto vismitena sa bhūbhṛtā |
pūrvaṃ yad āvayor vṛttaṃ tat kiṃcit smaryatām iti ||
anenāpi vihasyoktaṃ yad yad devāya rocate |
asaṃdigdhaṃ suviśrabdhas tat tat pṛṣṭatu mām iti ||
athādhyāya ciraṃ rājñā yad yat pṛṣṭaṃ cirantanam |
aśeṣaṃ tat tad etena saviśeṣaṃ niveditam ||
āhainaṃ dārikā kasmai jāmātre dīyatām iti ||
rocate yo varas tasyai tasmai sā dīyatām iti ||
bhavatyai rocate neti mātar ākhyāyatām iti ||
svedārdrāṃśukayā prāgvan na tad vicalitaṃ śiraḥ ||
tad bhavān rūcitas tasyai nṛpāya ca yatas tataḥ |
avanter aham āyātaḥ saha bhrātrā kanīyasā |
yogakṣemārthibhir bhavyais tasmād evaṃ bhavatv iti ||
yaś ca saṃvatsareṇāpi duḥsaṃbhāro nṛpaiḥ paraiḥ |
vivāhārthaḥ sa saṃbhāro rājñā saṃbhāritaḥ kṣaṇāt ||
dattvā tataḥ śreṣṭhipadaṃ nagaryāṃ vittaṃ ca bhūmaṇḍalamūlyatulyam |
samṛddhim anveṣya ca kāliyasya prāsthāpayan māṃ mudito narendraḥ ||
āsīc ca mama lokoktir iyaṃ mayy eva saṃprati |
vardhamāno yathā rājā śreṣṭhī jāta iti sthitā ||
ahorātre tv atikrānte sa gomukham apaśyataḥ |
āsīc ca me vilakṣasya vilakṣaṃ gomukhaṃ balāt |
adrākṣaṃ bhṛtyavargaṃ ca saṃcarantam itas tataḥ ||
cintitaṃ ca mayā diṅ māṃ vilakṣakam akāraṇe |
balād ānāyayāmy enaṃ kiṃ duḥkhāsikayā mama ||
kiṃ gomukhaḥ sakhā yasya prājñaṃmanyo na vidyate |
tasya sādhyāni kāryāṇi na sidhyantīti so .bravīt ||
na tu tatkāraṇair yogyair vinā sidhyati kasyacit ||
yad apīdaṃ mahat kāryaṃ yuṣmābhiḥ kila sādhitam |
prabhavaḥ prabhavanto hi doṣābhāse manāg api |
bhṛtyān udvejayanty eva teṣāṃ kiṃ kriyatām iti ||
kim asmin bhavatā kārye kṛtam ity udite mayā |
ākhyātum ayam ārabdhaḥ śrūyatāṃ yan mayā kṛtam ||
asty ahaṃ bhartsitaḥ kruddhair yuṣmābhiḥ svagṛhaṃ gataḥ |
tatra prāvṛtya mūrdhānaṃ patitvā śayano sthitaḥ ||
kim etad iti tasyaiva na mayā dattam uttaram ||
sā yadā dṛḍhanibandhā pṛcchati sma punaḥ punaḥ |
āma subhrū sa evāyam iti tasyai nyavedayam ||
āsīt sumanasaḥ kāpi priyā vidyādharī sakhī |
sā yadṛcchāgatā caināṃ prasaṅge kvacid abravīt |
tvaṃ mām āpadi kaṣṭāyāṃ vartamānā smarer iti ||
uktā cāsmi purā sakhyā vyasane māṃ smarer iti |
avocat sakhi mā bhaiṣīr janayitvedṛśīṃ sutām ||
kanyāyā hāṭakaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaṇṭhe gaṇḍakam abravīt ||
prabhāvād oṣadher asyāḥ striyam enāṃ satīṃ janāḥ |
paśyanti hi yathābhūtam arthaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā ||
tena yaḥ striyam evaināṃ draṣṭā sa bhavati dhruvam |
oṣadhir yā ca kaṇṭhe .syāḥ sā nāmnā priyadarśanā |
idam eva ca nāmāsyāḥ praśastaṃ kriyatām iti ||
ciraṃ sundari jīveti tenaiva viditaṃ mayā ||
na hi śaktaḥ striyaṃ draṣṭum enām avanigocaraḥ |
yas tu paśyati sma vyaktaṃ cakravartīty abhūn mama ||
tvaṃ ca gomukha eveti tadaiva jñātavaty aham |
sarūpaḥ savayāś cānyo nāsti yac cakravartinaḥ ||
rūpaṃ ca yuvarājasya tava cānāyitaṃ mayā |
kauśāmbītaḥ paṭe nyastaṃ tac ca niścayakāraṇam ||
yaḥ punar ghaṭanopāyaḥ kāryaḥ sa bhavatānayoḥ |
ghaṭane durghaṭasyāpi caturo hi bhavān iti ||
evamādi tataḥ śrutvā spṛhayāmi sma mṛtyave |
mayā satyaṃ bruvad bhartā mithyā brūteti kheditaḥ |
atra jīvati yas tasya mṛta evāmṛtopamaḥ ||
pāṇḍityāndhasuhṛdvairi mā sma tiṣṭha puro mama |
iti yaḥ svāminādiṣṭas tasya mṛtyum arhotsavaḥ ||
na cāsti durghaṭasyāsya ghaṭane mama kauśalam |
tasmān maraṇam evāstu dhik prāṇān duḥsthitān iti ||
na hi duḥkhakṣayopāyo mṛtyur iṣṭaḥ satām iti ||
asau ca dārakaḥ kuṇṭhaḥ khañjaḥ kubjaḥ pṛthūdaraḥ |
na vahāmi na puṣṇāmi bhavantaṃ niṣprayojanam ||
eṣa tvāṃ gāḍham āveṣṭya grīvāṃ bhittvāthavā śiraḥ |
tatas tena vihasyoktaṃ mā vākṣīr mā ca māṃ puṣaḥ |
etāvatā hi te kāryaṃ na madīyena mṛtyunā ||
mayāpi kila kartavyaṃ mahat kāryaṃ mahātmanām |
tad bhavān māṃ sahasreṇa vikrīṇītāṃ mahātmasu ||
sahasraṃ yac ca tad dattaṃ paryāptaṃ jīvanaṃ yataḥ |
mā sma tasmād vinā kāryān mārayan māṃ bhavān iti ||
mama tv āsīn mahātmānaḥ ke .nye yuṣmaj jagattraye |
sahasraṃ te na yat kiṃcit koṭyāpi yadi labhyate |
tucchamūlyas tathāpy eṣa tṛṇamuṣṭisamā hi sā ||
tat tad ityādi niścitya gṛham ānāyya taṃ tataḥ |
pracchannaṃ śreṣṭhino vṛttaṃ tāvan me kathyatām iti ||
kāliyena ca rājñā ca yad yat kāryaṃ rahaḥ kṛtam |
tat tat sumanase bhartrā kathitaṃ dhīracetase ||
yac ca śrutadharā kāryaṃ rājñaḥ śrutavatī guru |
tayā tayā ca tan mahyaṃ kubjāya kathitaṃ mayā |
kubjena brahmadattāya śeṣaṃ pratyakṣam eva ca ||
tad yuṣmābhir yad ādiṣṭaṃ yad atra bhavatā kṛtam |
tad ācakṣveti kāryaṃ tad etad atra mayā kṛtam ||
prāśaṃsaṃ caritaṃ tasya praśasyā hi guṇādhikāḥ ||
kā vidyādharacakravartipadake tucchā ratir mādṛśaḥ suprāpaṃ dharaṇīcarair yad aparaiḥ krodhādivaśyair api |
prajñādhikkṛtadevadānavagurur yeṣāṃ suhṛd gomukhaḥ te yat piṣṭapasaptakāptivimukhās tatkarmaṇāṃ jṛmbhitam ||
ayam āryakaniṣṭho vaḥ śreṇiśreṣṭhī bhavatv iti ||
atha yāte kvacit kāle saudhe sapriyadarśanaḥ |
sopāne tāram aśrauṣaṃ haṃsānām iva nisvanam ||
mama tv āsīn na haṃsānāṃ nūpurāṇām ayaṃ dhvaniḥ |
utsavābhyudayeṣv eva tā hi bibhrati bhūṣaṇam ||
vaṇṭakas tasya yuṣmābhiḥ sadārair gṛhyatām iti ||
atha mahyaṃ susaṃskāraṃ sā samudraṃ samudgakam |
mayoktaṃ dvayam apy etad arhati priyadarśanā |
preṣitaṃ yoṣitā yat tad yoṣid eva yato .rhati ||
idam ākarṇya tāḥ prekṣya vismitāḥ sasmitāś ca mām |
tasyai dattvā ca tad dravyam agacchan kṛtavandanāḥ ||
anabhyastaṃ hi yad yena tena tad vastu duḥsaham ||
kiṃ cānyat kulakanyānāṃ keyam īdṛk svatantratā |
na dhanāyaty api svāṅgaṃ kim aṅga dhanam adhruvam ||
tad asyāḥ ko bhaved bhāvo mayīty etad vitarkayan |
durantā vāthavā svantā na hīyaṃ prastutā mayā |
athavā saṃkaṭāt trātā mamāsty eva bhavān iti ||
mūḍhabhṛtyakṛtā doṣā na grāhyāḥ svāminām iti ||
mayāpy uktaṃ na paśyāmi doṣam ācaritaṃ tayā |
asti cet kṣānta evāsau tathāpy ākhyāyatām iti ||
ayi vairiṇi bhartāram evaṃ vadati kāṅganā |
yathokto mandayā jyeṣṭho yaśobhāginn iti tvayā ||
na ca tvadīyam evedaṃ vacaḥ saṃbhāvayaty asau |
yaḥ śreṣṭhiduhitur bhartā so .smākam api dharmataḥ |
priyadarśanayā sārdham abhinnaiva hi me tanuḥ ||
tathā vijñāpyatāṃ cedaṃ yathāvajñāṃ na manyate ||
iti śrutvedam āsīn me ko .nyaḥ paribhavaḥ paraḥ |
etasmād yad asāv āha bhāryā prasthāpyatām iti ||
yā vadhūs tātapādānāṃ mama bhāryā ca sā katham |
atha māṃ gomukho .vocat kim asthāne viśaṅkayā |
nedaṃ paragṛhaṃ devyās tathā viditam eva vaḥ ||
maṅgalaṃ hi vivāhāntam asyās tatraiva kāritam |
tac caitac ca gṛhaṃ tasmād abhinnaṃ dṛśyatām iti ||
tatas tadvacanān nyāyyād anujñātā satī mayā |
tac ca rājakulād dṛṣṭvā gacchatpravahaṇaṃ tataḥ |
sūryo .pi tad ahar manye bhagnākṣasyandano bhavet |
kṣaṇaṃ ca tatra viśrāntāṃ tām āliṅgam asau ca mām |
dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭā mayā tasyāḥ saṃprāptiṃ priyadarśanā ||
bahu śrotavyam atrāsti krameṇa śrūyatām iti |
uktvā ruṣṭaiva tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sācaṣṭa sma kathām imām ||
na ca tatra mayā dṛṣṭā mārgayantyā nṛpātmajā ||
tataḥ parijanas tasyāḥ prāha māṃ rājadārikā |
praviśya ca mayā dṛṣṭā tasminn udyānapālikā |
sā ca pṛṣṭā mayāvocad yo .yaṃ saṃdhyāvadāruṇaḥ |
dūrāt kurabakānāṃ ca [... au4 Zeichenjh] kānanam |
bhṛṅgadaṃśabhayāt kas taṃ nāpramattas tyajed iti ||
mama tv āsīd aho śaktir dohadasya varīyasī |
anṛtāv api yenaite jṛmbhitāḥ pādapā iti ||

column3: atha tasyā mayā gatvā samīpaṃ vandanā kṛtā |
tayāpi kṣiptacetastvān na kiṃcid api bhāṣitam ||
tataḥ kumudikā tasyāḥ pādam ālambya niṣṭhuram |
pratibuddhām avocat tāṃ bhaginī dṛśyatām iti ||
column5: ity uktvāntarhite deve pratibuddhā dadarśa sā |

column3: sukhāsīnāṃ ca mām āha bhartā te sukhabhāgini |
punar āha sa te bhartā chāttratvād durjanaḥ kila |
āhārādyair durārādhas tvayā tad iti me matiḥ ||
punar uktaṃ tayā smitvā nedaṃ saṃbhāvyate tayoḥ |
mayoktaṃ sarvam asty etat kiṃtu tau divyacakṣuṣau |
yad evādiśataḥ kiṃcit tat tathaiva hi sidhyati ||
jyeṣṭhasya ca guṇā jyeṣṭhās tābhyāṃ kasyeti mānuṣāḥ |
evaṃ ca kṣaṇam āsīnām āha māṃ rājadārikā |
āstām āstām iti mayā anicchantyā yāvad ucyate |
tāvad balād balātailaṃ nyadhāt kumudikā mayi ||
etat tvatkaraśākhābhir likhitaṃ [... au4 Zeichenjh] mbhakam |
athavā tvaṃ parādhīnā bhartaiva tava nirdayaḥ |
matsaṃdeśaṃ ca vācyo .sau kim asthāne kṛtam tvayā |
na hi cūḍāmaṇiḥ pāde prabhavāmīti badhyate ||
idaṃ hi karkaśāḥ soḍhuṃ śaktā rājanyakanyakāḥ |
ityādi bahu jalpitvā sā mām udvartanādibhiḥ |
bahur visraṃsamānāyāṃ granthir asyāṃ tayā kṛtaḥ |
tataḥ prasthāpitavatī mām ityādi vidhāya sā |
mekhalā skhalitā ceyaṃ chittvā tat tantubandhanam ||
iti tasyās tayā citre prapañce .smin nivedite |
tayā yad guru saṃdiṣṭam upalabdhaṃ ca yat tayā |
yat punar mekhalā baddhā niḥsarair bisatantubhiḥ |
satsv apy anyeṣu sūtreṣu tatredaṃ cintitaṃ tayā ||
anayā [... au4 Zeichenjh] prītim ādhāsyaty api kām iti ||
kathaṃ vettheti sāpṛcchad athettham aham uktavān ||
śyāmānāṃ maṇḍanaṃ tajjñaiś citravarṇaṃ tu varṇitam ||
kiṃca nānyā tataḥ kācid darśanīyatamā yataḥ |
tayoktaṃ dhig dhig astv eṣāṃ ratnalakṣaṇakāriṇām |
janaḥ pracchādanīyo .pi khyāpito yaiḥ śaṭhair api ||
mama tv āsīd iyaṃ cintā kiṃ mamopāyacintayā |
devatās tat kariṣyanti yena śāntir bhaviṣyati ||
yathā tāḥ prāptavān asmi tathā rājasutām iti ||
prātar eva prāyātāsmi tad eṣā mucyatām iti ||
atha tasyai pratijñāya gacchatv evaṃ bhavatv iti |
atha tāṃ dṛṣṭavān asmi prasthāpya priyadarśanām |
āstāṃ ca mama tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ mānasacakṣuṣī |
asāv akālamṛtyur yair nārīrūpo na vīkṣitaḥ ||
tayā cānanam unnamya hṛṣṭaḥ saṃdṛṣṭavān aham |
māṃ ca maddayitāṃ nāsau saṃmānitavatī samam |
mayi dṛṣṭam adāt tasyāṃ gāḍha [... au4 Zeichenjh] ṭhagrahārhaṇām ||
column61: na taṃ paśyāmi yasyāhaṃ taṃ na paśyāmi yo mama ||

column3: atha svayānam āropya sā priyāṃ priyadarśanām |
ahaṃ tu tad dinaṃ nītvā kṛcchrān mandiraniṣkuṭe |
sā ca māṃ tatra paśyantī saṃtataṃ priyadarśanām |
gāḍhaṃ niṣpīḍayantī ca ciram aṅgaṃ nyapīḍayat ||
vandanāchadmanā paścān māyy ātmānaṃ nidhāya sā |
ārādhayāmi nṛpasūnukṛte nu gaurīṃ kiṃ khānayāmi caturais tvaritaṃ suruṅgām |
